  4702                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  4703                                  ;
  4704                                  ; Procedure Name : ABSDRD
  4705                                  ;
  4706                                  ; Interrupt 25 handler. Performs absolute disk read.
  4707                                  ; Inputs:	AL - 0-based drive number
  4708                                  ;		DS:BX point to destination buffer
  4709                                  ;		CX number of logical sectors to read
  4710                                  ;		DX starting logical sector number (0-based)
  4711                                  ; Outputs:	Original flags still on stack
  4712                                  ;		Carry set
  4713                                  ;		    AH error from BIOS
  4714                                  ;		    AL same as low byte of DI from INT 24
  4715                                  ;
  4716                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  4717                                          ;procedure   ABSDRD,FAR
  4718                                  ABSDRD:
  4719                                  	; 15/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
  4720                                  	; MSDOS 6.21 (DOSCODE:42E5h)
  4721                                  	; 04/11/2022
  4722                                  	; MSDOS 5.0 (DOSCODE:42D8h)
  4723                                  	
  4724                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
  4725 00000531 FA                      	CLI
  4726                                  	
  4727                                  ;	set up ds to point to DOSDATA
  4728                                  
  4729 00000532 50                      	push	ax			; preserve AX value
  4730 00000533 8CD8                    	mov	ax,ds			; store DS value in AX
  4731                                  	;getdseg <ds>
  4732 00000535 2E8E1E[0700]            	mov	ds,[cs:DosDSeg]
  4733 0000053A A3[0A0D]                	mov	[TEMPSEG],ax		; store DS value in TEMPSEG
  4734 0000053D 58                      	pop	ax			; restore AX value
  4735                                  
  4736                                  	; M072:
  4737                                  	; We shall save es on the user stack here. We need to use ES in
  4738                                  	; order to access the DOSDATA variables AbsRdWr_SS/SP at exit

  5932                                  ;M044; Start of changes
  5933                                  ; Winoldap has a bug in that its calculations for the Windows memory image
  5934                                  ; to save is off by 1 para. This para can happen to be a Windows arena if the
  5935                                  ; DOS top of memory happens to be at an odd boundary (as is the case when
  5936                                  ; UMBs are present). This is because Windows builds its arenas only at even
  5937                                  ; para boundaries. This arena now gets trashed when Windows is swapped back
  5938                                  ; in leading to a crash. Winoldap issues callouts when it swaps Windows out
  5939                                  ; and back in. We sit on these callouts. On the Windows swapout, we save the
  5940                                  ; last para of the Windows memory block and then restore this para on the
  5941                                  ; Windows swapin callout. 
  5942                                  
  5943                                  getwinlast:
  5944                                  	; 07/12/2022
  5945 00000908 8B36[3003]              	mov	si,[CurrentPDB]
  5946 0000090C 4E                      	dec	si

  5949 00000914 C3                      	retn
  5950                                  
  5951                                  ; 15/12/2022
  5952                                  %if 0
  5953                                  winold_swap:
  5954                                  	push	ds
  5955                                  	push	es
  5956                                  	push	si
  5957                                  	push	di
  5958                                  	push	cx
  5959                                  
  5960                                  	;getdseg <ds>			;ds = DOSDATA
  5961                                  	mov	ds,[cs:DosDSeg]
  5962                                  
  5963                                  	cmp	al,1			;swap Windows out call
  5964                                  	jne	short swapin		;no, check if Swap in call
  5965                                  	call	getwinlast
  5966                                  	push	ds
  5967                                  	pop	es
  5968                                  	mov	ds,si			;ds = memory arena of Windows
  5969                                  	xor	si,si
  5970                                  	mov	di,WinoldPatch1
  5971                                  	mov	cx,8
  5972                                  	cld
  5973                                  	push	cx
  5974                                  	rep	movsb			;save first 8 bytes
  5975                                  	pop	cx
  5976                                  	mov	di,WinoldPatch2
  5977                                  	rep	movsb			;save next 8 bytes
  5978                                  	jmp	short winold_done
  5979                                  swapin:
  5980                                  	cmp	al,2			;swap Windows in call?
  5981                                  	jne	short winold_done	;no, something else, pass it on
  5982                                  	call	getwinlast
  5983                                  	mov	es,si
  5984                                  	xor	di,di
  5985                                  	mov	si,WinoldPatch1
  5986                                  	mov	cx,8
  5987                                  	cld

  5989                                  	rep	movsb			;restore first 8 bytes
  5990                                  	pop	cx

  6286                                  ; DOSMES.ASM (MSDOS 2.11, 1983)
  6287                                  
  6288                                  ; OEMFunction key is expected to process a single function
  6289                                  ;   key input from a device and dispatch to the proper
  6290                                  ;   routines leaving all registers UNTOUCHED.
  6291                                  ;
  6292                                  ; Inputs:   CS, SS are DOSGROUP
  6293                                  ; Outputs:  None. This function is expected to JMP to onw of
  6294                                  ;           the following labels:
  6295                                  ;
  6296                                  ;           GetCh       - ignore the sequence
  6297                                  ;           TwoEsc      - insert an ESCChar in the buffer
  6298                                  ;           ExitIns     - toggle insert mode
  6299                                  ;           EnterIns    - toggle insert mode
  6300                                  ;           BackSp      - move backwards one space
  6301                                  ;           ReEdit      - reedit the line with a new template
  6302                                  ;           KilNew      - discard the current line and start from scratch
  6303                                  ;           CopyLin     - copy the rest of the template into the line
  6304                                  ;           SkipStr     - read the next character and skip to it in the template
  6305                                  ;           CopyStr     - read next char and copy from template to line until char
  6306                                  ;           SkipOne     - advance position in template one character
  6307                                  ;           CopyOne     - copy next character in template into line
  6308                                  ;           CtrlZ       - place a ^Z into the template
  6309                                  ; Registers that are allowed to be modified by this function are:
  6310                                  ;           AX, CX, BP
  6311                                  
  6312                                  ; 13/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
  6313                                  ; -------------------------------------
  6314                                  ; DOSCODE:4820h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
  6315                                  
  6316                                  ; 05/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
  6317                                  ; -------------------------------------
  6318                                  ; DOSCODE:4813h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
  6319                                  
  6320                                  OEMFunctionKey:
  6321 00000A44 E80A09                  	CALL	_$STD_CON_INPUT_NO_ECHO	; Get the second byte of the sequence
  6322 00000A47 B10E                    	MOV     CL,ESCTABLEN ; 14	; length of table for scan
  6323 00000A49 57                      	PUSH    DI                      ; save DI (cannot change it!)
  6324 00000A4A BF[1A0A]                	MOV     DI,ESCTAB		; offset of second byte table
  6325 00000A4D 06                      	push	es
  6326 00000A4E 0E                      	push	cs
  6327 00000A4F 07                      	pop	es
  6328 00000A50 F2AE                    	REPNE   SCASB                   ; Look it up in the table
  6329 00000A52 07                      	pop	es
  6330 00000A53 5F                      	POP     DI                      ; restore DI
  6331 00000A54 D1E1                    	SHL     CX,1                    ; convert byte offset to word
  6332 00000A56 89CD                    	MOV     BP,CX                   ; move to indexable register
  6333                                  	;JMP	word [BP+ESCFUNC]	; Go to the right routine
  6334 00000A58 2EFFA6[280A]            	JMP	word [CS:BP+ESCFUNC]

  6816                                  
  6817                                  ; Inputs:
  6818                                  ;       None
  6819                                  ; Function:
  6820                                  ;       Return MS-DOS version number
  6821                                  ; Outputs:
  6822                                  ;       OEM number in BH
  6823                                  ;       User number in BL:CX (24 bits)
  6824                                  ;       Version number as AL.AH in binary
  6825                                  ;       NOTE: On pre 1.28 DOSs AL will be zero
  6826                                  
  6827                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
  6828                                  ;
  6829                                  ;	Fake_Count is used to lie about the version numbers to support
  6830                                  ;	old binarys. See ms_table.asm for more info.

  6834                                  ;		else if input al = 01
  6835                                  ;		  (bh) = version flags
  6836                                  ;		 
  6837                                  ;		       	 bits 0-2 = DOS internal revision
  6838                                  ;		       	 bits 3-7 = DOS type flags
  6839                                  ;		              bit 3    = DOS is in ROM
  6840                                  ;		              bit 4    = DOS in in HMA
  6841                                  ;		              bits 5-7 = reserved
  6842                                  ;               M007 change - only bit 3 is now valid. Other bits
  6843                                  ;               are 0 when AL = 1

  6937                                  ;BREAK <$International - return country-dependent information>
  6938                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6939                                  ;
  6940                                  ; Procedure Name : $INTERNATIONAL
  6941                                  ;
  6942                                  ; Inputs:
  6943                                  ;	MOV	AH,International
  6944                                  ;	MOV	AL,country	(al = 0 => current country)
  6945                                  ;      [MOV	BX,country]
  6946                                  ;	LDS	DX,block
  6947                                  ;	INT	21
  6948                                  ; Function:
  6949                                  ;	give users an idea of what country the application is running
  6950                                  ; Outputs:
  6951                                  ;	IF DX != -1 on input (get country)
  6952                                  ;	  AL = 0 means return current country table.
  6953                                  ;	  0<AL<0FFH means return country table for country AL
  6954                                  ;	  AL = 0FF means return country table for country BX
  6955                                  ;	  No Carry:
  6956                                  ;	     Register BX will contain the 16-bit country code.
  6957                                  ;	     Register AL will contain the low 8 bits of the country code.
  6958                                  ;	     The block pointed to by DS:DX is filled in with the information
  6959                                  ;	     for the particular country.
  6960                                  ;		BYTE  Size of this table excluding this byte and the next
  6961                                  ;		BYTE  Country code represented by this table
  6962                                  ;			A sequence of n bytes, where n is the number specified
  6963                                  ;			by the first byte above and is not > internat_block_max,
  6964                                  ;			in the correct order for being returned by the
  6965                                  ;			INTERNATIONAL call as follows:
  6966                                  ;		WORD	Date format 0=mdy, 1=dmy, 2=ymd
  6967                                  ;		5 BYTE	Currency symbol null terminated
  6968                                  ;		2 BYTE	thousands separator null terminated
  6969                                  ;		2 BYTE	Decimal point null terminated
  6970                                  ;		2 BYTE	Date separator null terminated
  6971                                  ;		2 BYTE	Time separator null terminated
  6972                                  ;		1 BYTE	Bit field.  Currency format.
  6973                                  ;			Bit 0.	=0 $ before #  =1 $ after #
  6974                                  ;			Bit 1.	no. of spaces between # and $ (0 or 1)
  6975                                  ;		1 BYTE	No. of significant decimal digits in currency
  6976                                  ;		1 BYTE	Bit field.  Time format.
  6977                                  ;			Bit 0.	=0 12 hour clock  =1 24 hour
  6978                                  ;		DWORD	Call address of case conversion routine
  6979                                  ;		2 BYTE	Data list separator null terminated.
  6980                                  ;	  Carry:
  6981                                  ;	     Register AX has the error code.
  6982                                  ;	IF DX = -1 on input (set current country)
  6983                                  ;	  AL = 0 is an error
  6984                                  ;	  0<AL<0FFH means set current country to country AL
  6985                                  ;	  AL = 0FF means set current country to country BX
  6986                                  ;	  No Carry:
  6987                                  ;	    Current country SET
  6988                                  ;	    Register AL will contain the low 8 bits of the country code.
  6989                                  ;	  Carry:
  6990                                  ;	     Register AX has the error code.
  6991                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  6992                                  
  6993                                  ;procedure   $INTERNATIONAL,NEAR   ; DOS 3.3
  6994                                  
  6995                                  ; 13/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
  6996                                  ; DOSCODE:4A4Dh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
  6997                                  
  6998                                  ; 05/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
  6999                                  ; DOSCODE:4A40h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
  7000                                  
  7001                                  _$INTERNATIONAL:  ; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3), offset 1992h
  7002                                  	 
  7003 00000C4D 3CFF                    	CMP	AL,0FFH
  7004 00000C4F 7404                    	JZ	short BX_HAS_CODE	; -1 means country code is in BX
  7005 00000C51 88C3                    	MOV	BL,AL			; Put AL country code in BX
  7006 00000C53 30FF                    	XOR	BH,BH
  7007                                  BX_HAS_CODE:
  7008 00000C55 1E                      	PUSH	DS
  7009 00000C56 07                      	POP	ES
  7010 00000C57 52                      	PUSH	DX
  7011 00000C58 5F                      	POP	DI			; User buffer to ES:DI
  7012                                  
  7013                                  ;hkn; SS is DOSDATA

  7826                                  
  7827                                  ;**	$Char_Oper - Manipulate Switch Character
  7828                                  ;
  7829                                  ;	This function was put in to facilitate XENIX path/switch compatibility
  7830                                  ;
  7831                                  ;	ENTRY	AL = function:
  7832                                  ;		    0 - read switch char
  7833                                  ;		    1 - set switch char (char in DL)
  7834                                  ;		    2 - read device availability
  7835                                  ;			Always returns available
  7836                                  ;		    3 - set device availability
  7837                                  ;			No longer supported (NOP)
  7838                                  ;	EXIT	(al) = 0xff iff error
  7839                                  ;		(al) != 0xff if ok
  7840                                  ;		  (dl) = character/flag, if "read switch char" subfunction
  7841                                  ;	USES	AL, DL
  7842                                  ;
  7843                                  ;	NOTE	This already obsolete function has been deactivated in DOS 5.0
  7844                                  ;		The character / is always returned for subfunction 0,
  7845                                  ;		subfunction 2 always returns -1, all other subfunctions are ignored.
  7846                                  
  7847                                  ; 13/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
  7848                                  ; DOSCODE:4CC9h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
  7849                                  
  7850                                  ; 06/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
  7851                                  ; DOSCODE:4CBCh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
  7852                                  
  7853                                  _$CHAR_OPER:
  7854                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
  7855 00000EB3 08C0                    	or	al,al				; get switch?
  7856 00000EB5 B22F                    	mov	dl,'/'				; assume yes
  7857 00000EB7 7407                    	jz	short chop_1			; jump if yes
  7858 00000EB9 3C02                    	cmp	al,2				; check device availability?
  7859 00000EBB B2FF                    	mov	dl,-1				; assume yes
  7860 00000EBD 7401                    	jz	short chop_1			; jump if yes
  7861 00000EBF C3                      	retn					; otherwise just quit
  7862                                  
  7863                                  ; subfunctions requiring return of value to user come here. DL holds
  7864                                  ; value to return
  7865                                  
  7866                                  chop_1:
  7867 00000EC0 E8C2F5                  	call	Get_User_Stack
  7868 00000EC3 895406                  	mov	[SI+user_env.user_DX],dx	; store value for user
  7869 00000EC6 C3                      	retn

  8027                                  ;BREAK <$Parse_File_Descriptor -- Parse an arbitrary string into an FCB>
  8028                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8029                                  ; Inputs:
  8030                                  ;       DS:SI Points to a command line
  8031                                  ;       ES:DI Points to an empty FCB
  8032                                  ;       Bit 0 of AL = 1 At most one leading separator scanned off
  8033                                  ;                   = 0 Parse stops if separator encountered
  8034                                  ;       Bit 1 of AL = 1 If drive field blank in command line - leave FCB
  8035                                  ;                   = 0  "    "    "     "         "      "  - put 0 in FCB
  8036                                  ;       Bit 2 of AL = 1 If filename field blank - leave FCB
  8037                                  ;                   = 0  "       "      "       - put blanks in FCB
  8038                                  ;       Bit 3 of AL = 1 If extension field blank - leave FCB
  8039                                  ;                   = 0  "       "      "        - put blanks in FCB
  8040                                  ; Function:
  8041                                  ;       Parse command line into FCB
  8042                                  ; Returns:
  8043                                  ;       AL = 1 if '*' or '?' in filename or extension, 0 otherwise
  8044                                  ;       DS:SI points to first character after filename
  8045                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  8046                                  
  8047                                  _$PARSE_FILE_DESCRIPTOR:
  8048 00000F02 E8813E                  	call	MAKEFCB
  8049 00000F05 56                      	PUSH    SI
  8050 00000F06 E87CF5                  	call	Get_User_Stack
  8051                                  	;pop	word [si+8]
  8052 00000F09 8F4408                  	POP     word [SI+user_env.user_SI]
  8053 00000F0C C3                      	retn

  8513                                  ;
  8514                                  ;	There has been a bug in our fatsize calculation for so long
  8515                                  ;	  that we can't correct it now without causing some user to
  8516                                  ;	  experience data loss. There are even cases where allowing
  8517                                  ;	  the number of clusters to exceed the fats is the optimal
  8518                                  ;	  case -- where adding 2 more fat sectors would make the
  8519                                  ;	  data field smaller so that there's nothing to use the extra
  8520                                  ;	  fat sectors for.
  8521                                  ;
  8522                                  ;	Note that this bug had very minor known symptoms. CHKDSK would
  8523                                  ;	  still report that there was a cluster left when the disk was
  8524                                  ;	  actually full. Very graceful failure for a corrupt system
  8525                                  ;	  configuration. There may be worse cases that were never
  8526                                  ;	  properly traced back to this bug. The problem cases only
  8527                                  ;	  occurred when partition sizes were very near FAT sector
  8528                                  ;	  rounding boundaries, which were rare cases.
  8529                                  ;
  8530                                  ;	Also, it's possible that some third-party partition program might
  8531                                  ;	  create a partition that had a less-than-perfect FAT calculation
  8532                                  ;	  scheme. In this hypothetical case, the number of allocation
  8533                                  ;	  clusters which don't actually have FAT entries to represent
  8534                                  ;	  them might be larger and might create a more catastrophic
  8535                                  ;	  failure. So we'll provide the safeguard of limiting the
  8536                                  ;	  max_cluster to the amount that will fit in the FATs.
  8537                                  ;
  8538                                  ;	ax = maximum legal cluster, ES:BP -> dpb
  8539                                  
  8540                                  ;	make sure the number of fat sectors is actually enough to
  8541                                  ;	  hold that many clusters. otherwise, back the number of
  8542                                  ;	  clusters down
  8543                                  
  8544                                  	; 15/12/2022
  8545                                  	; bx = number of clusters
  8546                                  
  8547                                  	; 19/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
  8548                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
  8549                                  	; 15/12/2022
  8550                                  	;mov	bx,ax			; remember calculated # clusters
  8551                                  
  8552                                  	; 01/08/2018 (MSDOS 3.3)

  8554                                  	;xor	ah,ah

  8556                                  	; 10/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

  8890                                  	; (MSDOS 6.0 note)
  8891                                  	;
  8892                                  	; The address in BX:AX will be F01D:FEF0 if there is 64K or more 
  8893                                  	; memory in the system. This is equivalent to 0:c0 if A20 is OFF.
  8894                                  	; If DOS is in HMA this equivalence is no longer valid as A20 is ON.
  8895                                  	; But the BIOS which now resides in FFFF:30 has 5 bytes in FFFF:D0
  8896                                  	; (F01D:FEF0) which is the same as the ones in 0:C0, thereby 
  8897                                  	; making this equvalence valid for this particular case. If however
  8898                                  	; there is less than 64K remaining the address in BX:AX will not 
  8899                                  	; be the same as above. We will then stuff 0:c0, the call 5 address
  8900                                  	; into the PSP.
  8901                                  	;
  8902                                  	; Therefore for the case where there is less than 64K remaining in 
  8903                                  	; the system old CPM Apps that look at PSP:6 to determine memory
  8904                                  	; requirements will not work. Call 5, however will continue to work
  8905                                  	; for all cases.
  8906                                  	;
  8907

  8909                                  	;mov	[8],bx

  9653                                  
  9654                                  ; 06/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
  9655                                  ; DOSCODE:5126h (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
  9656                                  
  9657                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9658                                  ; Each handler must leave everything untouched; including flags!
  9659                                  ;
  9660                                  ; Sleaze for time savings: first instruction is a return. This is patched
  9661                                  ; by the sharer to be a PUSH AX to complete the correct routines.
  9662                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9663                                  
  9664                                  ; (DOSMAC.INC, MSDOS 6.0, 1991)
  9665                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9666                                  ; Some old versions of the 80286 have a bug in the chip. The popf instruction
  9667                                  ; will enable interrupts. Therefore in a section of code with interrupts
  9668                                  ; disabled and you need a popf instruction use the 'popff' macro instead.
  9669                                  ; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  9670                                  
  9671                                  ;%macro POPFF 0
  9672                                  ;	jmp	$+3
  9673                                  ;	iret
  9674                                  ;	push	cs
  9675                                  ;	call	$-2
  9676                                  ;%endmacro
  9677                                  
  9678                                  ; ---------------------------
  9679

  9692 000012EE 740D                    	jz	short ECritDisk_2

 10061                                  ;
 10062                                  
 10063                                  ;**	Old style CP/M 1-12 system calls to talk to reserved devices

 10065                                  ;	$Std_Con_Input

 10079                                  
 10080                                  ; The following routines form the console I/O group (funcs 1,2,6,7,8,9,10,11).
 10081                                  ; They assume ES and DS NOTHING, while not strictly correct, this forces data
 10082                                  ; references to be SS or CS relative which is desired.

 10084                                  ;DOSCODE SEGMENT
 10085                                  ;	ASSUME	SS:DOSDATA,CS:DOSCODE
 10086                                  
 10087                                  
 10088                                  ;hkn; 	All the variables use SS override or DS. Therefore there is
 10089                                  ;hkn;	no need to specifically set up any seg regs unless SS assumption is
 10090                                  ;hkn;	not valid. 
 10091                                  
 10092                                  ; DOSCODE:51BAh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 10093                                  ; 08/11/2022

 10097                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10098                                  ;
 10099                                  ; Procedure : $Std_Con_Input_No_Echo
 10100                                  ;
 10101                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10102                                  ;
 10103                                  
 10104                                  _$STD_CON_INPUT_NO_ECHO:   ;System call 8
 10105                                  
 10106                                  ; Inputs:
 10107                                  ;	None
 10108                                  ; Function:
 10109                                  ;	Input character from console, no echo
 10110                                  ; Returns:
 10111                                  ;	AL = character
 10112                                  
 10113 00001351 1E                      	push	ds
 10114 00001352 56                      	push	si
 10115                                  INTEST:
 10116 00001353 E8803C                  	call	STATCHK
 10117 00001356 753A                    	jnz	short GET ; 08/09/2018
 10118                                  ;*************************************************************************
 10119                                  ;hkn; SS override
 10120 00001358 36803E[A00A]00          	cmp	byte [SS:PRINTER_FLAG],0  ; is printer idle?
 10121 0000135E 7505                    	jnz	short no_sys_wait
 10122 00001360 B405                    	mov	ah,5			; get input status with system wait
 10123 00001362 E8D72F                  	call	IOFUNC
 10124                                  no_sys_wait:
 10125                                  ;**************************************************************************
 10126 00001365 B484                    	MOV	AH,84h
 10127 00001367 CD2A                    	INT	int_IBM	 ; int 2Ah
 10128                                  
 10129                                  ;;; 7/15/86  update the date in the idle loop
 10130                                  ;;; Dec 19, 1986 D.C.L. changed following CMP to Byte Ptr from Word Ptr
 10131                                  ;;;;		 to shorten loop in consideration of the PC Convertible
 10132                                  
 10133                                  ;hkn; SS override
 10134 00001369 36803E[910D]FF          	CMP	byte [SS:DATE_FLAG],-1	; date is updated may be every
 10135 0000136F 751A                    	JNZ	short NoUpdate		; 65535 x ? ms if no one calls
 10136                                  
 10137 00001371 50                      	PUSH	AX
 10138 00001372 53                      	PUSH	BX			; following is tricky,
 10139 00001373 51                      	PUSH	CX			; it may be called by critical handler
 10140 00001374 52                      	PUSH	DX			; at that time, DEVCALL is used by
 10141                                  					; other's READ or WRITE
 10142 00001375 1E                      	PUSH	DS			; save DS = SFT's segment
 10143                                  
 10144                                  ;hkn; READTIME must use ds = DOSDATA
 10145                                  ;hkn;	PUSH	CS			; READTIME must use DS=CS
 10146                                  
 10147 00001376 16                      	PUSH	SS ; 04/05/2019
 10148 00001377 1F                      	POP	DS
 10149                                  
 10150                                  	;MOV	AX,0			; therefore, we save DEVCALL
 10151                                  	; 26/06/2024
 10152 00001378 31C0                    	xor	ax,ax
 10153 0000137A E89102                  	CALL	Save_Restore_Packet	; save DEVCALL packet
 10154                                  	;invoke	READTIME		; readtime
 10155 0000137D E88FF7                  	call	READTIME
 10156 00001380 B80100                  	MOV	AX,1
 10157 00001383 E88802                  	CALL	Save_Restore_Packet	; restore DEVCALL packet
 10158                                  
 10159                                  ;	; MSDOS 3.3 (IBMDOS.COM, Offset 1F8Ch)
 10160                                  ;	; (MSDOS 6.0 code does not contain IBM DOS FETCHI_TAG check)
 10161                                  ;	push	bx
 10162                                  ;	mov	bx,DATE_FLAG
 10163                                  ;	add	bx,2  ; mov bx,FETCHI_FLAG
 10164                                  ;	cmp	word [cs:bx],5872h
 10165                                  ;	jz	short FETCHI_TAG_chk_ok
 10166                                  ;	call	DOSINIT
 10167                                  ;FETCHI_TAG_chk_ok:
 10168                                  ;	pop	bx
 10169                                  
 10170 00001386 1F                      	POP	DS			; restore DS
 10171 00001387 5A                      	POP	DX
 10172 00001388 59                      	POP	CX
 10173 00001389 5B                      	POP	BX
 10174 0000138A 58                      	POP	AX
 10175                                  NoUpdate:
 10176                                  
 10177                                  ;hkn; SS override
 10178 0000138B 36FF06[910D]            	INC	word [SS:DATE_FLAG]
 10179                                  
 10180                                  ;;; 7/15/86 ;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
 10181 00001390 EBC1                    	JMP	short INTEST
 10182                                  GET:
 10183 00001392 30E4                    	XOR	AH,AH
 10184 00001394 E8A52F                  	call	IOFUNC
 10185 00001397 5E                      	POP	SI
 10186 00001398 1F                      	POP	DS
 10187                                  ;;; 7/15/86
 10188                                  
 10189                                  ;hkn; SS override
 10190                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 10191 00001399 36C606[900D]00          	MOV	BYTE [SS:SCAN_FLAG],0
 10192                                  	;
 10193 0000139F 3C00                    	CMP	AL,0	    ; extended code ( AL )
 10194 000013A1 7505                    	JNZ	short noscan
 10195                                  
 10196                                  ;hkn; SS override
 10197                                  	;MOV	BYTE [SS:SCAN_FLAG],1 ; set this flag for ALT_Q key
 10198                                  	; 20/06/2023
 10199 000013A3 36FE06[900D]            	inc	byte [SS:SCAN_FLAG]
 10200                                  noscan:
 10201 000013A8 C3                      	retn

 10204                                  ;
 10205                                  ;**	$STD_CON_STRING_OUTPUT - Console String Output
 10206                                  ;
 10207                                  ;
 10208                                  ;	ENTRY	(DS:DX) Point to output string '$' terminated
 10209                                  ;	EXIT	none
 10210                                  ;	USES	ALL
 10211                                  ;
 10212                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10213                                  ;
 10214                                  
 10215                                  _$STD_CON_STRING_OUTPUT:	;System call 9
 10216                                  
 10217 000013A9 89D6                    	mov	si,dx
 10218                                  STRING_OUT1:	
 10219 000013AB AC                      	lodsb
 10220 000013AC 3C24                    	cmp	al,'$'
 10221 000013AE 74F8                    	je	short noscan
 10222                                  NEXT_STR1:
 10223 000013B0 E88402                  	call	OUTT
 10224 000013B3 EBF6                    	jmp	short STRING_OUT1
 10225                                  
 10226                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10227                                  ;
 10228                                  ;**	$STD_CON_STRING_INPUT - Input Line from Console
 10229                                  ;
 10230                                  ;	$STD_CON_STRING_INPUT Fills a buffer from console input until CR
 10231                                  ;
 10232                                  ;	ENTRY	(ds:dx) = input buffer
 10233                                  ;	EXIT	none
 10234                                  ;	USES	ALL
 10235                                  ;
 10236                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 10237                                  
 10238                                  	; 15/01/2024
 10239                                  
 10240                                  _$STD_CON_STRING_INPUT:		;System call 10
 10241                                  
 10242                                  	; 15/01/2024
 10243                                  	;mov	ax,ss
 10244                                  	;mov	es,ax
 10245 000013B5 16                      	push	ss
 10246 000013B6 07                      	pop	es
 10247                                  
 10248 000013B7 89D6                    	mov	si,dx
 10249 000013B9 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch
 10250 000013BB AD                      	lodsw
 10251                                  
 10252                                  ;	(AL) = the buffer length
 10253                                  ;	(AH) = the template length
 10254                                  
 10255 000013BC 08C0                            or	al,al
 10256 000013BE 74E8                            jz	short noscan	;Buffer is 0 length!!?
 10257 000013C0 88E3                    	mov	bl,ah		;Init template counter
 10258 000013C2 88EF                            mov	bh,ch		;Init template counter
 10259                                  
 10260                                  ;	(BL) = the number of bytes in the template
 10261                                  
 10262 000013C4 38D8                            cmp	al,bl
 10263 000013C6 7605                            jbe	short NOEDIT	;If length of buffer inconsistent with contents
 10264 000013C8 80380D                          cmp	byte [bx+si],c_CR ; 0Dh
 10265 000013CB 7402                            jz	short EDITON	;If CR correctly placed EDIT is OK
 10266                                  
 10267                                  ; The number of chars in the template is >= the number of chars in buffer or
 10268                                  ; there is no CR at the end of the template. This is an inconsistant state
 10269                                  ; of affairs. Pretend that the template was empty:
 10270                                  ;
 10271                                  
 10272                                  NOEDIT:	
 10273 000013CD 88EB                    	mov	bl,ch		;Reset buffer
 10274                                  EDITON: 
 10275 000013CF 88C2                    	mov	dl,al
 10276 000013D1 4A                      	dec	dx		;DL is # of bytes we can put in the buffer
 10277                                  
 10278                                  ;	Top level. We begin to read a line in.
 10279                                  
 10280                                  NEWLIN: 
 10281 000013D2 36A0[F901]              	mov	al,[SS:CARPOS]
 10282 000013D6 36A2[FA01]              	mov	[SS:STARTPOS],al ;Remember position in raw buffer
 10283                                  
 10284 000013DA 56                      	push	si
 10285 000013DB BF[FB01]                	mov	di,INBUF ;Build the new line here
 10286 000013DE 36882E[7905]            	mov	byte [SS:INSMODE],ch ;Insert mode off

 11553                                  ;Break <$Get_FCB_Position - set random record fields to current pos>
 11554                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11555                                  ;
 11556                                  ;   $Get_FCB_Position - look at an FCB, retrieve the current position from the
 11557                                  ;	extent and next record field and set the random record field to point
 11558                                  ;	to that record
 11559                                  ;
 11560                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:DX point to a possible extended FCB
 11561                                  ;   Outputs:	The random record field of the FCB is set to the current record
 11562                                  ;   Registers modified: all
 11563                                  ;
 11564                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11565                                  ;
 11566                                  
 11567                                  _$GET_FCB_POSITION:
 11568 00001753 E8C804                  	call	GetExtended		; point to FCB
 11569 00001756 E89904                  	call	GetExtent		; DX:AX is current record
 11570                                  	;mov	[si+21h],ax
 11571 00001759 894421                  	MOV	[SI+SYS_FCB.RR],AX 	; drop in low order piece
 11572                                  	;mov	[si+23h],dl
 11573 0000175C 885423                  	MOV	[SI+SYS_FCB.RR+2],DL	; drop in high order piece
 11574                                  	;cmp	word [si+0Eh],64
 11575 0000175F 837C0E40                	CMP	word [SI+SYS_FCB.RECSIZ],64
 11576 00001763 7303                    	JAE	short GetFCBBye
 11577                                  	;mov	[si+24h],dh
 11578 00001765 887424                  	MOV	[SI+SYS_FCB.RR+2+1],DH	; Set 4th byte only if record size < 64
 11579                                  GoodPath:	; 16/12/2022
 11580                                  GetFCBBye:
 11581 00001768 E9E6EE                  	jmp	FCB_RET_OK

 11895                                  
 11896                                  ;Break <Misbehavior fixers>
 11897                                  ;
 11898                                  ;   FCBs suffer from several problems. First, they are maintained in the
 11899                                  ;   user's space so he may move them at will. Second, they have a small
 11900                                  ;   reserved area that may be used for system information. Third, there was
 11901                                  ;   never any "rules for behavior" for FCBs; there was no protocol for their
 11902                                  ;   usage.
 11903                                  ;
 11904                                  ;   This results in the following misbehavior:
 11905                                  ;
 11906                                  ;	infinite opens of the same file:
 11907                                  ;
 11908                                  ;	While (TRUE) {			While (TRUE) {
 11909                                  ;	    FCBOpen (FCB);		    FCBOpen (FCB);
 11910                                  ;	    Read (FCB); 		    Write (FCB);
 11911                                  ;	    }				    }
 11912                                  ;
 11913                                  ;	infinite opens of different files:
 11914                                  ;
 11915                                  ;	While (TRUE) {			While (TRUE) {
 11916                                  ;	    FCBOpen (FCB[i++]); 	    FCBOpen (FCB[i++]);
 11917                                  ;	    Read (FCB); 		    Write (FCB);
 11918                                  ;	    }				    }
 11919                                  ;
 11920                                  ;	multiple closes of the same file:
 11921                                  ;
 11922                                  ;	FCBOpen (FCB);
 11923                                  ;	while (TRUE)
 11924                                  ;	    FCBClose (FCB);
 11925                                  ;
 11926                                  ;	I/O after closing file:
 11927                                  ;
 11928                                  ;	FCBOpen (FCB);
 11929                                  ;	while (TRUE) {
 11930                                  ;	    FCBWrite (FCB);
 11931                                  ;	    FCBClose (FCB);
 11932                                  ;	    }
 11933                                  ;
 11934                                  ;   The following is am implementation of a methodology for emulating the
 11935                                  ;   above with the exception of I/O after close. We are NOT attempting to
 11936                                  ;   resolve that particular misbehavior. We will enforce correct behaviour in
 11937                                  ;   FCBs when they refer to a network file or when there is file sharing on
 11938                                  ;   the local machine.
 11939                                  ;
 11940                                  ;   The reserved fields of the FCB (10 bytes worth) is divided up into various
 11941                                  ;   structures depending on the file itself and the state of operations of the
 11942                                  ;   OS. The information contained in this reserved field is enough to
 11943                                  ;   regenerate the SFT for the local non-shared file. It is assumed that this
 11944                                  ;   regeneration procedure may be expensive. The SFT for the FCB is
 11945                                  ;   maintained in a LRU cache as the ONLY performance inprovement.
 11946                                  ;
 11947                                  ;   No regeneration of SFTs is attempted for network FCBs.
 11948                                  ;
 11949                                  ;   To regenerate the SFT for a local FCB, it is necessary to determine if the
 11950                                  ;   file sharer is working. If the file sharer is present then the SFT is not
 11951                                  ;   regenerated.
 11952                                  ;
 11953                                  ;   Finally, if there is no local sharing, the full name of the file is no
 11954                                  ;   longer available. We can make up for this by using the following
 11955                                  ;   information:
 11956                                  ;
 11957                                  ;	The Drive number (from the DPB).
 11958                                  ;	The physical sector of the directory that contains the entry.
 11959                                  ;	The relative position of the entry in the sector.
 11960                                  ;	The first cluster field.
 11961                                  ;	The last used SFT.
 11962                                  ;      OR In the case of a device FCB
 11963                                  ;	The low 6 bits of sf_flags (indicating device type)
 11964                                  ;	The pointer to the device header
 11965                                  ;
 11966                                  ;   We read in the particular directory sector and examine the indicated
 11967                                  ;   directory entry. If it matches, then we are kosher; otherwise, we fail.
 11968                                  ;
 11969                                  ;   Some key items need to be remembered:
 11970                                  ;
 11971                                  ;	Even though we are caching SFTs, they may contain useful sharing
 11972                                  ;	information. We enforce good behavior on the FCBs.
 11973                                  ;
 11974                                  ;	Network support must not treat FCBs as impacting the ref counts on
 11975                                  ;	open VCs. The VCs may be closed only at process termination.
 11976                                  ;
 11977                                  ;	If this is not an installed version of the DOS, file sharing will
 11978                                  ;	always be present.
 11979                                  ;
 11980                                  ;	We MUST always initialize lstclus to = firclus when regenerating a
 11981                                  ;	file. Otherwise we start allocating clusters up the wazoo.
 11982                                  ;
 11983                                  ;	Always initialize, during regeneration, the mode field to both isFCB
 11984                                  ;	and open_for_both. This is so the FCB code in the sharer can find the
 11985                                  ;	proper OI record.
 11986                                  ;
 11987                                  ;   The test bits are:
 11988                                  ;
 11989                                  ;	00 -> local file
 11990                                  ;	40 -> sharing local
 11991                                  ;	80 -> network
 11992                                  ;	C0 -> local device
 11993                                  
 11994                                  ;Break	<SaveFCBInfo - store pertinent information from an SFT into the FCB>
 11995                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 11996                                  ;
 11997                                  ;   SaveFCBInfo - given an FCB and its associated SFT, copy the relevant
 11998                                  ;	pieces of information into the FCB to allow for subsequent
 11999                                  ;	regeneration. Poke LRU also.
 12000                                  ;
 12001                                  ;   Inputs:	ThisSFT points to a complete SFT.
 12002                                  ;		DS:SI point to the FCB (not an extended one)
 12003                                  ;   Outputs:	The relevant reserved fields in the FCB are filled in.
 12004                                  ;		DS:SI preserved

 12216                                  ;   ResetLRU - during lru updates, we may wrap at 64K. We must walk the
 12217                                  ;   entire set of SFTs and subtract 8000h from their lru counts and truncate
 12218                                  ;   at 0.

 12221                                  ;		ES:DI point to SFT currently being updated

 12298                                  ;Break	<LRUFCB - perform LRU on FCB sfts>
 12299                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 12300                                  ;
 12301                                  ;   LRUFCB - find LRU fcb in cache. Set ThisSFT and return it. We preserve
 12302                                  ;	the first keepcount sfts if they are network sfts or if sharing is
 12303                                  ;	loaded.  If carry is set then NO BLASTING is NECESSARY.

 12529                                  ;
 12530                                  ; LruFCB -- allocate the LRU SFT from the SFT Table. The LRU scheme
 12531                                  ; maintains separate counts for net/Share and local SFTs. We allocate a 
 12532                                  ; net/Share SFT only if we do not find a local SFT. This helps keep
 12533                                  ; net/Share SFTs which cannot be regenerated for as long as possible. We
 12534                                  ; optimize regeneration operations by keeping track of the current local
 12535                                  ; SFT. This avoids scanning of the SFTs as long as we have at least one 
 12536                                  ; local SFT in the SFT Block.
 12537                                  ;
 12538                                  ; Inputs: al = 0 => Regenerate SFT operation
 12539                                  ;	    = 1 => Allocate new SFT for Open/Create
 12540                                  ;
 12541                                  ; Outputs: Carry clear
 12542                                  ;	 	es:di = Address of allocated SFT
 12543                                  ;	  	ThisSFT = Address of allocated SFT
 12544                                  ;
 12545                                  ;	  carry set if closes of net/Share files failed 
 12546                                  ;		al = error_FCB_unavailable
 12547                                  ;
 12548                                  ; Registers affected: None
 12549                                  ;
 12550                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 12551

 13145                                  ; --------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13146                                  ;	BlastSFT is used when an SFT is no longer needed; it's called with
 13147                                  ;	various garbage values to put into the SFT.  I don't know why,
 13148                                  ;	presumably to help with debugging (jgl).  We clear the few fields
 13149                                  ;	necessary to show that the SFT is free after filling it.

 13528                                  ;Break <GetRR - return the random record field in DX:AX>
 13529                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13530                                  ;
 13531                                  ;   GetRR - correctly load DX:AX with the random record field (3 or 4 bytes)
 13532                                  ;	from the FCB pointed to by DS:SI
 13533                                  ;
 13534                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI point to an FCB
 13535                                  ;		BX has record size

 13543                                  	;mov	dx,[si+23h]
 13544 00001BE7 8B5423                  	MOV	DX,[SI+SYS_FCB.RR+2]	; get high order part
 13545 00001BEA 83FB40                  	CMP	BX,64			; ignore MSB of RR if recsiz > 64

 13578                                  ;Break <SetExtent - update the extent/NR field>
 13579                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 13580                                  ;
 13581                                  ;   SetExtent - change the position of an FCB by filling in the extent/NR
 13582                                  ;	fields
 13583                                  ;
 13584                                  ;   Inputs:	DS:SI point to FCB
 13585                                  ;		DX:AX is a record location in file

 13598 00001C10 D1E1                    	SHL	CX,1

 14317                                  
 14318                                  ; The SFT at ES:DI is the one that is already in use for this FCB. We set the
 14319                                  ; FCB to use this one. We increment its ref count. We do NOT close it at all.
 14320                                  ; Consider:
 14321                                  ;
 14322                                  ;   open (foo)	delete (foo) open (bar)
 14323                                  ;
 14324                                  ; This causes us to recycle (potentially) bar through the same local SFT as
 14325                                  ; foo even though foo is no longer needed; this is due to the server closing
 14326                                  ; foo for us when we delete it. Unfortunately, we cannot see this closure.
 14327                                  ; If we were to CLOSE bar, the server would then close the only reference to
 14328                                  ; bar and subsequent I/O would be lost to the redirector.
 14329                                  ;
 14330                                  ; This gets solved by NOT closing the sft, but zeroing the ref count
 14331                                  ; (effectively freeing the SFT) and informing the sharer (if relevant) that
 14332                                  ; the SFT is no longer in use. Note that the SHARER MUST keep its ref counts
 14333                                  ; around. This will allow us to access the same file through multiple network
 14334                                  ; connections and NOT prematurely terminate when the ref count on one
 14335                                  ; connection goes to zero.
 14336                                  
 14337                                  OpenFound:
 14338                                  	;mov	[si+18h],al
 14339 00001EA8 884418                  	MOV	[SI+fcb_sfn],AL 	; assign with this
 14340 00001EAB 26FF05                  	inc	word [es:di]
 14341                                  	;INC	word [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count]
 14342                                  					; remember this new invocation
 14343                                  	; 24/01/2024
 14344 00001EAE 16                      	push	ss
 14345 00001EAF 1F                      	pop	ds
 14346                                  	
 14347                                  	;MOV	AX,[SS:FCBLRU]		; update LRU counts
 14348 00001EB0 A1[1000]                	mov	ax,[FCBLRU] ; 24/01/2024
 14349                                  	;mov	[es:di+15h],ax
 14350 00001EB3 26894515                	MOV	[ES:DI+sf_LRU],AX
 14351                                  ;
 14352                                  ; We have an FCB sft that is now of no use. We release sharing info and then
 14353                                  ; blast it to prevent other reuse.
 14354                                  ;
 14355                                  	;push	ss
 14356                                  	;pop	ds
 14357                                  
 14358 00001EB7 C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 14359 00001EBB 26FF0D                  	dec	word [es:di]

 14361                                  					; free the newly allocated SFT

 14420                                  ; Procedure Name : $DIR_SEARCH_FIRST
 14421                                  ;

 14432

 15096                                  ; several cases to consider:
 15097                                  ;
 15098                                  ;   o	Local, simple CDS.  In this case, we take the input path and convert
 15099                                  ;	it into a WFP.	We verify the existance of this directory and then
 15100                                  ;	copy the WFP into the CDS and set up the ID field to point to the
 15101                                  ;	directory cluster.
 15102                                  ;   o	Net CDS.  We form the path from the root (including network prefix)
 15103                                  ;	and verify its existance (via DOS_Chdir).  If successful, we copy the
 15104                                  ;	WFP back into the CDS.
 15105                                  ;   o	SUBST'ed CDS.  This is no different than the local, simple CDS.
 15106                                  ;   o	JOIN'ed CDS.  This is trouble as there are two CDS's at work.  If we
 15107                                  ;	call TransPath, we will get the PHYSICAL CDS that the path refers to
 15108                                  ;	and the PHYSICAL WFP that the input path refers to.  This is perfectly
 15109                                  ;	good for the validation but not for currency.  We call TransPathNoSet
 15110                                  ;	to process the path but to return the logical CDS and the logical
 15111                                  ;	path.  We then copy the logical path into the logical CDS.
 15112                                  ;
 15113                                  ; Inputs:
 15114                                  ;	DS:DX Points to asciz name
 15115                                  ; Returns:
 15116                                  ;	STD XENIX Return
 15117                                  ;	AX = chdir_path_not_found if error
 15118                                  ;
 15119                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15120                                  
 15121                                  _$CHDIR:
 15122 0000212A BF[BE03]                	MOV	DI,OPENBUF		; spot for translated name
 15123 0000212D 89D6                    	MOV	SI,DX			; get source
 15124 0000212F E87448                  	call	TransPath		; go munge the path and get real CDS
 15125 00002132 7304                    	JNC	short ChDirCrack	; no errors, try path
 15126                                  ChDirErrP:
 15127                                  	;mov	al,3
 15128 00002134 B003                    	MOV	AL,error_path_not_found
 15129                                  ChDirErr:
 15130                                  	;jmp	SYS_RET_ERR 	; oops!
 15131                                  	; 10/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 15132 00002136 EBC9                    	jmp	short chdir_errj
 15133                                  
 15134                                  ChDirCrack:
 15135 00002138 803E[7A05]FF            	CMP	byte [CMETA],-1		; No meta chars allowed.
 15136 0000213D 75F5                    	JNZ	short ChDirErrP
 15137                                  
 15138                                  ; We cannot do a ChDir (yet) on a raw CDS. This is treated as a path not
 15139                                  ; found.
 15140                                  
 15141 0000213F C43E[A205]              	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 15142 00002143 83FFFF                  	CMP	DI,-1			;   if (ThisCDS == NULL)
 15143 00002146 74EC                    	JZ	short ChDirErrP		;	error ();
 15144                                  
 15145                                  ; Find out if the directory exists.
 15146                                  
 15147 00002148 E88B0F                  	call	DOS_CHDIR
 15148                                  	;Jc	short ChDirErr
 15149                                  	; 16/12/2022
 15150 0000214B 72B4                    	jc	short chdir_errj
 15151                                  ;
 15152                                  ; Get back CDS to see if a join as seen. Set the currency pointer (only if
 15153                                  ; not network). If one was seen, all we need to do is copy in the text
 15154                                  ;
 15155 0000214D C43E[A205]              	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 15156                                  	;test	word [es:di+43h],2000h
 15157                                  	; 17/12/2022
 15158 00002151 26F6454420              	test	byte [ES:DI+curdir.flags+1],curdir_splice>>8
 15159                                  	;TEST	word [ES:DI+curdir.flags],curdir_splice
 15160 00002156 7425                    	JZ	short GotCDS
 15161                                  
 15162                                  ; The CDS was joined. Let's go back and grab the logical CDS.
 15163                                  
 15164 00002158 06                      	push	es	
 15165 00002159 57                      	push	di
 15166 0000215A 51                      	push	cx			; save CDS and cluster...
 15167 0000215B E827E3                  	call	Get_User_Stack		; get original text
 15168                                  	
 15169                                  	;mov	di,[si+6]
 15170 0000215E 8B7C06                  	MOV	DI,[SI+user_env.user_DX]
 15171                                  	;mov	ds,[si+0Eh]
 15172 00002161 8E5C0E                  	MOV	DS,[SI+user_env.user_DS]
 15173                                  	
 15174 00002164 BE[BE03]                	MOV	SI,OPENBUF		; spot for translated name
 15175 00002167 87F7                    	XCHG	SI,DI
 15176 00002169 30C0                    	XOR	AL,AL			; do no splicing
 15177 0000216B 57                      	push	di
 15178 0000216C E84348                  	call	TransPathNoSet		; Munge path
 15179 0000216F 5E                      	pop	si
 15180                                  
 15181                                  ; There should NEVER be an error here.
 15182                                  
 15183                                  ;IF FALSE
 15184                                  ;	JNC SKipErr
 15185                                  ;	fmt <>,<>,<"$p: Internal CHDIR error\n">
 15186                                  ;SkipErr:
 15187                                  ;ENDIF
 15188 00002170 C43E[A205]              	LES	DI,[THISCDS]		; get new CDS
 15189                                  	;mov	word [es:di+49h],-1
 15190 00002174 26C74549FFFF            	MOV	word [ES:DI+curdir.ID],-1
 15191                                  					; no valid cluster here...
 15192 0000217A 59                      	pop	cx
 15193 0000217B 5F                      	pop	di
 15194 0000217C 07                      	pop	es
 15195                                  
 15196                                  ; ES:DI point to the physical CDS, CX is the ID (local only)
 15197                                  
 15198                                  GotCDS:
 15199                                  
 15200                                  ; wfp_start points to the text. See if it is long enough
 15201                                  
 15202                                  	; MSDOS 3.3
 15203                                  	;push	ss
 15204                                  	;pop	ds
 15205                                  	;mov	si,[WFP_START]
 15206                                  	;push	cx
 15207                                  	;call	DStrLen
 15208                                  	;cmp	cx,67 ; cmp cx,DIRSTRLEN
 15209                                  	;pop	cx
 15210                                  	;ja	short ChDirErrP
 15211                                  
 15212                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 15213 0000217D E85000                  	CALL	Check_PathLen		;PTM.		;AN000;
 15214 00002180 77B2                    	JA	short ChDirErrP
 15215                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 15216                                  	;TEST	word [ES:DI+curdir.flags],curdir_isnet ; 8000h
 15217                                  	; 17/12/2022
 15218 00002182 26F6454480              	test	byte [ES:DI+curdir.flags+1],curdir_isnet>>8
 15219 00002187 7512                    	JNZ	short SkipRecency
 15220                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 15221                                  	;test	word [es:di+43h],2000h
 15222                                  	; 17/12/2022
 15223 00002189 26F6454420              	test	byte [ES:DI+curdir.flags+1],curdir_splice>>8
 15224                                  	;TEST	word [ES:DI+curdir.flags],curdir_splice 
 15225                                  					;PTM. for Join and Subst ;AN000;
 15226 0000218E 7403                    	JZ	short setdirclus	;PTM.		;AN000;
 15227 00002190 B9FFFF                  	MOV	CX,-1			;PTM.		;AN000;
 15228                                  setdirclus:
 15229                                  	;mov	[es:di+49h],cx
 15230 00002193 26894D49                	MOV	[ES:DI+curdir.ID],CX
 15231 00002197 C43E[A205]              	LES	DI,[THISCDS]		; get logical CDS
 15232                                  SkipRecency:
 15233 0000219B E827F0                  	call	FStrCpy
 15234 0000219E 30C0                    	XOR	AL,AL
 15235                                  mkdir_ok:
 15236 000021A0 E992E4                  	jmp	SYS_RET_OK

 15264                                  DoDirCall:

 15266

 15281                                  	;push	ss

 15299 000021CC 72E6                    	JC	short MkErr		; no errors

 15302 000021CE EBD0                    	jmp	short mkdir_ok
