 15333                                  ; IOCTL.ASM, MSDOS 6.0, 1991
 15334                                  ;============================================================================
 15335                                  ; 07/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 15336                                  ; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 15337                                  
 15338                                  ;**	IOCTL system call.
 15339                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15340                                  ;	$IOCTL
 15341                                  ;
 15342                                  ;	  Revision history:
 15343                                  ;
 15344                                  ;		Created: ARR 4 April 1983
 15345                                  ;
 15346                                  ;		GenericIOCTL added:		KGS	22 April 1985
 15347                                  ;
 15348                                  ;		A000	version 4.00	Jan. 1988
 15349                                  ;
 15350                                  ;		Used jump table to dispatch IOCTL functions. HKN 3/12/90
 15351                                  ;
 15352                                  
 15353                                  ;BREAK <IOCTL - munge on a handle to do device specific stuff>
 15354                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15355                                  ;
 15356                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 15357                                  ;	    MOV     BX, Handle
 15358                                  ;	    MOV     DX, Data
 15359                                  ;
 15360                                  ;	(or LDS     DX,BUF
 15361                                  ;	    MOV     CX,COUNT)
 15362                                  ;
 15363                                  ;	    MOV     AH, Ioctl
 15364                                  ;	    MOV     AL, Request
 15365                                  ;	    INT     21h
 15366                                  ;
 15367                                  ;   AH = 0  Return a combination of low byte of sf_flags and device driver
 15368                                  ;	    attribute word in DX, handle in BX:
 15369                                  ;	    DH = high word of device driver attributes
 15370                                  ;	    DL = low byte of sf_flags
 15371                                  ;	 1  Set the bits contained in DX to sf_flags.  DH MUST be 0.  Handle
 15372                                  ;	    in BX.
 15373                                  ;	 2  Read CX bytes from the device control channel for handle in BX
 15374                                  ;	    into DS:DX.  Return number read in AX.
 15375                                  ;	 3  Write CX bytes to the device control channel for handle in BX from
 15376                                  ;	    DS:DX.  Return bytes written in AX.
 15377                                  ;	 4  Read CX bytes from the device control channel for drive in BX
 15378                                  ;	    into DS:DX.  Return number read in AX.
 15379                                  ;	 5  Write CX bytes to the device control channel for drive in BX from
 15380                                  ;	    DS:DX.  Return bytes written in AX.
 15381                                  ;	 6  Return input status of handle in BX. If a read will go to the
 15382                                  ;	    device, AL = 0FFh, otherwise 0.
 15383                                  ;	 7  Return output status of handle in BX. If a write will go to the
 15384                                  ;	    device, AL = 0FFh, otherwise 0.
 15385                                  ;	 8  Given a drive in BX, return 1 if the device contains non-
 15386                                  ;	    removable media, 0 otherwise.
 15387                                  ;	 9  Return the contents of the device attribute word in DX for the
 15388                                  ;	    drive in BX.  0200h is the bit for shared.	1000h is the bit for
 15389                                  ;	    network. 8000h is the bit for local use.
 15390                                  ;	 A  Return 8000h if the handle in BX is for the network or not.
 15391                                  ;	 B  Change the retry delay and the retry count for the system. BX is
 15392                                  ;	    the count and CX is the delay.
 15393                                  ;
 15394                                  ;   Error returns:
 15395                                  ;	    AX = error_invalid_handle
 15396                                  ;	       = error_invalid_function
 15397                                  ;	       = error_invalid_data
 15398                                  ;
 15399                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15400                                  ;
 15401                                  ;   This is the documentation copied from DOS 4.0 it is much better
 15402                                  ;   than the above
 15403                                  ;
 15404                                  ;	There are several basic forms of IOCTL calls:
 15405                                  ;
 15406                                  ;
 15407                                  ;	** Get/Set device information:	**
 15408                                  ;
 15409                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15410                                  ;		  0 - Get device information
 15411                                  ;		  1 - Set device information
 15412                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 15413                                  ;		(DX) = info for "Set Device Information"
 15414                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15415                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15416                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15417                                  ;		  (DX) = info for "Get Device Information"
 15418                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15419                                  ;
 15420                                  ;
 15421                                  ;	**  Read/Write Control Data From/To Handle  **
 15422                                  ;
 15423                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15424                                  ;		  2 - Read device control info
 15425                                  ;		  3 - Write device control info
 15426                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 15427                                  ;		(CX) = transfer count
 15428                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data
 15429                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15430                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15431                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15432                                  ;		  (AX) = count of bytes transfered
 15433                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15434                                  ;
 15435                                  ;
 15436                                  ;	**  Read/Write Control Data From/To Block Device  **
 15437                                  ;
 15438                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15439                                  ;		  4 - Read device control info
 15440                                  ;		  5 - Write device control info
 15441                                  ;		(BL) = Drive number (0=default, 1='A', 2='B', etc)
 15442                                  ;		(CX) = transfer count
 15443                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data
 15444                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15445                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15446                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15447                                  ;		  (AX) = count of bytes transfered
 15448                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15449                                  ;
 15450                                  ;
 15451                                  ;	**  Get Input/Output Status  **
 15452                                  ;
 15453                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15454                                  ;		  6 - Get Input status
 15455                                  ;		  7 - Get Output Status
 15456                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 15457                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15458                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15459                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15460                                  ;		  (AL) = 00 if not ready
 15461                                  ;		  (AL) = FF if ready
 15462                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15463                                  ;
 15464                                  ;
 15465                                  ;	**  Get Drive Information  **
 15466                                  ;
 15467                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15468                                  ;		  8 - Check for removable media
 15469                                  ;		  9 - Get device attributes
 15470                                  ;		(BL) = Drive number (0=default, 1='A', 2='B', etc)
 15471                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15472                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15473                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15474                                  ;		  (AX) = 0/1 media is removable/fixed (func. 8)
 15475                                  ;		  (DX) = device attribute word (func. 9)
 15476                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15477                                  ;
 15478                                  ;
 15479                                  ;	**  Get Redirected bit	**
 15480                                  ;
 15481                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15482                                  ;		  0Ah - Network stuff
 15483                                  ;		(BX) = file handle
 15484                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15485                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15486                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15487                                  ;		  (DX) = SFT flags word, 8000h set if network file
 15488                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15489                                  ;
 15490                                  ;
 15491                                  ;	**  Change sharer retry parameters  **
 15492                                  ;
 15493                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15494                                  ;		  0Bh - Set retry parameters
 15495                                  ;		(CX) = retry loop count
 15496                                  ;		(DX) = number of retries
 15497                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15498                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15499                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15500                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15501                                  ;
 15502                                  ;
 15503                                  ;   =================================================================
 15504                                  ;
 15505                                  ;	**  New Standard Control  **
 15506                                  ;
 15507                                  ;	ALL NEW IOCTL FACILITIES SHOULD USE THIS FORM.	THE OTHER
 15508                                  ;	FORMS ARE OBSOLETE.
 15509                                  ;
 15510                                  ;   =================================================================
 15511                                  ;
 15512                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15513                                  ;		  0Ch - Control Function subcode
 15514                                  ;		(BX) = File Handle
 15515                                  ;		(CH) = Category Indicator
 15516                                  ;		(CL) = Function within category
 15517                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data, if any
 15518                                  ;		(SI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 15519                                  ;		(DI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 15520                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15521                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15522                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15523                                  ;		  (SI) = Return value, meaning is function dependent
 15524                                  ;		  (DI) = Return value, meaning is function dependent
 15525                                  ;		  (DS:DX) = Return address, use is function dependent
 15526                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15527                                  ;
 15528                                  ;    ============== Generic IOCTL Definitions for DOS 3.2 ============
 15529                                  ;     (See inc\ioctl.inc for more info)
 15530                                  ;
 15531                                  ;	ENTRY	(AL) = function code
 15532                                  ;		  0Dh - Control Function subcode
 15533                                  ;		(BL) = Drive Number (0 = Default, 1= 'A')
 15534                                  ;		(CH) = Category Indicator
 15535                                  ;		(CL) = Function within category
 15536                                  ;		(DS:DX) = address for data, if any
 15537                                  ;		(SI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 15538                                  ;		(DI) = Passed to device as argument, use depends upon function
 15539                                  ;
 15540                                  ;	EXIT	'C' set if error
 15541                                  ;		  (AX) = error code
 15542                                  ;		'C' clear if OK
 15543                                  ;		  (DS:DX) = Return address, use is function dependent
 15544                                  ;	USES	ALL
 15545                                  ;
 15546                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 15547                                  	
 15548                                  	; 17/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 15549                                  	; DOSCODE:611Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 15550                                  
 15551                                  	; 11/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 15552                                  	; DOSCODE:610Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 15553

 16165                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16166                                  ; Proc Name : Check_If_Net:
 16167                                  ;
 16168                                  ;
 16169                                  ; Checks if the device is over the net or not. Returns result in ZERO flag.
 16170                                  ; If no device is found, the return address is popped off the stack, and a
 16171                                  ; jump is made to ioctl_drv_err.
 16172                                  ;
 16173                                  ; On Entry:
 16174                                  ; Registers same as those for Get_Driver_BL
 16175                                  ;
 16176                                  ; On Exit:
 16177                                  ; ZERO flag	- set if not a net device
 16178                                  ;		- reset if net device
 16179                                  ; ES:DI -> the device
 16180                                  ;
 16181                                  ;
 16182                                  ; BUGBUG: This function assumes the following stack setup on entry
 16183                                  ;
 16184                                  ;	  SP+2 -> Error return address
 16185                                  ;	  SP   -> Normal return address
 16186                                  ;
 16187                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16188                                  
 16189                                  Check_If_Net:
 16190                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 (& MSDOS 6.0)
 16191 0000244E E8D0FF                  	CALL	Get_Driver_BL
 16192 00002451 7201                    	JC	short ioctl_drv_err_pop	; invalid drive letter
 16193                                  
 16194                                  ; 30/01/2024 ('Get_Driver_BL' returns with
 16195                                  ;	      'curdir_isnet' condition/ZF, no need to a second test)
 16196                                  %if 0
 16197                                  	;;;
 16198                                  	; (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM, Windows ME IO.SYS)
 16199                                  	PUSH	ES
 16200                                  	PUSH	DI
 16201                                  	LES	DI,[THISCDS]
 16202                                  	;test	word [es:di+43h],8000h
 16203                                  	;TEST	word [ES:DI+curdir.flags],curdir_isnet
 16204                                  	;test	byte [es:di+44h],80h
 16205                                  	TEST	byte [ES:DI+curdir.flags+1],(curdir_isnet>>8)
 16206                                  	POP	DI
 16207                                  	POP	ES
 16208                                  	;;;
 16209                                  %endif
 16210 00002453 C3                      	retn

 16332                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16333                                  ;
 16334                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DELETE
 16335                                  ;
 16336                                  ; Inputs:
 16337                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 16338                                  ;		terminated)
 16339                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 16340                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 16341                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 16342                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 16343                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 16344                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 16345                                  ; Function:
 16346                                  ;	Delete the specified file(s)
 16347                                  ; Outputs:
 16348                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 16349                                  ;		OK
 16350                                  ;	CARRY SET
 16351                                  ;	    AX is error code
 16352                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 16353                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 16354                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 16355                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 16356                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 16357                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 16358                                  ;		error_access_denied
 16359                                  ;			Attempt to delete device or directory
 16360                                  ;		***error_sharing_violation***
 16361                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 16362                                  ;			This error is NOT returned. The INT 24H is generated,
 16363                                  ;			  and the file is ignored (not deleted). Delete will
 16364                                  ;			  simply continue on looking for more files.
 16365                                  ;			  Carry will NOT be set in this case.
 16366                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 16367                                  ;
 16368                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16369                                  
 16370                                  FILEFOUND   equ 01h
 16371                                  FILEDELETED equ 10h
 16372                                  
 16373                                  
 16374                                  	; 12/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 16376                                  
 16377                                  	; 30/01/2024

 16856                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_RENAME - Internal RENAME call for MS-DOS
 16857                                  ;	NAME	DOS_RENAME
 16858                                  
 16859                                  ;**	Low level routine for renaming files
 16860                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16861                                  ;	DOS_RENAME
 16862                                  ;
 16863                                  ;	Modification history:
 16864                                  ;
 16865                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 16866                                  
 16867                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16868                                  ;
 16869                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_RENAME
 16870                                  ;
 16871                                  ; Inputs:
 16872                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to SOURCE WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 16873                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 16874                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string [SOURCE]
 16875                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 16876                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 16877                                  ;	[REN_WFP] Points to DEST WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3
 16878                                  ;		chars, NUL terminated)
 16879                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 16880                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 16881                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 16882                                  ; Function:
 16883                                  ;	Rename the specified file(s)
 16884                                  ;	NOTE: This routine uses most of AUXSTACK as a temp buffer.
 16885                                  ; Outputs:
 16886                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 16887                                  ;	    OK
 16888                                  ;	CARRY SET
 16889                                  ;	    AX is error code
 16890                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 16891                                  ;			No match for source, or dest path invalid
 16892                                  ;		error_not_same_device
 16893                                  ;			Source and dest are on different devices
 16894                                  ;		error_access_denied
 16895                                  ;			Directory specified (not simple rename),
 16896                                  ;			Device name given, Destination exists.
 16897                                  ;			NOTE: In third case some renames may have
 16898                                  ;			 been done if metas.
 16899                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 16900                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 16901                                  ;			SOURCE ONLY
 16902                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 16903                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 16904                                  ;			SOURCE ONLY
 16905                                  ;		error_sharing_violation
 16906                                  ;			Deny both access required, generates an INT 24.
 16907                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 16908                                  ;
 16909                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 16910                                  
 16911                                  	; 14/11/2022 Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 16912                                  
 16913                                  	; 31/01/2024
 16914

 16924                                  ;	transfer NET_RENAME

 16926                                  	;MOV	AX,(MultNET SHL 8) OR 17
 16927                                  	;INT	2FH
 16928                                  	;return
 16929                                  
 16930 0000267B B81111                  	mov     ax, 1111h
 16931 0000267E CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR - RENAME REMOTE FILE
 16932                                  			; SS = DS = DOS CS, 
 16933                                  			; SDA first filename pointer = offset of fully-qualified old name
 16934                                  			; SDA CDS pointer -> current directory
 16935                                  			; Return: CF set on error
 16936 00002680 C3                      	retn
 16937                                  ;ENDIF

 17756                                  ;** 	Low level DUP routine for use by EXEC when creating a new process.

 17765                                  ;BREAK <DOS_DUP -- DUP SFT across network>
 17766                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17767                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_DUP
 17768                                  ;
 17769                                  ; Inputs:
 17770                                  ;	[THISSFT] set to the SFT for the file being DUPed
 17771                                  ;		(a non net SFT is OK, in this case the ref
 17772                                  ;		 count is simply incremented)
 17773                                  ; Function:
 17774                                  ;	Signal to the devices that a logical open is occurring
 17775                                  ; Returns:

 17777                                  ;    Carry clear
 17778                                  ;	SFT ref_count is incremented
 17779                                  ; Registers modified: None.
 17780                                  ; NOTE:
 17781                                  ;	This routine is called from $CREATE_PROCESS_DATA_BLOCK at DOSINIT
 17782                                  ;	time with SS NOT DOSGROUP. There will be no Network handles at
 17783                                  ;	that time.
 17784                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 17794                                  DOS_Dup_Direct:

 17810                                  ;TITLE	DOS_CREATE/DOS_CREATE_NEW - Internal CREATE calls for MS-DOS
 17811                                  ;NAME	DOS_CREATE
 17812                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17813                                  ;**	Internal Create and Create new to create a local or NET file and SFT.
 17814                                  ;
 17815                                  ;	DOS_CREATE

 17822                                  ;
 17823                                  ;	    A000 version 4.00	  Jan. 1988

 17825

 17843                                  ;***	DOS_CREATE - Create a File
 17844                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17845                                  ;	DOS_Create is called to create the specified file, truncating
 17846                                  ;	the old one if it exists.
 17847                                  ;
 17848                                  ;	ENTRY	AX is Attribute to create
 17849                                  ;		(ds) = DOSDATA
 17850                                  ;		[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 17851                                  ;			terminated)
 17852                                  ;		[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 17853                                  ;			( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 17854                                  ;			 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 17855                                  ;		[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 17856                                  ;			(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 17857                                  ;		[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file created
 17858                                  ;			(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 17859                                  ;		[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 17860                                  ;
 17861                                  ;	EXIT	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 17862                                  ;		CARRY CLEAR
 17863                                  ;		    THISSFT filled in.
 17864                                  ;			sf_mode = unchanged for FCB, sharing_compat + open_for_both
 17865                                  ;		CARRY SET
 17866                                  ;		    AX is error code
 17867                                  ;			error_path_not_found
 17868                                  ;				Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 17869                                  ;			error_bad_curr_dir
 17870                                  ;				Bad path in current directory part of path
 17871                                  ;			error_access_denied
 17872                                  ;				Attempt to re-create read only file , or
 17873                                  ;				create a second volume id or create a dir
 17874                                  ;			error_sharing_violation
 17875                                  ;				The sharing mode was correct but not allowed
 17876                                  ;				generates an INT 24
 17877                                  ;	USES	all but DS
 17878                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 17879                                  
 17880                                  	; 14/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 17881                                  	; DOSCODE:6920h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 17888                                  ;hkn; this point.

 18288                                  
 18289                                  ;	TITLE	DOS_OPEN - Internal OPEN call for MS-DOS
 18290                                  ;	NAME	DOS_OPEN
 18291                                  
 18292                                  ;**	OPEN.ASM - File Open
 18293                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18294                                  ;	Low level routines for openning a file from a file spec.
 18295                                  ;	Also misc routines for sharing errors
 18296                                  ;
 18297                                  ;	DOS_Open
 18298                                  ;	Check_Access_AX
 18299                                  ;	SHARE_ERROR
 18300                                  ;	SET_SFT_MODE
 18301                                  ;	Code_Page_Mismatched_Error		   ; DOS 4.00
 18302                                  ;
 18303                                  ;	Revision history:
 18304                                  ;
 18305                                  ;	    Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 18306                                  ;	    A000	version 4.00   Jan. 1988
 18307                                  ;
 18308                                  ;	M034 - The value in save_bx must be pushed on to the stack for
 18309                                  ; 	       remote extended opens and not save_cx.
 18310                                  ;
 18311                                  ;	M035 - if open made from exec then we must set the appropriate bits
 18312                                  ;	       on the stack before calling off to the redir.
 18313                                  ;	M042 - Bit 11 of DOS34_FLAG set indicates that the redir knows how 
 18314                                  ;	       to handle open from exec. In this case set the appropriate bit
 18315                                  ;	       else do not.
 18316                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------	
 18317                                  
 18318                                  ;Installed = TRUE
 18319                                  
 18320                                  ;	i_need	NoSetDir,BYTE
 18321                                  ;	i_need	THISSFT,DWORD
 18322                                  ;	i_need	THISCDS,DWORD
 18323                                  ;	i_need	CURBUF,DWORD
 18324                                  ;	i_need	CurrentPDB,WORD
 18325                                  ;	i_need	CURR_DIR_END,WORD
 18326                                  ;	I_need	RetryCount,WORD
 18327                                  ;	I_need	Open_Access,BYTE
 18328                                  ;	I_need	fSharing,BYTE
 18329                                  ;	i_need	JShare,DWORD
 18330                                  ;	I_need	FastOpenFlg,byte
 18331                                  ;	I_need	EXTOPEN_ON,BYTE 		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18332                                  ;	I_need	ALLOWED,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18333                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18334                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_LOCUS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18335                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_ACTION,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18336                                  ;	I_need	EXTERR_CLASS,BYTE		  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18337                                  ;	I_need	CPSWFLAG,BYTE			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18338                                  ;	I_need	EXITHOLD,DWORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18339                                  ;	I_need	THISDPB,DWORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18340                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_CX,WORD			  ;AN000;; DOS 4.00
 18341                                  ;	I_need	SAVE_BX,WORD			  ;M034
 18342                                  ;
 18343                                  ;	I_need	DOS_FLAG,BYTE
 18344                                  ;	I_need	DOS34_FLAG,WORD			  ;M042
 18345                                  
 18346                                  ;Break	<DOS_Open - internal file access>
 18347                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18348                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_Open
 18349                                  ;
 18350                                  ; Inputs:
 18351                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 18352                                  ;		terminated)
 18353                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 18354                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 18355                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 18356                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 18357                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 18358                                  ;	[THISSFT] Points to SFT to fill in if file found
 18359                                  ;		(sf_mode field set so that FCB may be detected)
 18360                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 18361                                  ;	AX is Access and Sharing mode
 18362                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 18363                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 18364                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 18365                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 18366                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 18367                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 18368                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 18369                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 18370                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 18371                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 18372                                  ;
 18373                                  ;	  For FCB SFTs AL should = sharing_compat + open_for_both
 18374                                  ;		(not checked)
 18375                                  ; Function:
 18376                                  ;	Try to open the specified file
 18377                                  ; Outputs:
 18378                                  ;	sf_ref_count is NOT altered
 18379                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 18380                                  ;	    THISSFT filled in.
 18381                                  ;	CARRY SET
 18382                                  ;	    AX is error code
 18383                                  ;		error_file_not_found
 18384                                  ;			Last element of path not found
 18385                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 18386                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 18387                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 18388                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 18389                                  ;		error_invalid_access

 18749                                  OpenShareRetry:
 18750 00002BDA 51                      	push	cx			; Save number left to do
 18751 00002BDB E85D45                  	call	SHARE_CHECK		; Final Check
 18752 00002BDE 59                      	pop	cx			; CX = # left

 18756                                  OpenShareFail:

 18766                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18767                                  ; Procedure Name : Check_Access
 18768                                  ;
 18769                                  ; Inputs:
 18770                                  ;	AX is mode
 18771                                  ;	  High NIBBLE of AL (Sharing Mode)
 18772                                  ;		sharing_compat	   file is opened in compatibility mode
 18773                                  ;		sharing_deny_none  file is opened Multi reader, Multi writer
 18774                                  ;		sharing_deny_read  file is opened Only reader, Multi writer
 18775                                  ;		sharing_deny_write file is opened Multi reader, Only writer
 18776                                  ;		sharing_deny_both  file is opened Only reader, Only writer
 18777                                  ;	  Low NIBBLE of AL (Access Mode)
 18778                                  ;		open_for_read	file is opened for reading
 18779                                  ;		open_for_write	file is opened for writing
 18780                                  ;		open_for_both	file is opened for both reading and writing.
 18781                                  ; Function:
 18782                                  ;	Check this access mode for correctness
 18783                                  ; Outputs:
 18784                                  ;	[open_access] = AL input
 18785                                  ;	Carry Clear
 18786                                  ;		Mode is correct
 18787                                  ;		AX unchanged
 18788                                  ;	Carry Set
 18789                                  ;		Mode is bad
 18790                                  ;		AX = error_invalid_access
 18791                                  ; No other registers effected
 18792                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18793                                  
 18794                                  Check_Access_AX:
 18795 00002BF2 A2[6E05]                	MOV	[OPEN_ACCESS],AL
 18796 00002BF5 53                      	PUSH	BX
 18797                                  
 18798                                  ;	If sharing, then test for special sharing mode for FCBs
 18799                                  
 18800 00002BF6 88C3                    	MOV	BL,AL
 18801 00002BF8 80E3F0                  	AND	BL,SHARING_MASK ; 0F0h
 18802 00002BFB 803E[7205]FF            	CMP	byte [FSHARING],-1
 18803 00002C00 7505                    	JNZ	short CheckShareMode	; not through server call, must be ok
 18804 00002C02 80FB70                  	CMP	BL,SHARING_NET_FCB
 18805 00002C05 7405                    	JZ	short CheckAccessMode	; yes, we have an FCB
 18806                                  CheckShareMode:
 18807 00002C07 80FB40                  	CMP	BL,40h			; is this a good sharing mode?
 18808 00002C0A 770B                    	JA	short Make_Bad_Access
 18809                                  CheckAccessMode:
 18810 00002C0C 88C3                    	MOV	BL,AL
 18811 00002C0E 80E30F                  	AND	BL,access_mask
 18812                                  	; 04/02/2026
 18813                                  	;CMP	BL,2
 18814                                  	;JA	short Make_Bad_Access
 18815                                  	;POP	BX
 18816                                  	;CLC
 18817                                  	;retn
 18818                                  	; 04/02/2026
 18819 00002C11 80FB03                  	cmp	bl,3
 18820 00002C14 F5                      	cmc
 18821                                  	; if bl>2 -> cf=1
 18822 00002C15 7303                    	jnc	short CheckAccessMode_OK
 18823                                  
 18824                                  Make_Bad_Access:
 18825 00002C17 B80C00                  	MOV	AX,error_invalid_access ; 0Ch
 18826                                  	; 04/02/2026
 18827                                  CheckAccessMode_OK:
 18828 00002C1A 5B                      	POP	BX
 18829                                  	;STC
 18830 00002C1B C3                      	retn

 18835                                  ; 08/08/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 18836                                  ; 18/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 18837                                  
 18838                                  ;**	Low level routine for returning disk drive information from a local
 18839                                  ;	  or NET device
 18840                                  ;
 18841                                  ;	DISK_INFO
 18842                                  ;
 18843                                  ;	  Modification history:
 18844                                  ;
 18845                                  ;		Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 18846                                  
 18847                                  ;	Break	<DISK_INFO -- Get Disk Drive Information>
 18848                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18849                                  ; Procedure Name : DISK_INFO
 18850                                  ;
 18851                                  ; Inputs:
 18852                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to the Macro List Structure of interest
 18853                                  ;		(It MAY NOT be NUL, error not detected)
 18854                                  ; Function:
 18855                                  ;	Get Interesting Drive Information
 18856                                  ; Returns:
 18857                                  ;	DX = Number of free allocation units
 18858                                  ;	BX = Total Number of allocation units on disk
 18859                                  ;	CX = Sector size
 18860                                  ;	AL = Sectors per allocation unit
 18861                                  ;	AH = FAT ID BYTE

 18966                                  ;**	Low level routines for doing local and NET directory searches
 18967                                  ;

 18980                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 18981                                  ;
 18982                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_SEARCH_FIRST
 18983                                  ;
 18984                                  ; Inputs:
 18985                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 18986                                  ;		terminated)
 18987                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 18988                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 18989                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 18990                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 18991                                  ;		(Low word = -1 if NUL CDS (Net direct request))
 18992                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 18993                                  ;	[DMAADD] Points to 53 byte buffer
 18994                                  ; Function:
 18995                                  ;	Initiate a search for the given file spec
 18996                                  ; Outputs:
 18997                                  ;	CARRY CLEAR
 18998                                  ;	    The 53 bytes ot DMAADD are filled in as follows:
 18999                                  ;
 19000                                  ;	LOCAL
 19001                                  ;	    Drive Byte (A=1, B=2, ...) High bit clear
 19002                                  ;		NEVER STORE DRIVE BYTE AFTER  found_it
 19003                                  ;	    11 byte search name with Meta chars in it
 19004                                  ;	    Search Attribute Byte, attribute of search
 19005                                  ;	    WORD LastEnt value
 19006                                  ;	    WORD DirStart
 19007                                  ;	    4 byte pad
 19008                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 19009                                  ;	NET
 19010                                  ;	    21 bytes First byte has high bit set
 19011                                  ;	    32 bytes of the directory entry found
 19012                                  ;
 19013                                  ;	CARRY SET
 19014                                  ;	    AX = error code
 19015                                  ;		error_no_more_files
 19016                                  ;			No match for this file
 19017                                  ;		error_path_not_found
 19018                                  ;			Bad path (not in curr dir part if present)
 19019                                  ;		error_bad_curr_dir
 19020                                  ;			Bad path in current directory part of path
 19021                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 19022                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19023                                  
 19024                                  ; 24/01/2024

 19426                                  ;**
 19427                                  ;
 19428                                  ; Internal Abort call closes all handles and FCBs associated with a process.
 19429                                  ;  If process has NET resources a close all is sent out over the net.
 19430                                  ;
 19431                                  ;   DOS_ABORT
 19432                                  ;
 19433                                  ;   Modification history:
 19434                                  ;
 19435                                  ;       Created: ARR 30 March 1983
 19436                                  ;
 19437                                  ;	M038	SR	10/16/90	Free SFT with the PSP of the process
 19438                                  ;				being terminated only if it is busy.
 19439                                  ;
 19440                                  
 19441                                  ;Break   <DOS_ABORT -- CLOSE all files for process>
 19442                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19443                                  ;
 19444                                  ; Procedure Name : DOS_ABORT
 19445                                  ;
 19446                                  ; Inputs:
 19447                                  ;       [CurrentPDB] set to PID of process aborting
 19448                                  ; Function:
 19449                                  ;       Close all files and free all SFTs for this PID
 19450                                  ; Returns:
 19451                                  ;       None
 19452                                  ; All destroyed except stack
 19453                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 19454                                  
 19455                                  DOS_ABORT:
 19456 00002DFD 368E06[3003]            	MOV     ES,[SS:CurrentPDB]	; SS override
 19457 00002E02 268B0E3200              	MOV     CX,[ES:PDB.JFN_Length]  ; Number of JFNs
 19458                                  reset_free_jfn:
 19459 00002E07 89CB                    	MOV     BX,CX
 19460 00002E09 51                      	PUSH    CX
 19461 00002E0A 4B                      	DEC     BX                      ; get jfn (start with last one)
 19462                                  
 19463 00002E0B E84C37                  	CALL	_$CLOSE
 19464 00002E0E 59                      	POP     CX
 19465 00002E0F E2F6                    	LOOP    reset_free_jfn          ; and do 'em all
 19466                                  
 19467                                  ; Note: We do need to explicitly close FCBs. Reasons are as follows: If we
 19468                                  ; are running in the no-sharing no-network environment, we are simulating the
 19469                                  ; 2.0 world and thus if the user doesn't close the file, that is his problem
 19470                                  ; BUT... the cache remains in a state with garbage that may be reused by the
 19471                                  ; next process. We scan the set and blast the ref counts of the FCBs we own.
 19472                                  ;
 19473                                  ; If sharing is loaded, then the following call to close process will
 19474                                  ; correctly close all FCBs. We will then need to walk the list AFTER here.
 19475                                  ;
 19476                                  ; Finally, the following call to NET_Abort will cause an EOP to be sent to all
 19477                                  ; known network resources. These resources are then responsible for cleaning
 19478                                  ; up after this process.
 19479                                  ;
 19480                                  ; Sleazy, eh?
 19481                                  
 19482                                  	;context DS			; SS is DOSDATA
 19483 00002E11 16                      	push	ss
 19484 00002E12 1F                      	pop	ds  ; 09/09/2018
 19485                                  
 19486                                  	;CallInstall Net_Abort, MultNET, 29
 19487 00002E13 B81D11                  	mov	ax,111Dh
 19488 00002E16 CD2F                    	int     2Fh 	; Multiplex - NETWORK REDIRECTOR 
 19489                                  			;	    - CLOSE ALL REMOTE FILES FOR PROCESS
 19490                                  			; DS???, SS = DOS CS
 19491                                  ;if installed
 19492 00002E18 FF1E[A000]              	call	far [JShare+(4*4)]	; 4 = MFTCloseP
 19493                                  ;else
 19494                                  ;	call 	MFTCloseP
 19495                                  ;endif
 19496                                  
 19497                                  ; Scan the FCB cache for guys that belong to this process and zap their ref
 19498                                  ; counts.
 19499                                  					; SS override
 19500 00002E1C 36C43E[4000]            	les     di,[ss:SFTFCB]		; grab the pointer to the table
 19501                                  	;mov	cx,[es:di+4]
 19502 00002E21 268B4D04                	mov     cx,[es:di+SFT.SFCount]
 19503 00002E25 E317                    	jcxz    FCBScanDone
 19504                                  	;lea	di,[di+6]
 19505 00002E27 8D7D06                  	LEA     DI,[DI+SFT.SFTable]	; point at table
 19506 00002E2A 36A1[3C03]              	mov     ax,[SS:PROC_ID]		; SS override
 19507                                  FCBTest:
 19508                                  	;cmp	[es:di+31h],ax
 19509 00002E2E 26394531                	cmp	[es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax ; is this one of ours
 19510 00002E32 7505                    	jnz	short FCBNext		; no, skip it
 19511 00002E34 26C7050000              	mov	word [es:di],0
 19512                                  	;mov	word [es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],0  ; yes, blast ref count
 19513                                  FCBNext:
 19514 00002E39 83C73B                  	add     di,SF_ENTRY.size ; 59 (for MSDOS 6.0)
 19515 00002E3C E2F0                    	loop    FCBTest
 19516                                  FCBScanDone:
 19517                                  
 19518                                  ; Walk the SFT to eliminate all busy SFT's for this process.
 19519                                  
 19520 00002E3E 31DB                    	XOR     BX,BX
 19521                                  Scan:
 19522 00002E40 53                      	push    bx
 19523 00002E41 E89236                  	call	SFFromSFN
 19524 00002E44 5B                      	pop     bx
 19525                                  	;jnc	short Scan1
 19526                                  	;retn
 19527                                  
 19528                                  	; 18/12/2022
 19529                                  	;jc	short NO_Question ; retn
 19530                                  	; 03/02/2024
 19531 00002E45 7234                    	jc	short RET2
 19532                                  
 19533                                  ;M038
 19534                                  ; Do what the comment above says, check for busy state
 19535                                  
 19536                                  Scan1:
 19537                                  	;cmp	word [es:di],0
 19538                                  	;jz	short scan_next  ; MSDOS 3.3
 19539                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 19540 00002E47 26833DFF                	cmp	word [es:di],sf_busy ; -1
 19541                                  	;cmp	word [es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],sf_busy
 19542                                  				; Is Sft busy? ;M038
 19543 00002E4B 7519                    	jnz	short scan_next
 19544                                  ;
 19545                                  ; we have a SFT that is busy. See if it is for the current process
 19546                                  ;
 19547 00002E4D 36A1[3C03]              	mov     ax,[SS:PROC_ID]		; SS override
 19548                                  	;cmp	[es:di+31h],ax
 19549 00002E51 26394531                	cmp	[es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_PID],ax
 19550 00002E55 750F                    	jnz	short scan_next
 19551 00002E57 36A1[3E03]              	mov     ax,[SS:USER_ID]		; SS override
 19552                                  	;cmp	[es:di+2Fh],ax
 19553 00002E5B 2639452F                	cmp	[es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_UID],ax
 19554 00002E5F 7505                    	jnz	short scan_next
 19555                                  
 19556                                  ; This SFT is labelled as ours.
 19557                                  
 19558 00002E61 26C7050000              	mov	word [es:di],0
 19559                                  	;mov	word [es:di+SF_ENTRY.sf_ref_count],0
 19560                                  scan_next:
 19561 00002E66 43                      	inc     bx
 19562 00002E67 EBD7                    	jmp     short Scan

 20766                                  ;

 21716                                  ;Break	<DIRREAD -- READ A DIRECTORY SECTOR>
 21717                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21718                                  ;
 21719                                  ; Procedure Name : DIRREAD
 21720                                  ;
 21721                                  ; Inputs:
 21722                                  ;	AX = Directory block number (relative to first block of directory)
 21723                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 21724                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = First sector of first cluster of directory
 21725                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster
 21726                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 21727                                  ; Function:
 21728                                  ;	Read the directory block into [CURBUF].
 21729                                  ; Outputs:
 21730                                  ;	[NXTCLUSNUM] = Next cluster (after the one skipped to)
 21731                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] Set
 21732                                  ;	ES:BP unchanged
 21733                                  ;	[CURBUF] Points to Buffer with dir sector
 21734                                  ;	Carry set if error (user said FAIL to I 24)
 21735                                  ; DS preserved, all other registers destroyed.
 21736                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 21737                                  
 21738                                  ;hkn; called from dir.asm. DS already set up to DOSDATA.
 21739                                  
 21740                                  DIRREAD:
 21741                                  
 21742                                  ; Note that ClusFac is the sectors per cluster. This is NOT necessarily
 21743                                  ; the same as what is in the DPB! In the case of the root directory, we have
 21744                                  ; ClusFac = # sectors in the root directory. The root directory is detected
 21745                                  ; by DIRStart = 0.

 21747 00003567 31D2                    	XOR	DX,DX

 21755                                  ; Convert the sector number in AX into cluster and sector-within-cluster pair
 21756

 21769                                  ;	(AX) = number of clusters to skip

 21777                                  ;	(AH) = remainder

 22067                                  ;
 22068                                  ; Procedure Name : DSKREAD
 22069                                  ;
 22070                                  ; Inputs:
 22071                                  ;	DS:BX = Transfer addr
 22072                                  ;	CX = Number of sectors
 22073                                  ;	[HIGH_SECTOR] = Absolute record number (HIGH)
 22074                                  ;	DX = Absolute record number	       (LOW)
 22075                                  ;	ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 22076                                  ; Function:
 22077                                  ;	Call BIOS to perform disk read
 22078                                  ; Outputs:
 22079                                  ;	DI = CX on entry
 22080                                  ;	CX = Number of sectors unsuccessfully transfered
 22081                                  ;	AX = Status word as returned by BIOS (error code in AL if error)

 22085                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------

 22921                                  ;
 22922                                  ; Procedure Name : DskRdBufScan
 22923                                  ;
 22924                                  ; Inputs:
 22925                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors read. (These constitute a block of
 22926                                  ;            sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 22927                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.

 22929                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 22930                                  ;
 22931                                  ; Function:
 22932                                  ;	The Buffer Queue is scanned: the contents of any dirty buffers are
 22933                                  ;	"read" into the transfer memory block, so that the transfer memory
 22934                                  ;	reflects the most recent data.

 22937                                  ;       Transfer memory updated as required.

 22939                                  ; Uses:

 22944                                  ;       FIRST_BUFF_ADDR is set-up to contain the LAST buffer to check, rather
 22945                                  ;	than the FIRST.

 23830                                  ;Break   <DskWrtBufPurge -- Disk Write Buffer Purge>
 23831                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23832                                  ;
 23833                                  ; Procedure Name : DskWrtBufPurge
 23834                                  ;
 23835                                  ; Inputs:
 23836                                  ;       CX = # of contiguous sectors to write. (These constitute a block of
 23837                                  ;	     sectors, also termed an "Extent".)
 23838                                  ;       [HIGH_SECTOR]:DX = physical sector # of first sector in extent.
 23839                                  ;       ES:BP -> Drive Parameter Block (DPB).
 23840                                  ;
 23841                                  ; Function:
 23842                                  ;       Purge the Buffer Queue and the Secondary Cache of any buffers which
 23843                                  ;	are in Extent; they are being over-written.
 23844                                  ;
 23845                                  ; Outputs:
 23846                                  ;       (Same as Input.)
 23847                                  ; Uses:
 23848                                  ;       All registers except DS,AX,SI,DI preserved.
 23849                                  ;       SS override for all global variables.
 23850                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23851                                  ;M039: Created
 23852                                  
 23853                                  ;procedure   DskWrtBufPurge,NEAR
 23854                                  ;
 23855                                  ;ASSUME  DS:NOTHING
 23856                                  
 23857                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 23858                                  ; DOSCODE:7C0Eh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 23859                                  
 23860                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 23861                                  ; DOSCODE:7BD4h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 23862                                  
 23863                                  DskWrtBufPurge:
 23864                                  	;SaveReg <bx,cx>
 23865 00003B91 53                      	push	bx
 23866 00003B92 51                      	push	cx
 23867                                  
 23868 00003B93 368B1E[0706]            	mov	bx,[ss:HIGH_SECTOR]	;BX:DX = Extent start (sector #).
 23869 00003B98 89DE                    	mov	si,bx
 23870 00003B9A 01D1                    	add	cx,dx
 23871 00003B9C 83D600                  	adc	si,0                    ;SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 23872                                  
 23873                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 23874                                  	;;mov	al,[es:bp+0]
 23875                                  	;mov	al,[es:bp+DPB.DRIVE]
 23876                                  	; 15/12/2022
 23877 00003B9F 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 23878                                  
 23879                                  ;	BX:DX = Extent start.
 23880                                  ;	SI:CX = Extent end + 1.
 23881                                  ;	AL = Drive #
 23882                                  
 23883 00003BA3 36833E[7700]00          	cmp	word [ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT],0 ;Secondary cache in-use?
 23884 00003BA9 7431                    	je	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 23885                                  
 23886                                  ;	If any of the sectors to be written are in the secondary cache (SC),
 23887                                  ;	invalidate the entire SC. (This is an optimization; we really only
 23888                                  ;	need to invalidate those sectors which intersect, but that's slower.)
 23889                                  
 23890 00003BAB 363A06[B00D]            	cmp	al,[ss:CurSC_DRIVE]	;Same drive?
 23891 00003BB0 752A                    	jne	short nosc		; -no, jump.
 23892                                  
 23893 00003BB2 50                      	push    ax
 23894 00003BB3 36A1[B10D]              	mov     ax,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR]
 23895 00003BB7 368B3E[B30D]            	mov     di,[ss:CurSC_SECTOR+2]	;DI:AX = SC start.
 23896                                  
 23897                                  	;Cmp32	si,cx,di,ax		;Extent end < SC start?
 23898                                  	;jbe	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 23899                                  
 23900 00003BBC 39FE                    	cmp	si,di
 23901 00003BBE 7502                    	jne	short sc01
 23902 00003BC0 39C1                    	cmp	cx,ax
 23903                                  sc01: 
 23904 00003BC2 7617                    	jbe	short sc5
 23905                                  
 23906 00003BC4 360306[7700]            	add	ax,[ss:SC_CACHE_COUNT]
 23907 00003BC9 83D700                  	adc	di,0                    ;DI:AX = SC end + 1.
 23908                                  	
 23909                                  	;Cmp32	bx,dx,di,ax             ;Extent start > SC end?
 23910                                  	;jae	short sc5		; -yes, jump.
 23911                                  
 23912 00003BCC 39FB                    	cmp	bx,di
 23913 00003BCE 7502                    	jne	short sc02
 23914 00003BD0 39C2                    	cmp	dx,ax
 23915                                  sc02:
 23916 00003BD2 7307                    	jnb	short sc5
 23917                                  
 23918 00003BD4 36C706[B50D]0000        	mov	word [ss:SC_STATUS],0	;Extent intersects SC: invalidate SC.
 23919                                  sc5:	
 23920 00003BDB 58                      	pop     ax
 23921                                  
 23922                                  ;	Free any buffered sectors which are in Extent; they are being over-
 23923                                  ;	written.
 23924                                  
 23925                                  nosc:	
 23926 00003BDC E85B1B                  	call	GETCURHEAD		;DS:DI -> first buffer in queue.
 23927                                  
 23928                                  _bufq:	
 23929                                  	;cmpo	al,[di+4]
 23930 00003BDF 3A4504                  	cmp     al,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID] ;Same drive?
 23931 00003BE2 7527                    	jne	short bufq5		; -no, jump.
 23932                                  
 23933                                  ;       Cmp32   bx,dx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 23934                                  ;       ja	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent start > buffer sector.
 23935                                  
 23936                                  	;cmp	bx,[di+8]
 23937 00003BE4 3B5D08                  	cmp	bx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 23938 00003BE7 7503                    	jne	short bufq04
 23939                                  	;cmp	dx,[di+6]
 23940 00003BE9 3B5506                  	cmp	dx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 23941                                  bufq04:
 23942 00003BEC 771D                    	ja	short bufq5
 23943                                  
 23944                                  ;       Cmp32   si,cx,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector+2]>,<WORD PTR [di.buf_sector]>
 23945                                  ;       jbe	short bufq5		;Jump if Extent end < buffer sector.
 23946                                  
 23947                                  	;cmp	si,[di+8]
 23948 00003BEE 3B7508                  	cmp	si,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector+2]
 23949 00003BF1 7503                    	jne	short bufq05
 23950                                  	;cmp	cx,[di+6]
 23951 00003BF3 3B4D06                  	cmp	cx,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_sector]
 23952                                  bufq05:
 23953 00003BF6 7613                    	jbe	short bufq5
 23954                                  
 23955                                  ;	Buffer's sector is in Extent, so free it; it is being over-written.
 23956                                  
 23957                                  	;test	byte [di+5],40h
 23958 00003BF8 F6450540                	test	byte [di+BUFFINFO.buf_flags],buf_dirty ;Buffer dirty?
 23959 00003BFC 7403                    	jz	short bufq4		; -no, jump.
 23960 00003BFE E8C31D                  	call	DEC_DIRTY_COUNT		; -yes, decrement dirty count.
 23961                                  bufq4:
 23962                                  	;mov	word [di+4],20FFh
 23963 00003C01 C74504FF20              	mov     word [di+BUFFINFO.buf_ID],((buf_visit<<8)|0FFh)
 23964                                  
 23965 00003C06 E8431B                  	call	SCANPLACE
 23966 00003C09 EB02                    	jmp     short bufq6
 23967                                  bufq5: 
 23968 00003C0B 8B3D                    	mov     di,[di]
 23969                                  	;mov	di,[di+BUFFINFO.buf_next]
 23970                                  bufq6: 
 23971 00003C0D 363B3E[BB0E]            	cmp	di,[ss:FIRST_BUFF_ADDR]	;Scanned entire buffer queue?
 23972 00003C12 75CB                    	jne	short _bufq		; --no, go do next buffer.
 23973                                  	
 23974                                  	;RestoreReg <cx,bx>
 23975 00003C14 59                      	pop	cx
 23976 00003C15 5B                      	pop	bx
 23977 00003C16 C3                      	retn

 23981                                  ;Break   <DIV32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT DIVIDE>
 23982                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23983                                  ;
 23984                                  ; Procedure Name : DIV32
 23985                                  ;
 23986                                  ; Inputs:
 23987                                  ;       DX:AX = 32 bit dividend   BX= divisor
 23988                                  ; Function:
 23989                                  ;       Perform 32 bit division:  DX:AX/BX = CX:AX + DX (rem.)
 23990                                  ; Outputs:
 23991                                  ;       CX:AX = quotient , DX= remainder
 23992                                  ; Uses:
 23993                                  ;       All registers except AX,CX,DX preserved.
 23994                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 23995                                  ;M039: DIV32 optimized for divisor of 512 (common sector size).
 23996                                  
 23997                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 23998                                  ; DOSCODE:7C94h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 23999                                  
 24000                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24001                                  ; DOSCODE:7C5Ah (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 24002                                  
 24003                                  DIV32:
 24004 00003C17 81FB0002                	cmp	bx,512
 24005 00003C1B 7515                    	jne	short div5
 24006                                  
 24007 00003C1D 89D1                    	mov	cx,dx
 24008 00003C1F 89C2                    	mov	dx,ax           ; CX:AX = Dividend
 24009 00003C21 81E2FF01                	and	dx,(512-1)      ; DX = Remainder
 24010 00003C25 88E0                    	mov	al,ah
 24011 00003C27 88CC                    	mov	ah,cl
 24012 00003C29 88E9                    	mov	cl,ch
 24013 00003C2B 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch
 24014 00003C2D D1E9                    	shr	cx,1
 24015 00003C2F D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1
 24016 00003C31 C3                      	retn
 24017                                  div5:	
 24018 00003C32 89C1                    	mov	cx,ax
 24019 00003C34 89D0                    	mov	ax,dx
 24020 00003C36 31D2                    	xor	dx,dx
 24021 00003C38 F7F3                    	div	bx              ; 0:AX/BX
 24022 00003C3A 91                      	xchg	cx,ax
 24023 00003C3B F7F3                    	div	bx              ; DX:AX/BX
 24024 00003C3D C3                      	retn
 24025                                  
 24026                                  ;Break   <SHR32 -- PERFORM 32 BIT SHIFT RIGHT>
 24027                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24028                                  ;
 24029                                  ; Procedure Name : SHR32
 24030                                  ;
 24031                                  ; Inputs:
 24032                                  ;	DX:AX = 32 bit sector number
 24033                                  ; Function:
 24034                                  ;       Perform 32 bit shift right
 24035                                  ; Outputs:
 24036                                  ;	AX = cluster number
 24037                                  ;	ZF = 1 if no error
 24038                                  ;	   = 0 if error (cluster number > 64k)
 24039                                  ; Uses:
 24040                                  ;       DX,CX
 24041                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24042                                  ; M017	- SHR32 rewritten for better performance
 24043                                  ; M039	- Additional optimization
 24044                                  
 24045                                  ; 04/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 24046                                  ; DOSCODE:7CBBh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 24047                                  ; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24048                                  ; DOSCODE:7C81h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 24049                                  SHR32:
 24050                                  	;mov	cl,[es:bp+5]
 24051 00003C3E 268A4E05                	mov	cl,[ES:BP+DPB.CLUSTER_SHIFT]
 24052 00003C42 30ED                    	xor	ch,ch	    ;ZF=1
 24053 00003C44 E306                    	jcxz	norota
 24054                                  
 24055                                  rotashft2:
 24056 00003C46 D1EA                    	shr	dx,1	    ;ZF reflects state of DX.
 24057 00003C48 D1D8                    	rcr	ax,1	    ;ZF not affected.
 24058 00003C4A E2FA                    	loop	rotashft2
 24059                                  norota:
 24060 00003C4C C3                      	retn
