 24072                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24073                                  ;
 24074                                  ; Procedure Name : FINDENTRY,SEARCH
 24075                                  ;
 24076                                  ; Inputs:
 24077                                  ;	[THISDPB] set
 24078                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 24079                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Starting directory sector number
 24080                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Next cluster of directory
 24081                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors/Cluster
 24082                                  ;	[NAME1] = Name to look for
 24083                                  ; Function:
 24084                                  ;	Find file name in disk directory.
 24085                                  ;	"?" matches any character.
 24086                                  ; Outputs:
 24087                                  ;	Carry set if name not found
 24088                                  ;	ELSE
 24089                                  ;	Zero set if attributes match (always except when creating)
 24090                                  ;	AH = Device ID (bit 7 set if not disk)
 24091                                  ;	[THISDPB] = Base of drive parameters
 24092                                  ;	DS = DOSGROUP
 24093                                  ;	ES = DOSGROUP
 24094                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:BX = Pointer into directory buffer
 24095                                  ;	[CURBUF+2]:SI = Pointer to First Cluster field in directory entry
 24096                                  ;	[CURBUF] has directory record with match
 24097                                  ;	[NAME1] has file name
 24098                                  ;	[LASTENT] is entry number of the entry
 24099                                  ; All other registers destroyed.
 24100                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24101                                  
 24102                                  ;hkn; called from rename.asm and dir2.asm. DS must be already set up at
 24103                                  ;hkn; this point.
 24104                                  
 24105                                  SEARCH:
 24106                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24107                                  	; DOSCODE:7C90h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS) 
 24108                                  
 24109                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 24110                                  	; DOSCODE:7CCA (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 24111                                  
 24112                                  	; 27/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 24113                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3) - Offset 45B3h 
 24114                                  	; 15/03/2018 - Retro DOS v2.0
 24115                                  
 24116                                  	; 24/01/2024
 24117                                  
 24118                                  	;entry	FindEntry
 24119                                  FINDENTRY:
 24120 00003C4D E80C04                  	call	STARTSRCH
 24121 00003C50 A0[6B05]                	MOV	AL,[ATTRIB]

 24584                                  ;	TITLE	DIR2 - Directory and path cracking
 24585                                  ;	NAME	Dir2
 24586                                  
 24587                                  ;Break	<GETPATH -- PARSE A WFP>
 24588                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24589                                  ;
 24590                                  ; Procedure Name : GETPATH
 24591                                  ;
 24592                                  ; Inputs:
 24593                                  ;	[WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:\" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 24594                                  ;		terminated; d:/ (note forward slash) indicates a real device).
 24595                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 24596                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 24597                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 24598                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 24599                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Is attribute of search, determines what files can be found
 24600                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 24601                                  ;	[THISDPB] set to DPB if disk otherwise garbage.
 24602                                  ; Function:
 24603                                  ;	Crack the path
 24604                                  ; Outputs:
 24605                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk if disk file
 24606                                  ;	Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Unk if char device
 24607                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 24608                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 24609                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 24610                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 24611                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 24612                                  ;	   Zero set
 24613                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 24614                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 24615                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 24616                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 24617                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 24618                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 24619                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 24620                                  ;	   Zero reset
 24621                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path or attribute mismatch
 24622                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 24623                                  ;	ELSE
 24624                                  ;	   [CurBuf] = -1 if root directory
 24625                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 24626                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 24627                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points into [CURBUF] to dir_first field for entry
 24628                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 24629                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 24630                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 24631                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 24632                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 24633                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 24634                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 24635                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it.

 24900                                  ;Break	<ROOTPATH, FINDPATH -- PARSE A PATH>
 24901                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24902                                  ;
 24903                                  ; Procedure Name : ROOTPATH,FINDPATH
 24904                                  ;
 24905                                  ; Inputs:
 24906                                  ;	Same as FINDPATH but,
 24907                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path which is assumed to start at
 24908                                  ;		the root (no leading '/').
 24909                                  ; Function:
 24910                                  ;	Search from root for path
 24911                                  ; Outputs:
 24912                                  ;	Same as FINDPATH but:
 24913                                  ;	If root directory specified, [CURBUF] and [NAME1] are NOT set, and
 24914                                  ;	[NoSetDir] is ignored.
 24915                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 24916                                  
 24917                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24918                                  	; DOSCODE:7F47h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 24919                                  
 24920                                  ROOTPATH:
 24921 00003ECE E8F1FE                  	call	SETROOTSRCH
 24922 00003ED1 803C00                  	CMP	BYTE [SI],0
 24923 00003ED4 7509                    	JNZ	short FINDPATH
 24924                                  
 24925                                  ; Root dir specified
 24926 00003ED6 A0[6D05]                	MOV	AL,[SATTRIB]
 24927 00003ED9 A2[6B05]                	MOV	[ATTRIB],AL
 24928 00003EDC 30E4                    	XOR	AH,AH			; Sets "device ID" byte, sets zero
 24929                                  					; (dir), clears carry.
 24930 00003EDE C3                      	retn
 24931                                  
 24932                                  ; Inputs:
 24933                                  ;	[ATTRIB] Set to get through directories
 24934                                  ;	[SATTRIB] Set to find last element
 24935                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 24936                                  ;	SI Points to asciz string of path (no leading '/').
 24937                                  ;	[SECCLUSPOS] = 0
 24938                                  ;	[DIRSEC] = Phys sec # of first sector of directory
 24939                                  ;	[CLUSNUM] = Cluster # of next cluster
 24940                                  ;	[CLUSFAC] = Sectors per cluster
 24941                                  ;	[NoSetDir] set
 24942                                  ;	[CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 24943                                  ;		( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 24944                                  ;		 Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 24945                                  ;	[THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 24946                                  ;	[CREATING] and [DELALL] set
 24947                                  ; Function:
 24948                                  ;	Parse path name
 24949                                  ; Outputs:
 24950                                  ;	ID1 field of [THISCDS] updated appropriately
 24951                                  ;	[ATTRIB] = [SATTRIB]
 24952                                  ;	ES:BP Points to DPB
 24953                                  ;	[THISDPB] = ES:BP
 24954                                  ;	Carry set if bad path
 24955                                  ;	   SI Points to path element causing failure
 24956                                  ;	   Zero set
 24957                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC] are set up to
 24958                                  ;	      start a search on the last directory
 24959                                  ;	      CL is zero if there is a bad name in the path
 24960                                  ;	      CL is non-zero if the name was simply not found
 24961                                  ;		 [ENTFREE] may have free spot in directory
 24962                                  ;		 [NAME1] is the name.
 24963                                  ;		 CL = 81H if '*'s or '?' in NAME1, 80H otherwise
 24964                                  ;	   Zero reset
 24965                                  ;	      File in middle of path or bad name in path
 24966                                  ;		or path too long or malformed path
 24967                                  ;	ELSE
 24968                                  ;	   [CURBUF] contains directory record with match
 24969                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:BX Points into [CURBUF] to start of entry
 24970                                  ;	   [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to fcb_FIRCLUS field for entry
 24971                                  ;	   [NAME1] Has name looked for
 24972                                  ;	   AH = device ID
 24973                                  ;	      bit 7 of AH set if device SI and BX
 24974                                  ;	      will point DOSGROUP relative The firclus
 24975                                  ;	      field of the device entry contains the device pointer
 24976                                  ;	   If last element is a directory zero is set and:
 24977                                  ;	      [DIRSTART],[SECCLUSPOS],[DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM], and [CLUSFAC]
 24978                                  ;	      are set up to start a search on it,
 24979                                  ;	      unless [NoSetDir] is non zero in which case the return is
 24980                                  ;	      like that for a file (except for zero flag)
 24981                                  ;	   If last element is a file zero is reset
 24982                                  ;	      [DIRSEC],[CLUSNUM],[CLUSFAC],[NXTCLUSNUM],[SECCLUSPOS],
 24983                                  ;	      [LASTENT], [ENTLAST] are set to continue search of last
 24984                                  ;	      directory for furthur matches on NAME1 via the NEXTENT
 24985                                  ;	      entry point in FindEntry (or GETENT entry in GETENTRY in
 24986                                  ;	      which case [NXTCLUSNUM] and [SECCLUSPOS] need not be valid)
 24987                                  ; Destroys all other registers
 24988                                  
 24989                                  	; 21/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 24990                                  	; DOSCODE:7F58h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 24991                                  
 24992                                      	;entry	FINDPATH
 24993                                  FINDPATH:
 24994 00003EDF 06                      	PUSH	ES			; Save ES:BP
 24995 00003EE0 56                      	PUSH	SI
 24996 00003EE1 89F7                    	MOV	DI,SI
 24997 00003EE3 8B0E[C205]              	MOV	CX,[DIRSTART]		; Get start clus of dir being searched
 24998 00003EE7 833E[B605]FF            	CMP	word [CURR_DIR_END],-1
 24999 00003EEC 740E                    	JZ	short NOIDS		; No current dir part
 25000 00003EEE 3B3E[B605]              	CMP	DI,[CURR_DIR_END]
 25001 00003EF2 7508                    	JNZ	short NOIDS		; Not to current dir end yet

 25005                                  NOIDS:
 25006                                  
 25007                                  ; Parse the name off of DS:SI into NAME1. AL = 1 if there was a meta
 25008                                  ; character in the string. CX,DI may be destroyed.
 25009                                  ;
 25010                                  ;	invoke	NAMETRANS
 25011                                  ;	MOV	CL,AL
 25012                                  ;
 25013                                  ; The above is the slow method. The name has *already* been munged by
 25014                                  ; TransPath so no special casing needs to be done. All we do is try to copy
 25015                                  ; the name until ., \ or 0 is hit.
 25016

 25018                                  	;MOV	ES,AX

 25028 00003F06 AB                      	STOSW

 25034 00003F0A BF[4B05]                	MOV	DI,NAME1
 25035 00003F0D 30E4                    	XOR	AH,AH			; bits for CL
 25036                                  GetNam:
 25037                                  	; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 25038                                  	;INC	CL ; ?*! ; MSDOS 6.0	;AN000; KK increment volid count
 25039                                  
 25040                                  	; 21/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 25041                                  	; 16/12/2022
 25042                                  	;inc	cl ; not required !
 25043                                  	
 25044 00003F0F AC                      	LODSB
 25045 00003F10 3C2E                    	CMP	AL,'.'	; 2Eh
 25046 00003F12 7412                    	JZ	short _SetExt
 25047 00003F14 08C0                    	OR	AL,AL
 25048 00003F16 7424                    	JZ	short _GetDone
 25049 00003F18 3C5C                    	CMP	AL,'\'	; 5Ch
 25050 00003F1A 7420                    	JZ	short _GetDone

 25077 00003F44 39FE                    	CMP	SI,DI

 25080                                  check_device:

 25083                                  	; 15/02/2024

 25087 00003F4E 7508                    	JNZ	short NOT_LAST

 25090

 25092 00003F54 883E[6B05]              	MOV	[ATTRIB],BH
 25093                                  
 25094                                  NOT_LAST:
 25095                                  
 25096                                  ; check name1 to see if we have a device...
 25097                                  
 25098 00003F58 06                      	PUSH	ES			; Save ES:BP
 25099                                  
 25100                                  ;hkn; SS is DOSDATA
 25101                                  	;context ES
 25102 00003F59 16                      	push	ss

 25735                                  ;Break	<CheckThisDevice - Check for being a device>
 25736                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 25737                                  ;
 25738                                  ;   CheckThisDevice - Examine the area at DS:SI to see if there is a valid
 25739                                  ;   device specified. We will return carry if there is a device present. 
 25740                                  ;   The forms of devices we will recognize are:
 25741                                  ;
 25742                                  ;	[path]device
 25743                                  ;
 25744                                  ;   Note that the drive letter has *already* been removed. All other forms
 25745                                  ;   are not considered to be devices. If such a device is found we change
 25746                                  ;   the source pointer to point to the device component.
 25747                                  ;
 25748                                  ;   Inputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 25749                                  ;		DS:SI contains name
 25750                                  ;   Outputs:	ES is DOSDATA
 25751                                  ;		DS:SI point to name or device
 25752                                  ;		Carry flag set if device was found
 25753                                  ;		Carry flag reset otherwise
 25754                                  ;   Registers Modified: all except ES:DI, DS
 25755                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 25756                                  
 25757                                  CheckThisDevice:
 25758 000041C0 57                      	push	di
 25759 000041C1 56                      	push	si
 25760 000041C2 89F7                    	MOV	DI,SI
 25761                                  
 25762                                  ; Check for presence of \dev\ (Dam multiplan!)
 25763                                  
 25764 000041C4 8A04                    	MOV	AL,[SI]
 25765 000041C6 E8450D                  	call	PATHCHRCMP		; is it a path char?
 25766 000041C9 7517                    	JNZ	short ParseDev		; no, go attempt to parse device
 25767 000041CB 46                      	INC	SI			; simulate LODSB
 25768                                  
 25769                                  ; We have the leading path separator. Look for DEV part.
 25770                                  
 25771 000041CC AD                      	LODSW
 25772 000041CD 0D2020                  	OR	AX,2020h
 25773 000041D0 3D6465                  	cmp	ax,"de"
 25774                                  	;CMP	AX,"e"<< 8 + "d"
 25775 000041D3 752D                    	JNZ	short NotDevice		; not "de", assume not device
 25776 000041D5 AC                      	LODSB
 25777 000041D6 0C20                    	OR	AL,20h
 25778 000041D8 3C76                    	CMP	AL,"v"                  ; Not "v", assume not device
 25779 000041DA 7526                    	JNZ	short NotDevice
 25780 000041DC AC                      	LODSB
 25781 000041DD E82E0D                  	call	PATHCHRCMP		; do we have the last path separator?
 25782 000041E0 7520                    	JNZ	short NotDevice		; no. go for it.
 25783                                  
 25784                                  ; DS:SI now points to a potential drive. Preserve them as NameTrans advances
 25785                                  ; SI and DevName may destroy DS.
 25786                                  
 25787                                  ParseDev:
 25788 000041E2 1E                      	push	ds
 25789 000041E3 56                      	push	si			; preserve the source pointer
 25790 000041E4 E8690C                  	call	NameTrans		; advance DS:SI
 25791 000041E7 803C00                  	CMP	BYTE [SI],0		; parse entire string?
 25792 000041EA F9                      	STC				; simulate a Carry return from DevName
 25793 000041EB 750B                    	JNZ	short SkipSearch	; no parse. simulate a file return.
 25794                                  
 25795                                  ;hkn; SS is DOSDATA
 25796 000041ED 16                      	push	ss
 25797 000041EE 1F                      	pop	ds
 25798                                  
 25799                                  ; M026 - start - fix ported from ROMDOS2 for bug # 2849
 25800                                  ;
 25801                                  ; SR;
 25802                                  ; We have to set Attrib before invoking DevName. Otherwise, the value from
 25803                                  ; a previous DOS call is used and DevName thinks it is not a device if the
 25804                                  ; old call set the volume attribute bit.
 25805                                  
 25806 000041EF A0[6D05]                	mov	al,[SATTRIB]
 25807 000041F2 A2[6B05]                	mov	[ATTRIB],al		;set Attrib for DevName
 25808                                  
 25809                                  ; M026 - end
 25810                                  
 25811 000041F5 E885FE                  	call	DEVNAME
 25812                                  
 25813                                  SkipSearch:
 25814 000041F8 5E                      	pop	si
 25815 000041F9 1F                      	pop	ds
 25816                                  
 25817                                  ; SI points to the beginning of the potential device. If we have a device
 25818                                  ; then we do not change SI. If we have a file, then we reset SI back to the
 25819                                  ; original value. At this point Carry set indicates FILE.
 25820                                  
 25821                                  CheckReturn:
 25822 000041FA 5F                      	pop	di			; get original SI
 25823 000041FB 7302                    	JNC	short Check_Done	; if device then do not reset pointer
 25824 000041FD 89FE                    	MOV	SI,DI
 25825                                  Check_Done:
 25826 000041FF 5F                      	pop	di
 25827 00004200 F5                      	CMC				; invert carry. Carry => device
 25828 00004201 C3                      	retn
 25829                                  NotDevice:
 25830 00004202 F9                      	STC
 25831 00004203 EBF5                    	JMP	short CheckReturn

 26137                                  ; Procedure Name : IOFUNC
 26138                                  ;
 26139                                  ; Inputs:
 26140                                  ;	DS:SI Points to SFT
 26141                                  ;	AH is function code
 26142                                  ;		= 0 Input
 26143                                  ;		= 1 Input Status
 26144                                  ;		= 2 Output
 26145                                  ;		= 3 Output Status

 26151                                  ;	Perform indicated I/O to device or file
 26152                                  ; Outputs:
 26153                                  ;	AL is character if input
 26154                                  ;	If a status call
 26155                                  ;		zero set if not ready
 26156                                  ;		zero reset if ready (character in AL for input status)
 26157                                  ; For regular files:
 26158                                  ;	Input Status

 26160                                  ;		Zero set on EOF

 26163                                  ;		Returns ^Z on EOF

 27368                                  ;Break   <MAKENODE -- CREATE A NEW NODE>
 27369                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27370                                  ;
 27371                                  ; Procedure Name : MakeNode
 27372                                  ;
 27373                                  ; Inputs:
 27374                                  ;       AL - attribute to create
 27375                                  ;       AH = 0 if it is ok to truncate a file already by this name
 27376                                  ;	AH != 0 if truncation not allowed (prexisting file is an error)
 27377                                  ;               (AH ignored on dirs and devices)
 27378                                  ;
 27379                                  ;        NOTE: When making a DIR or volume ID, AH need not be set since
 27380                                  ;               a name already existant is ALWAYS an error in these cases.
 27381                                  ;
 27382                                  ;       [WFP_START] Points to WFP string ("d:/" must be first 3 chars, NUL
 27383                                  ;               terminated)
 27384                                  ;       [CURR_DIR_END] Points to end of Current dir part of string
 27385                                  ;               ( = -1 if current dir not involved, else
 27386                                  ;                Points to first char after last "/" of current dir part)
 27387                                  ;       [THISCDS] Points to CDS being used
 27388                                  ;       [THISSFT] Points to an empty SFT. EXCEPT sf_mode filled in.
 27389                                  ; Function:
 27390                                  ;       Make a new node
 27391                                  ; Outputs:
 27392                                  ;       Sets EXTERR_LOCUS = errLOC_Disk or errLOC_Unk via GetPathNoset
 27393                                  ;       CARRY SET IF ERROR
 27394                                  ;          AX = 1 A node by this name exists and is a directory
 27395                                  ;          AX = 2 A new node could not be created
 27396                                  ;          AX = 3 A node by this name exists and is a disk file
 27397                                  ;               (AH was NZ on input)
 27398                                  ;          AX = 4 Bad Path
 27399                                  ;               SI return from GetPath maintained
 27400                                  ;          AX = 5 Attribute mismatch
 27401                                  ;          AX = 6 Sharing Violation
 27402                                  ;               (INT 24 generated ALWAYS since create is always compat mode
 27403                                  ;          AX = 7 file not found for Extended Open (not exists and fails)
 27404                                  ;       ELSE
 27405                                  ;          AX = 0 Disk Node
 27406                                  ;          AX = 3 Device Node (error in some cases)
 27407                                  ;          [DIRSTART],[DIRSEC],[CLUSFAC],[CLUSNUM] set to directory
 27408                                  ;               containing new node.
 27409                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:BX Points to entry
 27410                                  ;          [CURBUF+2]:SI Points to entry.dir_first
 27411                                  ;          [THISSFT] is filled in
 27412                                  ;               sf_mode = unchanged.
 27413                                  ;          Attribute byte in entry is input AL
 27414                                  ; DS preserved, others destroyed
 27415                                  ;
 27416                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------

 27418                                  ; 19/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0

 27608                                  ; We have found an existing file. We have also entered it into the share set.
 27609                                  ; At this point we need to call newentry to correctly address the problem of
 27610                                  ; getting rid of old data (create an existing file) or creating a new
 27611                                  ; directory entry (create a new file). Unfortunately, this operation may
 27612                                  ; result in an INT 24 that the user doesn't return from, thus locking the file
 27613                                  ; irretrievably into the share set. The correct solution is for us to LEAVE
 27614                                  ; the share set now, do the operation and then reassert the share access.
 27615                                  ;
 27616                                  ; We are allowed to do this! There is no window! After all, we are in
 27617                                  ; critDisk here and for someone else to get in, they must enter critDisk also.
 27618

 27620                                  	; DOSCODE:89C8h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 27666                                  ;
 27667                                  ; Procedure Name : NEWENTRY
 27668                                  ;
 27669                                  ; Inputs:
 27670                                  ;	  [THISSFT] set
 27671                                  ;	  [THISDPB] set
 27672                                  ;	  [LASTENT] current last valid entry number in directory if no free
 27673                                  ;		  entries
 27674                                  ;	  [VOLID] set if a volume ID was found during search
 27675                                  ;	Attrib Contains attributes for new file
 27676                                  ;	  [DIRSTART] Points to first cluster of dir (0 means root)
 27677                                  ;	  CARRY FLAG INDICATES STATUS OF SEARCH FOR FILE
 27678                                  ;		  NC means file existed (device)
 27679                                  ;		  C  means file did not exist
 27680                                  ;	  AH = Device ID byte
 27681                                  ;	  If FILE
 27682                                  ;	  [CURBUF+2]:BX points to start of directory entry
 27683                                  ;	  [CURBUF+2]:SI points to dir_first of directory entry
 27684                                  ;	  If device
 27685                                  ;	  DS:BX points to start of "fake" directory entry
 27686                                  ;	  DS:SI points to dir_first of "fake" directory entry
 27687                                  ;		  (has DWORD pointer to device header)
 27688                                  ; Function:
 27689                                  ;	  Make a new directory entry
 27690                                  ;	  If an old one existed it is truncated first
 27691                                  ; Outputs:
 27692                                  ;	  Carry set if error
 27693                                  ;		  Can't grow dir, atts didn't match, attempt to make 2nd
 27694                                  ;		  vol ID, user FAILed to I 24
 27695                                  ;	  else
 27696                                  ;		  outputs of DOOPEN
 27697                                  ; DS, BX, SI preserved (meaning on SI BX, not value), others destroyed
 27698                                  ;
 27699                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 27700                                  
 27701                                  	; 22/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 27702                                  	; DOSCODE:89F9h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)

 27837                                  ; DOOPEN
 27838                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 28144                                  ;
 28145                                  ; Procedure Name : CHECK_VIRT_OPEN
 28146                                  ;
 28147                                  ; CHECK_VIRT_OPEN checks to see if we had performed a "virtual open" (by
 28148                                  ; examining the flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN] to see if it is 1). If we did, then
 28149                                  ; it calls Dev_Close_SFT to decrement the ref. count. It also resets the
 28150                                  ; flag [VIRTUAL_OPEN].
 28151                                  ; No registers affected (including flags).
 28152                                  ; On input, [THISSFT] points to current SFT.
 28153                                  ;
 28154                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28155                                  
 28156                                  CHECK_VIRT_OPEN:
 28157 00004AB0 50                      	PUSH	AX
 28158 00004AB1 9F                      	lahf			; preserve flags
 28159 00004AB2 803E[A20A]00            	CMP	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0
 28160 00004AB7 7410                    	JZ	short ALL_CLOSED
 28161 00004AB9 C606[A20A]00            	mov	byte [VIRTUAL_OPEN],0 ; reset flag
 28162 00004ABE 06                      	push	es
 28163 00004ABF 57                      	push	di
 28164 00004AC0 C43E[9E05]              	LES	DI,[THISSFT]
 28165 00004AC4 E8C9F9                  	call	DEV_CLOSE_SFT
 28166 00004AC7 5F                      	pop	di
 28167 00004AC8 07                      	pop	es
 28168                                  
 28169                                  ALL_CLOSED:
 28170 00004AC9 9E                      	sahf			; restore flags
 28171 00004ACA 58                      	POP	AX
 28172 00004ACB C3                      	retn

 28291                                  ;Break  <BUFSEC -- BUFFER A SECTOR AND SET UP A TRANSFER>
 28292                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28293                                  ;
 28294                                  ; Procedure Name : BUFSEC
 28295                                  ;
 28296                                  ; Inputs:
 28297                                  ;       AH = priority of buffer
 28298                                  ;       AL = 0 if buffer must be read, 1 if no pre-read needed
 28299                                  ;       ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 28300                                  ;       [CLUSNUM] = Physical cluster number
 28301                                  ;       [SECCLUSPOS] = Sector position of transfer within cluster
 28302                                  ;       [BYTCNT1] = Size of transfer
 28303                                  ; Function:
 28304                                  ;       Insure specified sector is in buffer, flushing buffer before
 28305                                  ;       read if necessary.
 28306                                  ; Outputs:
 28307                                  ;       ES:DI = Pointer to buffer
 28308                                  ;       SI = Pointer to transfer address
 28309                                  ;       CX = Number of bytes
 28310                                  ;       [NEXTADD] updated
 28311                                  ;       [TRANS] set to indicate a transfer will occur
 28312                                  ;       Carry set if error (user FAILed to I 24)
 28313                                  ;--------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28314                                  
 28315                                  BUFSEC:
 28316 00004B0A 8B16[BC05]              	MOV	DX,[CLUSNUM]
 28317 00004B0E 8A1E[7305]              	MOV	BL,[SECCLUSPOS]
 28318                                  	;mov	byte [ALLOWED],38h

 28767                                  ; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 
 28768                                  
 28769                                  ;Break   <ALLOCATE -- Assign disk space>
 28770                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 28771                                  ;
 28772                                  ; Procedure Name : ALLOCATE - Allocate Disk Space
 28773                                  ;
 28774                                  ;   ALLOCATE is called to allocate disk clusters. The new clusters are
 28775                                  ;   FAT-chained onto the end of the existing file.
 28776                                  ;
 28777                                  ;   The DPB contains the cluster # of the last free cluster allocated
 28778                                  ;   (dpb_next_free). We start at this cluster and scan towards higher
 28779                                  ;   numbered clusters, looking for the necessary free blocks.
 28780                                  ;
 28781                                  ;   Once again, fancy terminology gets in the way of correct coding. When
 28782                                  ;   using next_free, start scanning AT THAT POINT and not the one following it.
 28783                                  ;   This fixes the boundary condition bug when only free = next_free = 2.
 28784                                  ;
 28785                                  ;       If we get to the end of the disk without satisfaction:
 28786                                  ;
 28787                                  ;           if (dpb_next_free == 2) then we've scanned the whole disk.
 28788                                  ;               return (insufficient_disk_space)
 28789                                  ;           ELSE
 28790                                  ;               dpb_next_free = 2; start scan over from the beginning.
 28791                                  ;
 28792                                  ;   Note that there is no multitasking interlock. There is no race when
 28793                                  ;   examining the entrys in an in-core FAT block since there will be no
 28794                                  ;   context switch. When UNPACK context switches while waiting for a FAT read
 28795                                  ;   we are done with any in-core FAT blocks, so again there is no race. The
 28796                                  ;   only special concern is that V2 and V3 MSDOS left the last allocated
 28797                                  ;   cluster as "00"; marking it EOF only when the entire alloc request was
 28798                                  ;   satisfied. We can't allow another activation to think this cluster is
 28799                                  ;   free, so we give it a special temporary mark to show that it is, indeed,
 28800                                  ;   allocated.
 28801                                  ;
 28802                                  ;   Note that when we run out of space this algorithem will scan from
 28803                                  ;   dpb_next_free to the end, then scan from cluster 2 through the end,
 28804                                  ;   redundantly scanning the later part of the disk. This only happens when
 28805                                  ;   we run out of space, so sue me.
 28806                                  ;
 28807                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 28808                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 28809                                  ;                                                                          ;
 28810                                  ;   The use of FATBYT and RESTFATBYT is somewhat mysterious. Here is the
 28811                                  ;   explanation:
 28812                                  ;
 28813                                  ;   In the NUL file case (sf_firclus currently 0) ALLOCATE is called with
 28814                                  ;   entry BX = 0. What needs to be done in this case is to stuff the cluster
 28815                                  ;   number of the first cluster allocated in sf_firclus when the ALLOCATE is
 28816                                  ;   complete. THIS VALUE IS SAVED TEMPORARILY IN CLUSTER 0, HENCE THE CURRENT
 28817                                  ;   VALUE IN CLUSTER 0 MUST BE SAVED AND RESTORED. This is a side effect of
 28818                                  ;   the fact that PACK and UNPACK don't treat requests for clusters 0 and 1 as
 28819                                  ;   errors. This "stuff" is done by the call to PACK which is right before
 28820                                  ;   the
 28821                                  ;           LOOP   findfre         ; alloc more if needed
 28822                                  ;   instruction when the first cluster is allocated to the nul file. The
 28823                                  ;   value is recalled from cluster 0 and stored at sf_firclus at ads4:
 28824                                  ;
 28825                                  ;   This method is obviously useless (because it is non-reentrant) for
 28826                                  ;   multitasking, and will have to be changed. Storing the required value on
 28827                                  ;   the stack is recommended. Setting sf_firclus at the PACK of cluster 0
 28828                                  ;   (instead of actually doing the PACK) is BAD because it doesn't handle
 28829                                  ;   problems with INT 24 well.
 28830                                  ;
 28831                                  ;            C  A  V  E  A  T     P  A  T  T  E  R  S  O  N                ;
 28832                                  ;----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----+----;
 28833                                  ;                                                                          ;
 28834                                  ;       ENTRY   BX = Last cluster of file (0 if null file)
 28835                                  ;               CX = No. of clusters to allocate
 28836                                  ;               ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 28837                                  ;               [THISSFT] = Points to SFT
 28838                                  ;
 28839                                  ;       EXIT    'C' set if insufficient space
 28840                                  ;                 [FAILERR] can be tested to see the reason for failure
 28841                                  ;                 CX = max. no. of clusters that could be added to file
 28842                                  ;               'C' clear if space allocated
 28843                                  ;                 BX = First cluster allocated
 28844                                  ;                 FAT is fully updated
 28845                                  ;                 sf_FIRCLUS field of SFT set if file was null
 28846                                  ;
 28847                                  ;       USES    ALL but SI, BP
 28848                                  
 28849                                  ;callmagic  proc near
 28850                                  ;       push    ds                             ;push segment of routine 
 28851                                  ;       push    Offset MagicPatch              ;push offset for routine
 28852                                  ;       retf                                   ;simulate jmp far
 28853                                  ;                                              ;far return address is on
 28854                                  ;                                              ;stack, so far return from
 28855                                  ;                                              ;call will return this routine
 28856                                  ;callmagic  endp
 28857                                  
 28858                                  ALLOCATE:
 28859                                  	; 10/09/2018
 28860                                  ;BEGIN MAGICDRV MODIFICATIONS
 28861                                  ;
 28862                                  ;7/5/92 scottq
 28863                                  ;
 28864                                  ;This is the disk compression patch location which allows
 28865                                  ;the disk compression software to fail allocations if the
 28866                                  ;FAT would allows allocation, but the free space for compressed
 28867                                  ;data would not.
 28868                                  ;        
 28869                                  ;;;	call    far ptr MAGICPATCH
 28870                                  ;;; We cannot do a far call since we cannot have fix-ups[romdos,hidos],
 28871                                  ;;; but we do know the segment and offset of the routine
 28872                                  ;;; so simulate a far call to dosdata:magicpatch
 28873                                  ;;; note dosassume above, so DS -> dosdata
 28874                                  
 28875                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 28876                                          ;clc				;clear carry so we fall through
 28877                                  	;				;if no patch is present
 28878                                  	;push	cs			;push segment for far return
 28879                                          ;call	callmagic		;this is a near call
 28880                                          ;jnc	short Regular_Allocate_Path
 28881                                  	;jmp	Disk_Full_Return
 28882                                  
 28883                                  ;Regular_Allocate_Path:
 28884                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 28885                                  ;END MAGICDRV MODIFICATIONS
 28886                                  
 28887                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 28888                                  	; DOSCODE:8D87h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 28889                                  
 28890 00004C8D 53                              PUSH    BX                      ; save (bx)
 28891 00004C8E 31DB                            XOR     BX,BX
 28892 00004C90 E81507                  	call	UNPACK
 28893 00004C93 893E[9605]                      MOV     [FATBYT],DI             ; save correct cluster 0 value
 28894 00004C97 5B                              POP     BX
 28895 00004C98 72F2                            jc	short figrec_retn	; abort if error   [INTERR?]
 28896                                  
 28897 00004C9A 51                              PUSH    CX
 28898 00004C9B 53                              PUSH    BX
 28899                                  
 28900 00004C9C 89DA                            MOV     DX,BX
 28901                                  	;;mov	bx,[es:bp+1Ch]  ; MSDOS 3.3
 28902                                  	;mov	bx,[es:bp+1Dh]	; MSDOS 6.0
 28903 00004C9E 268B5E1D                        mov     bx,[ES:BP+DPB.NEXT_FREE]
 28904 00004CA2 83FB02                          cmp     bx,2
 28905 00004CA5 7709                            ja	short FINDFRE
 28906                                  
 28907                                  ;   couldn't find enough free space beyond dpb_next_free, or dpb_next_free is
 28908                                  ;   <2 or >dpb_max_clus. Reset it and restart the scan
 28909                                  
 28910                                  ads1:
 28911                                  	;;mov	word [es:bp+1Ch],2 ; MSDOS 3.3
 28912                                  	;mov	word [es:bp+1Dh],2 ; MSDOS 6.0
 28913 00004CA7 26C7461D0200                    mov     word [ES:BP+DPB.NEXT_FREE],2
 28914 00004CAD BB0100                          mov     bx,1                    ; Counter next instruction so first
 28915                                                                          ;       cluster examined is 2
 28916                                  
 28917                                  ;   Scanning both forwards and backwards for a free cluster
 28918                                  ;
 28919                                  ;       (BX) = forwards scan pointer
 28920                                  ;       (CX) = clusters remaining to be allocated
 28921                                  ;       (DX) = current last cluster in file
 28922                                  ;       (TOS) = last cluster of file
 28923                                  
 28924                                  FINDFRE:
 28925 00004CB0 43                              INC     BX
 28926                                  	;cmp	bx,[es:bp+0Dh]
 28927 00004CB1 263B5E0D                        CMP	BX,[ES:BP+DPB.MAX_CLUSTER]
 28928 00004CB5 7757                    	ja	short ads7	; at end of disk
 28929 00004CB7 E8EE06                          call	UNPACK          ; check out this cluster
 28930 00004CBA 722F                            jc	short ads4	; FAT error             [INTERR?]
 28931 00004CBC 75F2                            jnz	short FINDFRE	; not free, keep on truckin
 28932                                  
 28933                                  ;   Have found a free cluster. Chain it to the file
 28934                                  ;
 28935                                  ;       (BX) = found free cluster #
 28936                                  ;       (DX) = current last cluster in file
 28937                                  
 28938                                  	;;mov	[es:bp+1Ch],bx
 28939                                  	;mov	[es:bp+1Dh],bx ; MSDOS 6.0
 28940 00004CBE 26895E1D                        mov	[ES:BP+DPB.NEXT_FREE],bx ; next time start search here
 28941 00004CC2 92                              xchg    ax,dx           ; save (dx) in ax
 28942 00004CC3 BA0100                          mov     dx,1            ; mark this free guy as "1"
 28943 00004CC6 E83307                  	call	PACK            ; set special "temporary" mark
 28944 00004CC9 7220                            jc	short ads4	; FAT error             [INTERR?]
 28945                                  	;;cmp	word [es:bp+1Eh],-1
 28946                                          ;cmp	word [es:bp+1Fh],-1 ; MSDOS 6.0
 28947 00004CCB 26837E1FFF              	CMP	word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT],-1 ; Free count valid?
 28948 00004CD0 7404                            JZ	short NO_ALLOC	; No
 28949                                  	;;dec	word [es:bp+1Eh]
 28950                                          ;dec	word [es:bp+1Fh] ; MSDOS 6.0
 28951 00004CD2 26FF4E1F                        DEC     word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT] ; Reduce free count by 1
 28952                                  NO_ALLOC:
 28953 00004CD6 92                              xchg    ax,dx           ; (dx) = current last cluster in file
 28954 00004CD7 87DA                            XCHG    BX,DX
 28955 00004CD9 89D0                            MOV     AX,DX
 28956 00004CDB E81E07                  	call	PACK            ; link free cluster onto file
 28957                                                                  ;  CAVEAT.. On Nul file, first pass stuffs
 28958                                                                  ;    cluster 0 with FIRCLUS value.
 28959 00004CDE 720B                            jc	short ads4	; FAT error [INTERR?]
 28960 00004CE0 93                              xchg    BX,AX           ; (BX) = last one we looked at
 28961 00004CE1 89DA                            mov     dx,bx           ; (dx) = current end of file
 28962 00004CE3 E2CB                            LOOP    FINDFRE         ; alloc more if needed
 28963                                  
 28964                                  ;   We've successfully extended the file. Clean up and exit
 28965                                  ;
 28966                                  ;       (BX) = last cluster in file
 28967                                  
 28968 00004CE5 BAFFFF                          MOV     DX,0FFFFH
 28969 00004CE8 E81107                  	call	PACK            ; mark last cluster EOF
 28970                                  
 28971                                  ;   Note that FAT errors jump here to clean the stack and exit. This saves us
 28972                                  ;   2 whole bytes. Hope its worth it...
 28973                                  ;
 28974                                  ;       'C' set if error
 28975                                  ;       calling (BX) and (CX) pushed on stack
 28976                                  
 28977                                  ads4:   
 28978 00004CEB 5B                      	POP     BX
 28979 00004CEC 59                              POP     CX              ; Don't need this stuff since we're successful
 28980 00004CED 729D                            jc	short figrec_retn
 28981 00004CEF E8B606                          call	UNPACK          ; Get first cluster allocated for return
 28982                                                                  ; CAVEAT... In nul file case, UNPACKs cluster 0.
 28983 00004CF2 7298                            jc	short figrec_retn
 28984 00004CF4 E83200                  	call	RESTFATBYT      ; Restore correct cluster 0 value
 28985 00004CF7 7293                            jc	short figrec_retn
 28986 00004CF9 87DF                            XCHG    BX,DI           ; (DI) = last cluster in file upon our entry
 28987 00004CFB 09FF                            OR      DI,DI           ; clear 'C'
 28988 00004CFD 758D                    	jnz	short figrec_retn ; we were extending an existing file
 28989                                  
 28990                                  ;   We were doing the first allocation for a new file. Update the SFT cluster
 28991                                  ;   info
 28992                                  dofastk:
 28993                                  	; 20/05/2019
 28994                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 28995                                  	;push	dx ; * MSDOS 6.0
 28996                                  	;;mov	dl,[es:bp+0]
 28997                                  	;;MOV	DL,[ES:BP+DPB.DRIVE]	; get drive #
 28998                                  	;mov	dl,[es:bp]
 28999                                  
 29000                                  	; 25/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 29001                                  	; DOSCODE:8DF9h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 29002                                  	
 29003                                  	; 16/12/2022
 29004                                  	;push	dx ; *
 29005                                  	;mov	dl,[ES:BP+DPB.DRIVE] 
 29006                                  	; 15/12/2022
 29007                                  	;mov	dl,[es:bp]
 29008                                  	
 29009                                  	; MSDOS 3.3 & MSDOS 6.0
 29010 00004CFF 06                      	PUSH	ES
 29011 00004D00 C43E[9E05]              	LES     DI,[THISSFT]
 29012                                  	;mov	[es:di+0Bh],bx
 29013 00004D04 26895D0B                	MOV     [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_firclus],BX
 29014                                  	;;mov	[es:di+1Bh],bx ; MSDOS 3.3
 29015                                  	;mov	[es:di+35h],bx ; MSDOS 6.0
 29016 00004D08 26895D35                	MOV     [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_lstclus],BX
 29017 00004D0C 07                      	POP	ES
 29018                                  	;retn
 29019                                  
 29020                                  	;pop	dx ; * MSDOS 6.0
 29021                                  
 29022                                  	; 16/12/2022
 29023                                  	; 25/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 29024                                  	;pop	dx ; *
 29025                                  
 29026 00004D0D C3                      	retn	
 29027                                  
 29028                                  ;** we're at the end of the disk, and not satisfied. See if we've scanned ALL
 29029                                  ;   of the disk...
 29030                                  
 29031                                  ads7:   
 29032 00004D0E 26837E1D02              	cmp	word [ES:BP+DPB.NEXT_FREE],2
 29033 00004D13 7592                    	jnz	short ads1	; start scan from front of disk
 29034                                  
 29035                                  ;   Sorry, we've gone over the whole disk, with insufficient luck. Lets give
 29036                                  ;   the space back to the free list and tell the caller how much he could have
 29037                                  ;   had.  We have to make sure we remove the "special mark" we put on the last
 29038                                  ;   cluster we were able to allocate, so it doesn't become orphaned.
 29039                                  ;
 29040                                  ;       (CX) = clusters remaining to be allocated
 29041                                  ;       (TOS) = last cluster of file (before call to ALLOCATE)
 29042                                  ;       (TOS+1) = # of clusters wanted to allocate
 29043                                  
 29044 00004D15 5B                              POP     BX              ; (BX) = last cluster of file
 29045 00004D16 BAFFFF                          MOV     DX,0FFFFH
 29046 00004D19 E81F00                  	call	RELBLKS         ; give back any clusters just alloced
 29047 00004D1C 58                              POP     AX              ; No. of clusters requested
 29048                                                                  ; Don't "retc". We are setting Carry anyway,
 29049                                                                  ;   Alloc failed, so proceed with return CX
 29050                                                                  ;   setup.
 29051 00004D1D 29C8                            SUB     AX,CX           ; AX=No. of clusters allocated
 29052 00004D1F E80700                  	call	RESTFATBYT      ; Don't "retc". We are setting Carry anyway,
 29053                                                                  ;   Alloc failed.
 29054                                  Disk_Full_Return:               ;label added for magic patch 8-6-92 scottq
 29055                                          ; MSDOS 6.0
 29056 00004D22 C606[0B06]01            	MOV	byte [DISK_FULL],1 ;MS. indicating disk full
 29057 00004D27 F9                              STC
 29058 00004D28 C3                              retn

 29063                                  ;
 29064                                  ; SEE ALLOCATE CAVEAT
 29065                                  ;       Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)

 29074 00004D32 E8C706                  	call	PACK
 29075 00004D35 5F                              POP     DI
 29076 00004D36 5A                              POP     DX
 29077 00004D37 5B                              POP     BX

 29083                                  ;Break	<RELEASE -- DEASSIGN DISK SPACE>
 29084                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29085                                  ;
 29086                                  ; Procedure Name : RELEASE
 29087                                  ;
 29088                                  ; Inputs:
 29089                                  ;       BX = Cluster in file
 29090                                  ;       ES:BP = Base of drive parameters
 29091                                  ; Function:
 29092                                  ;       Frees cluster chain starting with [BX]
 29093                                  ;       Carry set if error (currently user FAILed to I 24)
 29094                                  ; AX,BX,DX,DI all destroyed. Other registers unchanged.
 29095                                  ;
 29096                                  ;-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29097

 29100                                  RELEASE:
 29101 00004D39 31D2                            XOR     DX,DX
 29102                                  
 29103                                  	;entry	RELBLKS
 29104                                  RELBLKS:
 29105                                  
 29106                                  ;   Enter here with DX=0FFFFH to put an end-of-file mark in the first cluster
 29107                                  ;   and free the rest in the chain.
 29108                                  
 29109 00004D3B E86A06                  	call	UNPACK
 29110 00004D3E 7224                    	jc	short RELEASE_flush
 29111 00004D40 7422                    	jz	short RELEASE_flush
 29112 00004D42 89F8                            MOV     AX,DI
 29113 00004D44 52                              PUSH    DX
 29114 00004D45 E8B406                  	call	PACK
 29115 00004D48 5A                              POP     DX
 29116 00004D49 7219                    	jc	short RELEASE_flush
 29117 00004D4B 09D2                            OR      DX,DX
 29118 00004D4D 750B                            JNZ	short NO_DEALLOC	; Was putting EOF mark
 29119                                  	;;cmp	word [es:bp+1Eh],-1 ; MSDOS 3.3
 29120                                  	;cmp	word [es:bp+1Fh],-1 ; MSDOS 6.0
 29121 00004D4F 26837E1FFF              	CMP     word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT],-1 ; Free count valid?
 29122 00004D54 7404                            JZ	short NO_DEALLOC	; No
 29123 00004D56 26FF461F                        INC	word [ES:BP+DPB.FREE_CNT] ; Increase free count by 1
 29124                                  NO_DEALLOC:

 29126 00004D5C 48                              dec     ax              ; check for "1"
 29127 00004D5D 7405                    	jz	short RELEASE_flush	; is last cluster of incomplete chain
 29128 00004D5F E82F06                  	call	IsEOF
 29129 00004D62 72D5                            JB	short RELEASE	; Carry clear if JMP not taken
 29130                                  
 29131                                  	; 16/12/2022
 29132                                  ; 25/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 29133                                  ;%if 0
 29134                                  RELEASE_flush:
 29135                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 29136 00004D64 268A4600                	mov	al,[es:bp]
 29137                                  	;MOV	AL,[ES:BP+DPB.DRIVE]
 29138 00004D68 56                      	push	si		; FLUSHBUF may trash these and we guarantee
 29139 00004D69 51                      	push	cx		;  them to be preserved.
 29140 00004D6A 06                      	push	es
 29141 00004D6B 55                      	push	bp

 29143 00004D6F 5D                      	pop	bp

 29147                                  ;%endif

 29154                                  ; Procedure Name : GETEOF
 29155                                  ;

 29255 00004DB2 91                      	XCHG	AX,CX		; Put zero in AX

 29601                                  ; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29602                                  ; DOSCODE:8FB5h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 29603                                  
 29604                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29605                                  ;
 29606                                  ; Procedure Names : GetLet, UCase, GetLet3
 29607                                  ;
 29608                                  ; These routines take a character, convert it to upper case, and check
 29609                                  ; for delimiters.  Three different entry points:
 29610                                  ;	GetLet -  DS:[SI] = character to convert
 29611                                  ;	UCase  -  AL = character to convert
 29612                                  ;	GetLet3 - AL = character
 29613                                  ;		  [BX] = translation table to use
 29614                                  ;
 29615                                  ;	Exit (in all cases) : AL = upper case character
 29616                                  ;			      CY set if char is control char other than TAB
 29617                                  ;			      ZF set if char is a delimiter
 29618                                  ;	Uses : AX, flags
 29619                                  ;
 29620                                  ; NOTE: This routine exists in a fast table lookup version, and a slow
 29621                                  ; inline version.  Return with carry set is only possible in the inline
 29622                                  ; version. The table lookup version is the one in use.
 29623                                  ;
 29624                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29625                                  
 29626                                  ; This entry point has character at [SI]
 29627                                  
 29628                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 5517h
 29629                                  GETLET:	
 29630 00004EB8 AC                      	LODSB
 29631                                  
 29632                                  ; This entry point has character in AL
 29633                                  
 29634                                  	;entry	UCase
 29635                                  UCase:	
 29636                                  	; 09/08/2018
 29637                                  	; IBMDOS.COM (MSDOS 3.3, 1987) - Offset 5518h
 29638                                  _UCase:
 29639 00004EB9 53                      	PUSH	BX
 29640 00004EBA BB[310B]                	MOV	BX,FILE_UCASE_TAB+2
 29641                                  
 29642                                  ; Convert the character in AL to upper case
 29643                                  
 29644                                  gl_0:
 29645 00004EBD 3C61                    	CMP	AL,"a"
 29646 00004EBF 7214                    	JB	short gl_2	; Already upper case, go check type
 29647 00004EC1 3C7A                    	CMP	AL,"z"
 29648 00004EC3 7702                    	JA	short gl_1
 29649 00004EC5 2C20                    	SUB	AL,20H		; Convert to upper case
 29650                                  
 29651                                  ; Map European character to upper case
 29652                                  
 29653                                  gl_1:
 29654 00004EC7 3C80                    	CMP	AL,80H
 29655 00004EC9 720A                    	JB	short gl_2	; Not EuroChar, go check type
 29656 00004ECB 2C80                    	SUB	AL,80H		; translate to upper case with this index
 29657                                  
 29658                                  	; M048 - Start 
 29659                                  	; Lantastic call Ucase thru int 2f without setting SS to DOSDATA.
 29660                                  	; So we shall set up DS and to access FILE_UCASE_TAB in BX and also 
 29661                                  	; preserve it.
 29662

 29814                                  ;
 29815                                  ;  GetCharType - return flag bits indicating character type
 29816                                  ;	Bits are defined in DOSSYM.INC. Uses lookup table
 29817                                  ;	defined above at label CharType.
 29818                                  ;
 29819                                  ;	Entry : AL = character to return type flags for
 29820                                  ;	Exit  : AL = type flags
 29821                                  ;	Uses  : AL, flags
 29822                                  ;
 29823                                  ;-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 29824                                  
 29825                                  	; 25/11/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 29826                                  
 29827                                  	; 20/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 29828                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 29829                                  GetCharType:
 29830                                  	;cmp	al,7Eh
 29831 00004EF1 3C7E                    	cmp	al,CharType_last 	; beyond end of table?
 29832 00004EF3 7316                    	jae	short gct_90		; return standard value
 29833                                  
 29834 00004EF5 53                      	push	bx
 29835 00004EF6 BB[794E]                	mov	bx,CharType		; load lookup table
 29836 00004EF9 D0E8                    	shr	al,1			; adjust for half-byte table entry size
 29837                                  	;xlat	cs:[bx] 		; get flags
 29838 00004EFB 2ED7                    	cs	xlat	
 29839 00004EFD 5B                      	pop	bx
 29840                                  
 29841                                  ; carry clear from previous shift means we want the low nibble.  Otherwise
 29842                                  ; we have to shift the flags down to the low nibble
 29843                                  
 29844 00004EFE 7308                    	jnc	short gct_80		; carry clear, no shift needed
 29845                                  
 29846 00004F00 D0E8                    	shr	al,1			; we want high nibble, shift it down
 29847 00004F02 D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29848 00004F04 D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29849 00004F06 D0E8                    	shr	al,1
 29850                                  gct_80:
 29851 00004F08 240F                    	and	al,0Fh			; clear the unused nibble
 29852 00004F0A C3                      	retn
 29853                                  gct_90:
 29854 00004F0B B00F                    	mov	al,0Fh			; set all flags
 29855 00004F0D C3                      	retn

 30293                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30294                                  ;
 30295                                  ; Procedure Name : CNTHAND ( CTRLC_C HANDLER )
 30296                                  ;
 30297                                  ; "^C" and CR/LF is printed. Then the user registers are restored and the
 30298                                  ; user CTRL-C handler is executed. At this point the top of the stack has 1)
 30299                                  ; the interrupt return address should the user CTRL-C handler wish to allow
 30300                                  ; processing to continue; 2) the original interrupt return address to the code
 30301                                  ; that performed the function call in the first place. If the user CTRL-C
 30302                                  ; handler wishes to continue, it must leave all registers unchanged and RET
 30303                                  ; (not IRET) with carry CLEAR. If carry is SET then an terminate system call
 30304                                  ; is simulated.
 30305                                  ;
 30306                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 30307

 30317 00005069 7508                    	JNZ	short around_deadlock 	; AN002;

 30945                                  ; reset_environment checks the DS value against the CurrentPDB. If they are
 30946                                  ; different, then an old-style return is performed. If they are the same,
 30947                                  ; then we release jfns and restore to parent. We still use the PDB at DS:0 as
 30948                                  ; the source of the terminate addresses.

 30950                                  ; Some subtlety: We are about to issue a bunch of calls that *may* generate
 30951                                  ; INT 24s. We *cannot* allow the user to restart the abort process; we may
 30952                                  ; end up aborting the wrong process or turn a terminate/stay/resident into a
 30953                                  ; normal abort and leave interrupt handlers around. What we do is to set a
 30954                                  ; flag that will indicate that if any abort code is seen, we just continue the
 30955                                  ; operation. In essence, we dis-allow the abort response.

 31200                                  ;Break <IsEOF - check the quantity in BX for EOF>
 31201                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 31202                                  ;
 31203                                  ; Procedure Name : IsEOF
 31204                                  ;
 31205                                  ; IsEOF - check the fat value in BX for eof.
 31206                                  ;
 31207                                  ;   Inputs:	ES:BP point to DPB
 31208                                  ;		BX has fat value
 31209                                  ;   Outputs:	JAE eof
 31210                                  ;   Registers modified: none
 31211                                  ;
