 38207                                  ;BREAK <$AssignOper -- Set up a Macro>
 38208                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38209                                  ; Inputs:
 38210                                  ;	AL = 00 get assign mode 		    (ReturnMode)
 38211                                  ;	AL = 01 set assign mode 		    (SetMode)
 38212                                  ;	AL = 02 get attach list entry		    (GetAsgList)
 38213                                  ;	AL = 03 Define Macro (attch start)
 38214                                  ;	    BL = Macro type
 38215                                  ;	       = 0 alias
 38216                                  ;	       = 1 file/device
 38217                                  ;	       = 2 drive
 38218                                  ;	       = 3 Char device -> network
 38219                                  ;	       = 4 File device -> network
 38220                                  ;	    DS:SI -> ASCIZ source name
 38221                                  ;	    ES:DI -> ASCIZ destination name
 38222                                  ;	AL = 04 Cancel Macro
 38223                                  ;	    DS:SI -> ASCIZ source name
 38224                                  ;	AL = 05 Modified get attach list entry
 38225                                  ;	AL = 06 Get ifsfunc item
 38226                                  ;	AL = 07 set in_use of a drive's CDS
 38227                                  ;	     DL = drive number, 0=default  0=A,,
 38228                                  ;	AL = 08 reset in_use of a drive's CDS
 38229                                  ;	     DL = drive number, 0=A, 1=B,,,
 38230                                  ; Function:
 38231                                  ;	Do macro stuff
 38232                                  ; Returns:
 38233                                  ;	Std Xenix style error return
 38234                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38235                                  
 38236                                  	; 02/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 38237                                  	; 21/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 38238                                  _$AssignOper:
 38239                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 38240 000067C6 3C07                    	CMP	AL,7			      ; set in_use ?		;AN000;

 38242                                  srinuse:								;AN000;
 38243 000067CA 50                      	PUSH	AX			      ; save al 		;AN000;
 38244 000067CB 88D0                    	MOV	AL,DL			      ; AL= drive id		;AN000;
 38245 000067CD E85401                  	CALL	GetCDSFromDrv		      ; ds:si -> cds		;AN000;
 38246 000067D0 58                      	POP	AX			      ; 			;AN000;
 38247 000067D1 7216                    	JC	short baddrv		      ; bad drive		;AN000;
 38248                                  	;cmp	word [si+45h],0

 38687                                  ;BREAK <TransFCB - convert an FCB into a path, doing substitution>
 38688                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38689                                  ;   TransFCB - Copy an FCB from DS:DX into a reserved area doing all of the
 38690                                  ;       gritty substitution.
 38691                                  ;
 38692                                  ;   Inputs:     DS:DX - pointer to FCB
 38693                                  ;               ES:DI - point to destination
 38694                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry Set - invalid path in final map
 38695                                  ;               Carry Clear - FCB has been mapped into ES:DI
 38696                                  ;                   Sattrib is set from possibly extended FCB
 38697                                  ;                   ExtFCB set if extended FCB found
 38698                                  ;   Registers modified: most
 38699                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38700                                  
 38701                                  	; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 38702                                  TransFCB:
 38703                                  	; 22/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 38704                                  	; 12/07/2018 - Retro DOS v3.0
 38705                                  	;LocalVar FCBTmp,16
 38706                                  	;ENTER
 38707 00006944 55                      	push	bp
 38708 00006945 89E5                    	mov	bp,sp
 38709                                  	;sub	sp,15	; MSDOS 3.3
 38710 00006947 83EC10                  	sub	sp,16	; MSDOS 6.0
 38711 0000694A 16                      	push	ss
 38712 0000694B 07                      	pop	es
 38713 0000694C 06                      	push	es
 38714 0000694D 57                      	push	di
 38715                                  	;lea	di,[bp-15] ; MSDOS 3.3
 38716                                  	;LEA	DI,FCBTmp 
 38717 0000694E 8D7EF0                  	lea	di,[bp-16]		; point to FCB temp area
 38718 00006951 36C606[6C05]00          	mov	byte [SS:EXTFCB],0	; no extended FCB found ;smr;SS Override
 38719 00006957 36C606[6D05]00          	mov	byte [SS:SATTRIB],0	; default search attributes;smr;SS Override
 38720 0000695D E8BEB2                  	call	GetExtended             ; get FCB, extended or not
 38721                                  	; 06/12/2022
 38722 00006960 740D                    	jz	short GetDrive		; not an extended FCB, get drive
 38723 00006962 8A44FF                  	mov	AL,[SI-1]               ; get attributes
 38724 00006965 36A2[6D05]              	mov	[SS:SATTRIB],AL		; store search attributes;smr;SS Override
 38725 00006969 36C606[6C05]FF          	mov	byte [SS:EXTFCB],-1	; signal extended FCB  ;smr;SS Override
 38726                                  GetDrive:
 38727 0000696F AC                      	lodsb				; get drive byte
 38728 00006970 E85CFF                  	call	GETTHISDRV
 38729 00006973 722A                    	jc	short BadPack
 38730 00006975 E86F03                  	call	TextFromDrive           ; convert 0-based drive to text
 38731                                  
 38732                                  ; Scan the source to see if there are any illegal chars
 38733                                  
 38734                                  	;mov	bx,CharType		; load lookup table
 38735 00006978 B90B00                  	mov	cx,11
 38736 0000697B 56                      	push	si			; back over name, ext
 38737                                  FCBScan:
 38738 0000697C AC                      	lodsb				; get a byte
 38739                                  	
 38740                                  	; 09/08/2018
 38741                                  	;;xlat	byte [es:bx]
 38742                                  	;es	xlat
 38743                                  
 38744                                  	; 22/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0	
 38745 0000697D E871E5                  	call	GetCharType		; get flags
 38746                                  
 38747                                  	;test	al,8	
 38748 00006980 A808                    	test	al,FFCB
 38749 00006982 741B                    	jz	short BadPack
 38750                                  NextCh: 
 38751 00006984 E2F6                    	loop	FCBScan
 38752 00006986 5E                      	pop	si
 38753 00006987 89FB                    	mov	bx,di
 38754 00006989 E8CDB6                  	call	PackName                ; crunch the path
 38755 0000698C 5F                      	pop	di			; get original destination
 38756 0000698D 07                      	pop	es
 38757 0000698E 16                      	push	ss			; get DS addressability
 38758 0000698F 1F                      	pop	ds
 38759                                  	;lea	si,[bp-15] ; MSDOS 3.3
 38760                                  	;LEA	SI,FCBTmp		; point at new pathname
 38761 00006990 8D76F0                  	lea	si,[bp-16]
 38762 00006993 803F00                  	cmp	byte [bx],0
 38763 00006996 7407                    	jz	short BadPack
 38764 00006998 55                      	push	bp
 38765 00006999 E80E00                  	call	TransPathSet            ; convert the path
 38766 0000699C 5D                      	pop	bp
 38767 0000699D 7303                    	jnc	short FCBRet		; bye with transPath error code
 38768                                  BadPack:
 38769 0000699F F9                      	STC
 38770                                  	;mov	al,3
 38771 000069A0 B003                    	MOV     AL,error_path_not_found
 38772                                  FCBRet: 
 38773                                  	;LEAVE
 38774 000069A2 89EC                    	mov	sp,bp
 38775 000069A4 5D                      	pop	bp
 38776                                  TransPath_retn:
 38777 000069A5 C3                      	retn

 38781                                  ;BREAK <TransPath - copy a path, do string sub and put in current dir>
 38782                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38783                                  ;
 38784                                  ;   TransPath - copy a path from DS:SI to ES:DI, performing component string
 38785                                  ;       substitution, insertion of current directory and fixing . and ..
 38786                                  ;       entries. Perform splicing. Allow input string to match splice
 38787                                  ;       exactly.
 38788                                  ;
 38789                                  ;   TransPathSet - Same as above except No splicing is performed if input path
 38790                                  ;       matches splice.
 38791                                  ;
 38792                                  ;   TransPathNoSet - No splicing/local using is performed at all.
 38793                                  ;
 38794                                  ;   The following anomalous behaviour is required:
 38795                                  ;
 38796                                  ;       Drive letters on devices are ignored. (set up DummyCDS)
 38797                                  ;       Paths on devices are ignored. (truncate to 0-length)
 38798                                  ;       Raw net I/O sets ThisCDS => NULL.
 38799                                  ;       fSharing => dummyCDS and no subst/splice. Only canonicalize.
 38800                                  ;
 38801                                  ;   Other behaviour:
 38802                                  ;
 38803                                  ;       ThisCDS set up.
 38804                                  ;       FatRead done on local CDS.
 38805                                  ;       ValidateCDS done on local CDS.
 38806                                  ;
 38807                                  ;   Brief flowchart:
 38808                                  ;
 38809                                  ;       if fSharing then
 38810                                  ;           set up DummyCDS (ThisCDS)
 38811                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 38812                                  ;           splice
 38813                                  ;           fatRead
 38814                                  ;           return
 38815                                  ;       if \\ or d:\\ lead then
 38816                                  ;           set up null CDS (ThisCDS)
 38817                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 38818                                  ;           return
 38819                                  ;       if device then
 38820                                  ;           set up dummyCDS (ThisCDS)
 38821                                  ;           canonicalize (sets cMeta)
 38822                                  ;           return
 38823                                  ;       if file then
 38824                                  ;           getCDS (sets (ThisCDS) from name)
 38825                                  ;           validateCDS (may reset current dir)
 38826                                  ;           Copy current dir
 38827                                  ;           canonicalize (set cMeta)
 38828                                  ;           splice
 38829                                  ;           generate correct CDS (ThisCDS)
 38830                                  ;           if local then
 38831                                  ;               fatread
 38832                                  ;           return
 38833                                  ;
 38834                                  ;   Inputs:     DS:SI - point to ASCIZ string path
 38835                                  ;               DI - point to buffer in DOSDATA
 38836                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry Set - invalid path specification: too many .., bad
 38837                                  ;                   syntax, etc. or user FAILed to I 24.
 38838                                  ;               WFP_Start - points to beginning of buffer
 38839                                  ;               Curr_Dir_End - points to end of current dir in path
 38840                                  ;               DS - DOSDATA
 38841                                  ;   Registers modified: most
 38842                                  ;
 38843                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 38844                                  
 38845                                  ; 22/05/2019
 38846                                  ; 13/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 38847                                  ; DOSCODE:AB99h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 38848                                  
 38849                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 38850                                  ; DOSCODE:AB39h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 38851                                  
 38852                                  TransPath:

 38854 000069A8 EB02                    	JMP     SHORT SetSplice
 38855                                  TransPathSet:
 38856 000069AA B0FF                    	MOV     AL,-1
 38857                                  SetSplice:

 38859 000069B0 B0FF                    	MOV     AL,-1

 38863 000069BC 36893E[B205]            	MOV     [SS:WFP_START],DI 				;smr;SS Override

 38870                                  ; if this is through the server dos call, fsharing is set. We set up a
 38871                                  ; dummy cds and let the operation go.
 38872                                  ;
 38873                                  	;TEST	byte [SS:FSHARING],-1	; if no sharing		;smr;SS Override
 38874                                  	;JZ	short CheckUNC		; skip to UNC check
 38875                                  	; 13/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 38876                                  	;;;
 38877 000069CE 36803E[7205]00          	cmp	byte [ss:FSHARING],0
 38878 000069D4 7435                    	jz	short CheckUNC
 38879                                  	;;;

 38882                                  ;

 38887 000069E1 8D5D01                  	LEA	BX,[DI+1]               ; backup limit
 38888 000069E4 E83401                  	CALL	Canonicalize            ; copy and canonicalize
 38889 000069E7 72BC                    	jc	short TransPath_retn	; errors
 38890                                  ;
 38891                                  ; Perform splices for net guys.
 38892                                  ;
 38893 000069E9 16                      	push	ss
 38894 000069EA 1F                      	pop	ds
 38895 000069EB 8B36[B205]              	MOV     SI,[WFP_START] 		; point to name
 38896 000069EF F606[7105]FF            	TEST	byte [FSPLICE],-1
 38897 000069F4 7403                    	JZ	short NoServerSplice
 38898 000069F6 E82D02                  	CALL    Splice
 38899                                  NoServerSplice:
 38900 000069F9 16                      	push	ss
 38901 000069FA 1F                      	pop	ds                      ; for FATREAD
 38902 000069FB C43E[A205]              	LES     DI,[THISCDS]		; for fatread
 38903 000069FF E8E5A8                  	call	ECritDisk
 38904 00006A02 E838EB                  	call	FATREAD_CDS

 38907                                  	;mov	al,3
 38908 00006A08 B003                    	MOV     AL,error_path_not_found ; Set up for possible bad path error

 38911                                  ; Let the network decide if the name is for a spooled device. It will map
 38912                                  ; the name if so.
 38913                                  
 38914                                  CheckUNC:
 38915 00006A0B 36C706[A205]FFFF        	MOV     WORD [SS:THISCDS],-1	; NULL thisCDS		;smr;SS Override

 38919                                  			; DS:SI -> ASCIZ filename to canonicalize

 38925                                  ; \\s) or is a local file/device. Remember that if a net-spooled device was

 38929                                  NO_CHECK:

 38974                                  CheckPath:

 38977                                  
 38978                                  ; 04/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 38979                                  %if 0
 38980                                  	; MSDOS 6.0
 38981                                  ;;;BUGBUG BUG 10-26-1992 scottq
 38982                                  ;;;This is a hack for the CDROM extensions (2.1) who scan looking
 38983                                  ;;;for the following POP BP == 5Dh (restore <bp,ax>).
 38984                                  ;;;The problem is that a direct call to CheckThisDevice can (and did)
 38985                                  ;;;end up having a 5D in the opcode's displacement field. The
 38986                                  ;;;scanning code would choke on this thinking it was a POP BP instruction.
 38987                                  ;;;
 38988                                  ;;;What we do here is do a call to a function that is less than 5Dh
 38989                                  ;;;bytes away (and assert its not exactly 5D away) that jmps (transfers)
 38990                                  ;;;to the correct function. This cannot accidently insert a 5Dh.
 38991                                  ;;;
 38992                                  ;;;More info:
 38993                                  ;;;  This particular scan is begun at the UNCdone label for 32 bytes
 38994                                  ;;;looking for pop BP, so you cannot put a 5D between here and there.
 38995                                  ;;;
 38996                                  	call	no5Dshere
 38997                                  start5Dhack:
 38998                                  ;following is replaced with 5Dhack code--Invoke CheckThisDevice
 38999                                  backfrom5Dhack:
 39000                                  
 39001                                  %endif
 39002                                  	; 04/12/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 39003                                  	; Note: 'call no5Dshere' is not required for MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS
 39004 00006A54 E869D7                  	call    CheckThisDevice	; E8h,6Fh,0D6h
 39005

 39008 00006A59 731C                    	JNC	short DoFile		; yes we have a file.

 39019                                  ; getpath can understand. Normally getpath requires d:\ to begin the input

 39032                                  DoFile_retn:

 39103                                  
 39104                                  ; BX points to the end of the root part of the CDS (at where a path char
 39105                                  ; should be). Now, we decide whether we use this root or extend it with the
 39106                                  ; current directory. See if the input string begins with a leading

 39112                                  ;
 39113                                  ; The string does begin with a \. Reset the beginning of the canonicalization
 39114                                  ; to this root. Make sure that there is a path char there and advance the
 39115                                  ; source string over all leading \'s.
 39116                                  ;

 39118                                  SkipPath:

 39129                                  PathAssure:

 39131 00006AC5 AA                      	STOSB

 39133                                  ; ES:DI point to the correct spot for canonicalization to begin.
 39134                                  ; BP is the max extent to advance DI

 39139                                  	;retc				; badly formatted path.

 39142                                  ; The string has been moved to ES:DI. Reset world to DOS context, pointers
 39143                                  ; to wfp_start and do string substitution. BP is still the max position in

 40329                                  ;**	BinToAscii - convert a number to a string.
 40330                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40331                                  ;	BinToAscii converts a 16 bit number into a 4 ascii characters.
 40332                                  ;	This routine is used to generate temp file names so we don't spend
 40333                                  ;	the time and code needed for a true hex number, we just use
 40334                                  ;	A thorugh O.
 40335                                  ;
 40336                                  ;	ENTRY	(ax) = value
 40337                                  ;		(es:di) = destination
 40338                                  ;	EXIT	(es:di) updated by 4
 40339                                  ;	USES	cx, di, flags
 40340                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40341                                  
 40342                                  ; MSDOS 3.3
 40343                                  ;BinToAscii:
 40344                                  ;	mov     cx,4
 40345                                  ;bta5:
 40346                                  ;	push    cx
 40347                                  ;	mov     cl,4
 40348                                  ;	rol     ax,cl
 40349                                  ;	push    ax
 40350                                  ;	and     al,0Fh
 40351                                  ;	add     al,'0'
 40352                                  ;	cmp     al,'9'
 40353                                  ;	jbe     short bta6
 40354                                  ;	add     al,7
 40355                                  ;bta6: 
 40356                                  ;	stosb
 40357                                  ;	pop     ax
 40358                                  ;	pop     cx
 40359                                  ;	loop    bta5
 40360                                  ;	retn
 40361                                  
 40362                                  ; MSDOS 6.0
 40363                                  BinToAscii:
 40364 00006ED0 B90404                  	mov	cx,404h			; (ch) = digit counter, (cl) = shift cnt
 40365                                  bta5:	
 40366 00006ED3 D3C0                    	ROL	AX,CL			; move leftmost nibble into rightmost
 40367 00006ED5 50                      	push	ax			; preserve remainder of digits
 40368 00006ED6 240F                    	AND	AL,0Fh			; grab low nibble
 40369 00006ED8 0441                    	ADD	AL,'A'			; turn into ascii

 40371 00006EDB 58                      	pop	ax			; (ax) = shifted number
 40372 00006EDC FECD                    	dec	ch
 40373 00006EDE 75F3                    	jnz	short bta5		; process 4 digits
 40374 00006EE0 C3                      	retn

 40807                                  ;BREAK <$LockOper - Lock Calls>
 40808                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40809                                  ;
 40810                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 40811                                  ;	    MOV     BX, Handle	       (DOS 3.3)
 40812                                  ;	    MOV     CX, OffsetHigh
 40813                                  ;	    MOV     DX, OffsetLow
 40814                                  ;	    MOV     SI, LengthHigh
 40815                                  ;	    MOV     DI, LengthLow
 40816                                  ;	    MOV     AH, LockOper
 40817                                  ;	    MOV     AL, Request
 40818                                  ;	    INT     21h
 40819                                  ;
 40820                                  ;   Error returns:
 40821                                  ;	    AX = error_invalid_handle
 40822                                  ;	       = error_invalid_function
 40823                                  ;	       = error_lock_violation
 40824                                  ;
 40825                                  ;   Assembler usage:
 40826                                  ;	    MOV     AX, 5C??	       (DOS 4.00)
 40827                                  ;
 40828                                  ;				    0? lock all
 40829                                  ;				    8? lock write
 40830                                  ;				    ?2 lock multiple
 40831                                  ;				    ?3 unlock multiple
 40832                                  ;				    ?4 lock/read
 40833                                  ;				    ?5 write/unlock
 40834                                  ;				    ?6 add (lseek EOF/lock/write/unlock)
 40835                                  ;	    MOV     BX, Handle
 40836                                  ;	    MOV     CX, count or size
 40837                                  ;	    LDS     DX, buffer
 40838                                  ;	    INT     21h
 40839                                  ;
 40840                                  ;   Error returns:
 40841                                  ;	    AX = error_invalid_handle
 40842                                  ;	       = error_invalid_function
 40843                                  ;	       = error_lock_violation
 40844                                  ;
 40845                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 40846                                  
 40847                                  	; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)

 41267                                  ;Break <ShareEnter - attempt to enter a node into the sharing set>
 41268                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41269                                  ;   ShareEnter - perform a retried entry of a nodde into the sharing set. If
 41270                                  ;   the max number of retries is exceeded, we notify the user via int 24.
 41271                                  ;
 41272                                  ;   Inputs:     ThisSFT points to the SFT
 41273                                  ;               WFP_Start points to the WFP
 41274                                  ;   Outputs:    Carry clear => successful entry
 41275                                  ;               Carry set => failed system call
 41276                                  ;   Registers modified: all
 41277                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41278                                  
 41279                                  ShareEnter:
 41280 00007164 51                      	push	cx
 41281                                  retry:
 41282 00007165 8B0E[1A00]              	mov     cx,[RetryCount]
 41283                                  attempt:
 41284 00007169 C43E[9E05]              	les     di,[THISSFT]		; grab sft
 41285 0000716D 31C0                    	XOR     AX,AX
 41286                                   	;mov	[es:di+51],ax
 41287 0000716F 26894533                	MOV     [ES:DI+SF_ENTRY.sf_MFT],AX ; indicate free SFT
 41288 00007173 51                      	push	cx
 41289 00007174 E8C4FF                  	call    SHARE_CHECK             ; attempt to enter into the sharing set
 41290 00007177 59                      	pop	cx
 41291 00007178 730A                    	jnc	short done		; success, let the user see this
 41292 0000717A E86CA0                  	call	Idle                    ; wait a while
 41293 0000717D E2EA                    	loop    attempt                 ; go back for another attempt
 41294 0000717F E8BEFF                  	call    SHARE_VIOLATION         ; signal the problem to the user
 41295 00007182 73E1                    	jnc	short retry		; user said to retry, go do it
 41296                                  done:
 41297 00007184 59                      	pop	cx
 41298 00007185 C3                      	retn

 41407                                  	;;test	word [si+2],2		; Q: is this an overlay
 41408                                  	; 17/12/2022
 41409 000071A1 F6440202                	test	byte [si+ERStruc.ER_Flags],ER_OVERLAY ; 2
 41410                                  	;test	word [si+ERStruc.ER_Flags],ER_OVERLAY

 41412                                  					; N: set up lie version first

 41420 000071B3 1F                      	pop	ds

 41447 000071D9 E87D02                  	call	IsCopyProt		; check if copy protected
 41448 000071DC 1F                      	pop	ds

 41451                                  	; We need to inc the A20OFF_COUNT here. Note that if the count
 41452                                  	; is non-zero at this point it indicates that the A20 is to be 
 41453                                  	; turned off for that many int 21 calls made by the app. In 
 41454                                  	; addition the A20 has to be turned off when we exit from this 
 41455                                  	; call. Hence the inc.

 41470                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41471                                  ;
 41472                                  ; procedure : Rational386Patch
 41473                                  ;
 41474                                  ; Older versions of the Rational DOS Extender have several bugs which trash
 41475                                  ; 386 registers (usually just the high word of 32 bit registers) during
 41476                                  ; interrupt processing. Lotus 123 3.1+ is a popular application that uses a
 41477                                  ; version of the Rational extender with the 32 bit register trashing bugs.
 41478                                  ;
 41479                                  ; This routine applies patches to the Rational DOS Extender to work around
 41480                                  ; most of the register trashing bugs.
 41481                                  ;
 41482                                  ; Note that there are additional register trashing bugs not fixed by these
 41483                                  ; patches. In particular, the high word of ESP and the FS and GS registers
 41484                                  ; may be modified on interrupts.
 41485                                  ;
 41486                                  ; There are two different Rational DOS Extender patchs in this module.
 41487                                  ; Rational386Patch is to correct 386 register trashing bugs on 386 or later
 41488                                  ; processors. This patch code is executed when MS-DOS is running on a 386
 41489                                  ; or later processor, regardless of whether MS-DOS is running in the HMA
 41490                                  ; or not.
 41491                                  ;
 41492                                  ; The other Rational patch routine (RationalPatch, below) fixes a register
 41493                                  ; trashing problem on 286 processors, and is only executed if MS-DOS is
 41494                                  ; running in the HMA.
 41495                                  ;
 41496                                  ; This patch detection and replacement is based on an example supplied by
 41497                                  ; Ben Williams at Rational.
 41498                                  ;
 41499                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41500                                  
 41501                                  ; 22/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 41502                                  ; DOSCODE:B448h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 41503                                  
 41504                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41505                                  ;
 41506                                  ; INPUT : ES = segment where program got loaded
 41507                                  ;
 41508                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41509

 41512

 41732                                   .size:

 41740                                  	dw	rpFind3
 41741                                  	dw	rpFind3Len ; 4

 41773                                  struc StackVars
 41774                                   .sv_wVersion:	resw 1		; Rational extender version #
 41775                                   .sv_cbCodeSeg: resw 1		; code seg size to scan
 41776                                   .sv_pPatch:	resw 1		; offset of next avail patch byte
 41777                                   .size:
 41778                                  endstruc
 41779                                  
 41780                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41781                                  
 41782                                  ; 22/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 41783                                  
 41784                                  Rational386Patch:
 41785                                  	; Do a few quick checks to see if this looks like a Rational
 41786                                  	; Extended application. Hopefully this will quickly weed out
 41787                                  	; most non Rational apps.
 41788                                  
 41789                                  	cmp	word [es:0],395		; version number goes here - versions
 41790                                  	jae	short rp3QuickOut	;   3.95+ don't need patching
 41791                                  
 41792                                  	cmp	word [es:0Ch],20h	; always has this value here
 41793                                  	jne	short rp3QuickOut
 41794                                  
 41795                                  	push	ax
 41796                                  
 41797                                  	mov	ax,18h 			; extender has 18h at
 41798                                  	cmp	[es:24],ax		;   offsets 24, 28, & 36
 41799                                  	jne	short rp3QO_ax
 41800                                  	cmp	[es:28],ax
 41801                                  	jne	short rp3QO_ax
 41802                                  	cmp	[es:36],ax
 41803                                  	je	short rp3Maybe
 41804                                  rp3QO_ax:
 41805                                  	pop	ax
 41806                                  rp3QuickOut:
 41807                                  	retn
 41808                                  
 41809                                  ; It might be the rational extender, do more extensive checking
 41810                                  
 41811                                  rp3Maybe:
 41812                                  	cld
 41813                                  	push	bx			; note ax pushed above
 41814                                  	push	cx
 41815                                  	push	dx
 41816                                  	push	si
 41817                                  	push	di
 41818                                  	push	es
 41819                                  	push	ds			; we use all of them
 41820                                  	push	bp
 41821                                  	sub	sp,StackVars.size  ; 6	; make space for stack variables
 41822                                  	mov	bp,sp
 41823                                  
 41824                                  	push	cs
 41825                                  	pop	ds
 41826                                  
 41827                                  	mov	ax,[es:0]		; save version #
 41828                                  	;mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_wVersion],ax
 41829                                  	mov	[bp],ax	
 41830                                  					; check that binary version # matches
 41831                                  	call	VerifyVersion		;   ascii string
 41832                                  	jne	short rp3Exit_j
 41833                                  
 41834                                  ; Looks like this is it, find where to put the patch code.  The
 41835                                  ; patch will be located on top of Rational code specific to 80286
 41836                                  ; processors, so these patchs MUST NOT be applied if running on
 41837                                  ; an 80286 system.
 41838                                  
 41839                                  	; Rational says the code to patch will never be beyond offset 46xxh
 41840                                  
 41841                                  	mov	cx,4500h		; force search len to 4700h (searches
 41842                                  	;mov	[bp+2],cx
 41843                                  	mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_cbCodeSeg],cx	; start at offset 200h)
 41844                                  
 41845                                  	mov	es,[es:20h]		; es=code segment
 41846                                  
 41847                                  	mov	si,rpFind1		; string to find
 41848                                  	mov	dx,rpFind1Len ; 10	; length to match
 41849                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq		; look for code seq
 41850                                  	jz	short rpGotPatch
 41851                                  
 41852                                  ; According to Rational, some very old versions of the extender may not
 41853                                  ; have the find1 code sequence. If the find1 code wasn't found above,
 41854                                  ; try an alternative patch area which is on top of NEC 98xx switching code.
 41855                                  
 41856                                  	mov	si,rpFind1a
 41857                                  	mov	dx,rpFind1aLen  ;8
 41858                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq
 41859                                  	jz	short rpGotPatch
 41860                                  
 41861                                  rp3Exit_j:
 41862                                  	jmp	rp3Exit
 41863                                  
 41864                                  ; Found the location to write patch code! DI = offset in code seg.
 41865                                  
 41866                                  rpGotPatch:
 41867                                  	;mov	[bp+4],di
 41868                                  	mov	[bp-StackVars.sv_pPatch],di	; save patch pointer
 41869                                  
 41870                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41871                                  ; Bug # 1 -- loss of high EAX on 386+ if not VCPI or DPMI
 41872                                  
 41873                                  	;cmp	word [bp+0],381
 41874                                  	;cmp	word [bp+StackVars.sv_wVersion],381 ; only need bug 1 if version
 41875                                  	cmp	word [bp],381
 41876                                  	jae	short rpBug2			;   < 3.81
 41877                                  
 41878                                  	mov	bx,rpBug1Strs			; locate find2 & find3 code
 41879                                  	call	FindBadCode
 41880                                  	jc	short rpBug2
 41881                                  
 41882                                  ; si = rpFind2 offset, di = rpFind3 offset
 41883                                  
 41884                                  	push	di
 41885                                  	mov	di,si				; rpFind2 offset
 41886                                  	mov	dx,rpFind2Len ; 3
 41887                                  
 41888                                  	cmp	byte [es:di-1],51h	 	; find2 preceeded by push cx?
 41889                                  	jne	short rp_no_cx
 41890                                  
 41891                                  	dec	di				;   yes, gobble up push cx too
 41892                                  	inc	dx
 41893                                  rp_no_cx:
 41894                                  	mov	si,rpRepl2			; patch out find2 sequence
 41895                                  	mov	cx,rpRepl2Len  ; 6
 41896                                  	call	GenPatch
 41897                                  
 41898                                  	pop	di				; rpFind3 offset
 41899                                  	cmp	byte [es:di-1],59h 		; find3 preceeded by pop cx?
 41900                                  	jne	short rp_no_cx2
 41901                                  
 41902                                  	mov	byte [es:di-1],90h		;   yes, no-op it
 41903                                  rp_no_cx2:
 41904                                  	;mov	ax,[bp+4]
 41905                                  	mov	ax,[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch]	; change offset of far jmp
 41906                                  	;mov	[es:di+4],ax
 41907                                  	mov	[es:di+rpFind3Len],ax		;   to go to patch code
 41908                                  
 41909                                  	push	di				; save find3 offset
 41910                                  	mov	si,rpRepl3			; copy repl3 to patch area
 41911                                  	mov	cx,rpRepl3Len ; 5
 41912                                  	call	CopyPatch
 41913                                  
 41914                                  	pop	bx				; find3 offset
 41915                                  	add	bx,rpFind3Len+4	 ; 8		; skip over find3 and far jmp
 41916                                  	call	GenJump 			; jmp back from patch area
 41917                                  	;mov	[bp+4],di
 41918                                  	mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch], di	;   to main-line, update patch
 41919                                  						;   area pointer
 41920                                  
 41921                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 41922                                  ; Bug # 2 -- loss of high regs on 386+ under VCPI only
 41923                                  
 41924                                  rpBug2:
 41925                                  	mov	bx,rpBug2Strs			; locate find4 & find5 code
 41926                                  	call	FindBadCode
 41927                                  	jc	short rpBug3
 41928                                  
 41929                                  ; si = rpFind4 offset, di = rpFind5 offset
 41930                                  
 41931                                  	;push	word [bp+4]
 41932                                  	push	word [bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch]	; save current patch pointer
 41933                                  						;   (where repl4 goes)
 41934                                  	push	di				; save find5 offset
 41935                                  
 41936                                  	mov	di,si
 41937                                  	mov	dx,rpFind4Len ; 4
 41938                                  	mov	si,rpRepl4
 41939                                  	mov	cx,rpRepl4Len ; 15
 41940                                  	call	GenPatch			; patch out find4 code
 41941                                  
 41942                                  	pop	di				; find5 offset
 41943                                  	add	di,5				; keep 5 bytes of find5 code
 41944                                  	;mov	bx,[bp+4]
 41945                                  	mov	bx,[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch]	; jump to patch area
 41946                                  	push	bx				; save repl5 location
 41947                                  	call	GenJump
 41948                                  
 41949                                  	mov	si,rpRepl5			; copy repl5 code to patch
 41950                                  	mov	cx,rpRepl5Len  ; 15		;   area -- it has a jmp bx
 41951                                  	call	CopyPatch			;   so no need to jmp back to
 41952                                  						;   main-line code
 41953

 42051                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42052                                  ;
 42053                                  ; FindBadCode
 42054                                  ;
 42055                                  ; Searches Rational code segment looking for a pair of find strings (all
 42056                                  ; patches have at least two find strings).
 42057                                  ;
 42058                                  ; Entry:
 42059                                  ;	ES    = code segment to search
 42060                                  ;	DS:BX = search pair structure for this search
 42061                                  ;	[bp].sv_cbCodeSeg = length of code seg to search
 42062                                  ;
 42063                                  ; Exit:
 42064                                  ;	CY flag clear if both strings found, and
 42065                                  ;	SI    = offset in ES of 1st string
 42066                                  ;	DI    = offset in ES of 2nd string
 42067                                  ;	CY set if either string not found, or strings too far apart
 42068                                  ;
 42069                                  ; Used:
 42070                                  ;	CX
 42071                                  ;
 42072                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42073                                  
 42074                                  ;struc SearchPair
 42075                                  ; .sp_off1: resw 1	; offset of 1st search string
 42076                                  ; .sp_len1: resw 1	; length of 1st search string
 42077                                  ; .sp_off2: resw 1	; 2nd string
 42078                                  ; .sp_len2: resw 1	; 2nd string
 42079                                  ; .sp_diff: resw 1	; max difference between offsets
 42080                                  ; .size:
 42081                                  ;endstruc
 42082                                  
 42083                                  FindBadCode:
 42084                                  	;mov	cx,[bp+2]
 42085                                  	mov	cx,[bp+StackVars.sv_cbCodeSeg]	; search length
 42086                                  
 42087                                  	mov	si,[bx]	; mov si,[bx+0]
 42088                                  	;mov	si,[bx+Searchpair.sp_off1] ; ds:si -> search string
 42089                                  	
 42090                                  	;mov	dx,[bx+2]
 42091                                  	mov	dx,[bx+SearchPair.sp_len1] ; dx = search len
 42092                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq
 42093                                  	jnz	short fbc_error		; done if 1st not found
 42094                                  
 42095                                  	push	di			; save 1st string offset
 42096                                  
 42097                                  	;mov	si,[bx+4]
 42098                                  	mov	si,[bx+SearchPair.sp_off2]
 42099                                  	;mov	dx,[bx+6]
 42100                                  	mov	dx,[bx+SearchPair.sp_len2]
 42101                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq_di		; don't change flags after this!
 42102                                  
 42103                                  	pop	si			; restore 1st string offset
 42104                                  	jnz	short fbc_error
 42105                                  
 42106                                  	mov	ax,di			; sanity check that
 42107                                  	sub	ax,si			;   si < di && di - si <= allowed diff
 42108                                  	;jc	short fbc_error
 42109                                  	; 04/02/2026
 42110                                  	jc	short fbc_err
 42111                                  	;cmp	ax,[bx+8]
 42112                                  	cmp	ax,[bx+SearchPair.sp_diff]
 42113                                  	ja	short fbc_error
 42114                                  
 42115                                  	clc
 42116                                  	retn
 42117                                  
 42118                                  fbc_error:
 42119                                  	stc
 42120                                  fbc_err:
 42121                                  	retn
 42122                                  
 42123                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42124                                  ;
 42125                                  ; GenPatch
 42126                                  ;
 42127                                  ; Generate a patch sequence. 1) insert a jump at the buggy code location
 42128                                  ; (jumps to the patch code area), 2) copy the selected patch code to the
 42129                                  ; patch area, 3) insert a jump from the patch area back to the main-line
 42130                                  ; code.
 42131                                  ;
 42132                                  ; Entry:
 42133                                  ;	ES:DI = start of buggy code to be patched
 42134                                  ;	DX    = length of buggy code to be patched
 42135                                  ;	DS:SI = replacement patch code
 42136                                  ;	CX    = length of replacement patch code
 42137                                  ;	[bp].sv_pPatch = offset in ES of where to copy patch code
 42138                                  ;
 42139                                  ; Exit:
 42140                                  ;	DI, [bp].sv_pPatch = byte after generated patch code
 42141                                  ;
 42142                                  ; Used:
 42143                                  ;	AX, BX, SI, Flags
 42144                                  ;
 42145                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42146                                  
 42147                                  GenPatch:
 42148                                  	push	di			;save offset of buggy code
 42149                                  
 42150                                  	;mov	bx,[bp+4]
 42151                                  	mov	bx,[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch]
 42152                                  					;jump from buggy code to patch area
 42153                                  	call	GenJump
 42154                                  
 42155                                  	call	CopyPatch		;copy replacement code to patch area
 42156                                  
 42157                                  	pop	bx			;offset of buggy code + buggy code
 42158                                  	add	bx,dx			;  length = return from patch offset
 42159                                  
 42160                                  	call	GenJump 		;jump from patch area back to main-
 42161                                  	;mov	[bp+4],di
 42162                                  	mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch],di
 42163                                  					;  line code, update patch pointer
 42164                                  	retn
 42165                                  
 42166                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42167                                  ;
 42168                                  ; CopyPatch
 42169                                  ;
 42170                                  ; Copies patch code to patch location.
 42171                                  ;
 42172                                  ; Entry:
 42173                                  ;	DS:SI = patch code to be copied
 42174                                  ;	ES    = segment of code to patch
 42175                                  ;	CX    = length of code to copy
 42176                                  ;	[bp].sv_pPatch = offset in ES of where to copy patch code
 42177                                  ;
 42178                                  ; Exit:
 42179                                  ;	DI, [bp].sv_pPatch = byte after copied patch code
 42180                                  ;
 42181                                  ; Used:
 42182                                  ;	SI, Flags
 42183                                  ;
 42184                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42185                                  
 42186                                  CopyPatch:
 42187                                  	push	cx
 42188                                  	;mov	di,[bp+4]
 42189                                  	mov	di,[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch] ;patch pointer is the dest offset
 42190                                  	cld
 42191                                  	rep movsb
 42192                                  	pop	cx
 42193                                  	;mov	[bp+4],di
 42194                                  	mov	[bp+StackVars.sv_pPatch],di ;update net pointer location
 42195                                  	retn
 42196                                  
 42197                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42198                                  ;
 42199                                  ; GenJump
 42200                                  ;
 42201                                  ; Generates a rel16 JMP instruction at location 'from' to location 'to'.
 42202                                  ;
 42203                                  ; Entry:
 42204                                  ;	ES:DI = from location (where to put jmp instruction)
 42205                                  ;	BX    = to location (where to jump to)
 42206                                  ;
 42207                                  ; Exit:
 42208                                  ;	DI = byte after generated jump
 42209                                  ;
 42210                                  ; Used:
 42211                                  ;	AX
 42212                                  ;
 42213                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42214                                  
 42215                                  GenJump:
 42216                                  	mov	al,0E9h		; jmp rel16 opcode
 42217                                  	stosb
 42218                                  
 42219                                  	mov	ax,bx		; calc offset to 'to' location
 42220                                  	sub	ax,di
 42221                                  	sub	ax,2
 42222                                  
 42223                                  	stosw			; output offset
 42224                                  
 42225                                  	retn
 42226                                  
 42227                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42228                                  ; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 42229                                  
 42230                                  ; DOSCODE:B6D8h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 42231                                  
 42232                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42233                                  ;
 42234                                  ; ScanCodeSeq
 42235                                  ;
 42236                                  ; Looks for a pattern pointed to by DS:SI & len DX in ES:200 to ES:200+CX-1
 42237                                  ;
 42238                                  ; returns in ES:DI the start of the pattern if Zero flag is set
 42239                                  ;
 42240                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42241                                  
 42242                                  ScanCodeSeq:
 42243                                  	mov	di,200h
 42244                                  ScanCodeSeq_di:
 42245                                  	push	cx
 42246                                  	sub	cx,dx
 42247                                  	inc	cx
 42248                                  scsagain:
 42249                                  	push	si
 42250                                  	push	di
 42251                                  	push	cx
 42252                                  	mov	cx,dx
 42253                                  	rep	cmpsb
 42254                                  	pop	cx
 42255                                  	pop	di
 42256                                  	pop	si
 42257                                  	je	short scsfound
 42258                                  	inc	di
 42259                                  	loop	scsagain
 42260                                  scsfound:
 42261                                  	pop	cx
 42262                                  vvexit:		; 18/12/2022
 42263                                  	retn
 42264                                  
 42265                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42266                                  ; (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS compatibility)
 42267                                  
 42268                                  ; DOSCODE:B6F0h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 42269                                  	
 42270                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42271                                  ;
 42272                                  ; VerifyVersion
 42273                                  ;
 42274                                  ; Checks whether the binary version from ES:0 matches the ASCII version
 42275                                  ; from ES:2A.
 42276                                  ;
 42277                                  ;       Entry: AX = binary version number 
 42278                                  ;       Exit : Z flag set if version numbers match
 42279                                  ;
 42280                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42281                                  
 42282                                  VerifyVersion:
 42283                                  	mov	si,[es:2Ah]		; offset of version number
 42284                                  					;  in ascii
 42285                                  	mov	bl,10
 42286                                  	add	si,3			; point to last digit
 42287                                  
 42288                                  	call	VVDigit
 42289                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42290                                  	call	VVDigit
 42291                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42292                                  	cmp	byte [es:si],'.'
 42293                                  	jne	short vvexit
 42294                                  	dec	si
 42295                                  	;call	VVDigit
 42296                                  	; 18/12/2022
 42297                                  	;jmp	short VVDigit
 42298                                  ;vvexit:
 42299                                  	;retn
 42300                                  VVDigit:
 42301                                  	div	bl
 42302                                  	add	ah,'0'
 42303                                  	dec	si
 42304                                  	cmp	[es:si+1],ah
 42305                                  	mov	ah,0			; do not xor or sub we need Z
 42306                                  	retn
 42307                                  
 42308                                  %endif

 42928                                  ; M020 : BEGIN

 42930                                  ;---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42931                                  ;
 42932                                  ; procedure : RationalPatch
 42933                                  ;
 42934                                  ; A routine (in Ration DOS extender) which is invoked at hardware interrupts
 42935                                  ; clobbers CX register on 286 machines. (123 release 3 uses Rational DOS
 42936                                  ; extender). This routine identifies Buggy Rational EXEs and fixes the bug.
 42937                                  ;
 42938                                  ; THE BUG is in the following code sequence:
 42939                                  ;
 42940                                  ;8b 0e 10 00	mov	cx, ds:[10h]		; delay count
 42941                                  ;90		even				; word align
 42942                                  ;e2 fe		loop	$			; wait		CLOBBERS CX
 42943                                  ;e8 xx xx	call	set_A20			; enable A20
 42944                                  ;
 42945                                  ; This patch routine replaces the mov & the loop with a far call into a
 42946                                  ; routine in DOS data segment which is in low memory (because A20 line
 42947                                  ; is off). The routine (RatBugCode) in DOS data saves & restores CX around
 42948                                  ; a mov & loop.
 42949                                  ;
 42950                                  ; Identification of Buggy Rational EXE
 42951                                  ; ====================================
 42952                                  ;
 42953                                  ; (ALL OFFSETS ARE IN THE PROGRAM SECTION - EXCLUDING THE EXE HEADER)
 42954                                  ;
 42955                                  ; OFFSET				Contains
 42956                                  ; ------				--------
 42957                                  ; 0000h			100 times Version number in binary
 42958                                  ;			bug exists in version 3.48 thru 3.83 (both inclusive)
 42959                                  ;
 42960                                  ; 000ah			the WORDS : 0000h, 0020h, 0000h, 0040h, 0001h
 42961                                  ;
 42962                                  ; 002ah			offset where version number is stored in ASCII
 42963                                  ;				e.g. '3.48A'
 42964                                  ;
 42965                                  ; 0030h			offset of copyright string. Copyright strings either
 42966                                  ;			start with "DOS/16M Copyright...." or
 42967                                  ;			"Copyright.....". The string contains
 42968                                  ;			"Rational Systems, Inc."
 42969                                  ;
 42970                                  ; 0020h			word : Paragraph offset of the buggy code segment
 42971                                  ;				from the program image
 42972                                  ; 0016h			word : size of buggy code segment
 42973                                  ;
 42974                                  ;	Buggy code is definite to start after offset 200h in its segment
 42975                                  ;
 42976                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 42977                                  
 42978                                  ; 23/05/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 42979                                  ; DOSCODE:B976h (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 42980                                  
 42981                                  ; 04/12/2022 - Retro DOS v4.0 (Modified MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
 42982                                  ; DOSCODE:B654h (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 42983                                  
 42984                                  RScanPattern1:
 42985                                  	db	0, 0, 20h, 0, 0, 0, 40h, 0, 1, 0
 42986                                  
 42987                                  RLen1 equ $ - RScanPattern1
 42988                                  
 42989                                  RScanPattern2:
 42990                                  	db	8Bh, 0Eh, 10h, 00h, 90h, 0E2h, 0FEh, 0E8h
 42991                                  
 42992                                  RLen2 equ $ - RScanPattern2
 42993                                  
 42994                                  RScanPattern3:
 42995                                  	db	8Bh, 0Eh, 10h, 00h, 0E2h, 0FEh, 0E8h
 42996                                  
 42997                                  RLen3 equ $ - RScanPattern2
 42998                                  
 42999                                  ; DOSCODE:B98Fh (MSDOS 6.21, MSDOS.SYS)
 43000                                  ; DOSCODE:B66Dh (MSDOS 5.0, MSDOS.SYS)
 43001                                  
 43002                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 43003                                  ;
 43004                                  ; INPUT : ES = segment where program got loaded
 43005                                  ;
 43006                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------

 43009                                  	cld
 43010

 43017                                  	push	si
 43018                                  	push	di
 43019                                  %else
 43020                                  	; 21/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 43021                                  	;;;
 43022                                  	pusha
 43023                                  	;;;
 43024                                  %endif
 43025                                  	push	es
 43026                                  	push	ds			; we use all of them
 43027                                  	mov	di,0Ah			; look for pat1 at offset 0Ah
 43028                                  	push	cs
 43029                                  	pop	ds
 43030                                  	
 43031                                  	mov	si,RScanPattern1
 43032                                  	;mov	cx,10
 43033                                  	mov	cx,RLen1
 43034                                  	rep	cmpsb			; do we have the pattern ?
 43035                                  	jne	short rpexit
 43036                                  	mov	ax,[es:0]
 43037                                  	cmp	ax,348			; is it a buggy version ?
 43038                                  	jb	short rpexit
 43039                                  	cmp	ax,383			; is it a buggy version ?
 43040                                  	ja	short rpexit
 43041                                  
 43042                                  	call	VerifyVersion
 43043                                  	jne	short rpexit
 43044                                  
 43045                                  	mov	cx,[es:16h]		; Length of buggy code seg
 43046                                  	sub	cx,200h			; Length we search (we start
 43047                                  					;  at offset 200h)
 43048                                  	mov	es,[es:20h]		; es=buggy code segment
 43049                                  	mov	si,RScanPattern2
 43050                                  	;mov	dx,8	
 43051                                  	mov	dx,RLen2
 43052                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq		; look for code seq with nop
 43053                                  	jz	short rpfound
 43054                                  
 43055                                  	mov	si,RScanPattern3
 43056                                  	;mov	dx,15
 43057                                  	mov	dx,RLen3
 43058                                  	call	ScanCodeSeq		; look for code seq w/o nop
 43059                                  	jnz	short rpexit
 43060                                  
 43061                                  rpfound:
 43062                                  	
 43063                                  ;	we set up a far call into DOS data
 43064                                  ;	dx has the length of the code seq we were searching for
 43065                                  
 43066                                  	mov	al,9Ah			; far call opcode
 43067                                  	stosb
 43068                                  	mov	ax,RatBugCode
 43069                                  	stosw
 43070                                  	mov	ax,ss
 43071                                  	stosw
 43072                                  	mov	cx,dx
 43073                                  	sub	cx,6			; filler (with NOPs)
 43074                                  	mov	al,90h
 43075                                  	rep	stosb
 43076                                  rpexit:
 43077                                  	pop	ds
 43078                                  	pop	es
 43079                                  
 43080                                  ; 21/03/2024
 43081                                  %if 0
 43082                                  	pop	di
 43083                                  	pop	si
 43084                                  	pop	dx
 43085                                  	pop	cx
 43086                                  	pop	bx
 43087                                  	pop	ax
 43088                                  %else
 43089                                  	; 21/03/2024 (PCDOS 7.1 IBMDOS.COM)
 43090                                  	;;;
 43091                                  	popa
 43092                                  	;;;
 43093                                  %endif
 43094                                  	retn

 43106                                  ;

 43108                                  ;

 44123                                  ;	check_XMM: routine to check presence of XMM driver
 44124                                  ;
 44125                                  ;	Exit:   Sets up the XMM entry point in XMMcontrol in DOSDATA
 44126                                  ;

 44131                                  check_XMM: ; proc near
 44132                                  ;
 44133                                  ; determine whether or not an XMM driver is installed
 44134                                  ;
 44135 00007780 50                      	push	ax
 44136                                  	;mov	ax,(XMM_MULTIPLEX<<8)+XMM_INSTALL_CHECK
 44137 00007781 B80043                  	mov	ax,4300h
 44138 00007784 CD2F                    	int	2Fh
 44139                                  		; - Multiplex - XMS - INSTALLATION CHECK
 44140                                  		; Return: AL = 80h XMS driver installed
 44141                                  		; AL <> 80h no driver

 44143 00007788 751D                    	jne	short cXMM_no_driver	; N: set error, quit

 44315                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44316                                  ;
 44317                                  ; Procedure Name : WhatCPUType
 44318                                  ;
 44319                                  ; Inputs	 : none
 44320                                  ;
 44321                                  ; Outputs	 : AL = 0 if CPU <  286
 44322                                  ;		      = 1 if CPU == 286
 44323                                  ;		      = 2 if CPU >= 386
 44324                                  ;
 44325                                  ; Regs. Mod.	 : AX
 44326                                  ;
 44327                                  ;----------------------------------------------------------------------------
 44328                                  
 44329                                  WhatCPUType:
 44330                                  	; 25/04/2019 - Retro DOS v4.0
 44331                                  	;get_cpu_type	; done with a MACRO which can't be generated > once
 44332                                  
 44333                                  	;CPUTYPE.INC (MSDOS 6.0, 1991)
 44334                                  
 44335                                  ; Note: this must be a macro, and not a subroutine in the BIOS since
 44336                                  ; 	it is called from both CODE and SYSINITSEG.
 44337                                  ;
 44338                                  ;------GET_CPU_TYPE-----------------------------------May, 88 by M.Williamson
 44339                                  ;  Returns: AX = 0 if 8086 or 8088
 44340                                  ;              = 1 if 80286
 44341                                  ;              = 2 if 80386
 44342                                  
 44343                                  	; 04/11/2022
 44344                                  	; MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS - DOSCODE:0BB03h
 44345                                  
 44346                                  Get_CPU_Type:	;macro
 44347                                  	pushf
 44348                                  	push	bx			; preserve bx
 44349                                  	xor	bx,bx			; init bx to zero
 44350                                  
 44351                                  	xor	ax,ax			; 0000 into AX
 44352                                  	push	ax			; put it on the stack...
 44353                                  	popf				; ...then shove it into the flags
 44354                                  	pushf				; get it back out of the flags...
 44355                                  	pop	ax			; ...and into ax
 44356                                  	and	ax,0F000h		; mask off high four bits
 44357                                  	cmp	ax,0F000h		; was it all 1's?
 44358                                  	je	short cpu_8086		; aye; it's an 8086 or 8088
 44359                                  
 44360                                  	mov	ax,0F000h		; now try to set the high four bits..
 44361                                  	push	ax
 44362                                  	popf
 44363                                  	pushf
 44364                                  	pop	ax			; ...and see what happens
 44365                                  	and	ax,0F000h		; any high bits set ?
 44366                                  	jz	short cpu_286		; nay; it's an 80286
 44367                                  
 44368                                  cpu_386:				; bx starts as zero
 44369                                  	inc	bx			; inc twice if 386
 44370                                  cpu_286:				; just inc once if 286
 44371                                  	inc	bx
 44372                                  cpu_8086:				; don't inc at all if 086
 44373                                  	mov	ax,bx			; put CPU type value in ax
 44374                                  	pop	bx			; restore original bx
 44375                                  	popf
 44376                                  	
 44377                                  	;endm
 44378                                  
 44379                                  	; 04/11/2022 (MSDOS 5.0 MSDOS.SYS)
